title: Stand up comedy editor and content manager
job_title: Stand up comedy editor and content manager
description: I’m a professional stand-up comedian looking for someone to help me grow my audience on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. I have over 100 million views but want to take things to the next level. This is NOT just a video editing job. I’m looking for someone who wants to become obsessed with figuring out how to make my comedy go viral. And there is one requirement that is more important than anything else: You MUST genuinely love stand-up comedy. I don’t mean you’ve seen a few Kevin Hart clips on TikTok. I want someone who actually watches American stand-up comedy in their free time. You should have favorite comedians. You should watch comedy specials. You should understand why a joke is funny, where the punchline is, and why the setup matters. You should understand sarcasm, irony, wordplay, crowd work, cultural references, and comedic timing. This also means your English comprehension needs to be EXCELLENT. You don’t have to speak perfect English. But you need to understand it at a very high level. If you don’t genuinely love stand-up comedy, please don’t apply. WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY BE DOING I have a large amount of stand-up footage, podcasts, and other long-form content. Your job will be to find the best moments and turn them into short-form videos that people want to watch and share. You’ll primarily be creating content for: * Instagram Reels * Instagram Trial Reels * TikTok * YouTube Shorts We’ll be posting a LOT. On Instagram alone, I want to test at least 5 Trial Reels per day. The goal isn’t just to pump out 5 random videos. We’re going to test constantly and figure out what works. Which jokes get the most views? Which opening lines stop people from scrolling? Which topics perform best? Which clips generate followers? Which lengths perform best? What makes someone watch until the punchline? What makes someone share a clip with their friend? I want you paying attention to all of this. I DON’T WANT SOMEONE WHO JUST FOLLOWS INSTRUCTIONS At the beginning, I’ll give you a lot of direction. I’ll show you what I like. I’ll show you my best-performing content. I’ll explain my comedy and how I think about clips. But eventually I want YOU finding the clips. I want to be able to give you a 60-minute stand-up performance or a 90-minute podcast and have you identify the moments that have the best chance of performing online. I want you to get to know my comedy so well that you can watch something and immediately think: “That’s the clip.” That’s much more valuable to me than someone who is simply good at using editing software. YOUR REAL JOB IS GROWTH I don’t care about posting content just so we can say we posted something. I want views. I want followers. I want fans. I want someone who gets genuinely excited when a video takes off. If one video gets 20,000 views and another gets 2,000,000 views, I want you asking WHY. Was it the joke? The first three seconds? The caption? The length? The topic? The editing? Could we take another clip and package it the same way? Could we edit the same joke differently and test it again? You should constantly be looking for patterns and trying to beat our previous results. YOU’LL GET PAID MORE WHEN WE WIN In addition to your normal pay, you’ll have the opportunity to earn significant monthly performance bonuses. The more views and growth our content generates, the more money you can make. There will be bonuses based on things like: * Total monthly organic views * Follower growth * Individual videos that become breakout hits I want your incentives aligned with mine. If you help me build a massive comedy audience, I want this to become a VERY good job for you. WHO I’M LOOKING FOR You’ll probably be a great fit if: * You genuinely love American stand-up comedy * You regularly watch stand-up specials and comedy clips * Your English comprehension is excellent * You understand American humor and cultural references * You’re good at identifying the funniest/most interesting moment in a longer video * You have experience editing short-form vertical video * You understand hooks, retention, pacing, captions, and short-form storytelling * You understand Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube * You’re comfortable producing and posting a high volume of content * You like looking at analytics * You’re competitive * You experiment instead of doing the same thing over and over * You’re proactive * You can work independently * You want to get REALLY fucking good at social media growth HOURS We’ll start at approximately 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week. The first month will essentially be a paid trial. If you’re great at this, I would love to turn it into a full-time position. I’m not looking for someone to edit videos for me for three months. I’m looking for someone who could potentially work with me for YEARS and become an important part of growing my comedy career. HOW TO APPLY Please answer ALL of these questions: 1. Who are your 5 favorite stand-up comedians? Do not Google “popular American comedians.” I will be able to tell 😂 2. What is your favorite stand-up special you’ve watched recently and why did you like it? 3. Send me links to 3 short-form videos you’ve personally edited. 4. Tell me about the most successful short-form video you’ve edited. How many views did it get? 5. Why do you think that video performed well? 6. If I gave you a 60-minute stand-up show, how would you d ---------- which 5 moments should become clips? 7. What editing software do you use? 8. What is your current availability? And finally: Start your application with the words “THAT’S THE CLIP” so I know you actually read this entire post. If you don’t include those words, I won’t read your application. I’m excited to find someone who loves comedy and wants to build something big with me.

title: Dedicated Executive & Operations VA
description: Dedicated Executive & Operations VA I am looking for a long-term Filipino virtual assistant who is reliable, loyal, available during U.S. working hours, and able to take responsibility for online administrative work without needing constant supervision. Please read this carefully before applying. First: Do NOT Send Me a Resume I do not want a resume. Do not send me a long employment history, certificates, software lists, or paragraphs telling me how skilled, hardworking, dependable, or experienced you are. If you send me a resume instead of following the application instructions below, I will delete the application. I am not interested in how impressive you sound. I want to know whether you can actually help me. The Two Most Important Qualities: Reliability and Loyalty This position requires commitment. I am not looking for: * An agency * An entrepreneur building their own business * Someone managing many clients at the same time * Someone who will regularly place another client’s work ahead of mine * Someone who disappears when things get busy * Someone who misses deadlines because another client needed them first If there is a conflict between another client’s deadline and my deadline, and my work regularly becomes secondary, this will not be a good fit. I need someone who can make a real commitment to our team and our deadlines. I am looking for a long-term working relationship built on trust, dependability, communication, and loyalty. Christian Faith and Local Church Involvement Are Required This is a Christian ministry position. I serve evangelical, born-again pastors, church leaders, ministry leaders, biblical counselors, and Christian organizations. Because of that, the person assisting me must understand evangelical Christian ministry and have meaningful experience in the life of a local Bible-teaching church. You must: * Be a born-again Christian. * Attend an evangelical, Bible-teaching local church. * Be actively involved in the life of your church. * Understand basic evangelical Christian language, ministry culture, and church life. * Be comfortable communicating with pastors and ministry leaders. * Be able to represent a Christian ministry appropriately and professionally. This is not simply a preference. It is directly connected to the work you will be doing and the people we serve. As part of the interview process, I will ask you to provide: * The name of your local church. * The name of your pastor. * Your church website or public church information. * A brief description of your involvement in the church. * A letter of recommendation or endorsement from your pastor confirming that you attend and participate in the local church. Please do not apply if you are not currently part of an evangelical, Bible-teaching local church. You Must Work During U.S. Hours This is not a position where all work can be completed independently while I am asleep. We need to work together. You must be available for meaningful portions of the U.S. workday and be willing to communicate live when needed. There will be: * Zoom conversations * Voice conversations * Real-time questions * Team meetings * Deadline discussions * Project updates Your schedule must allow you to work effectively with a U.S.-based team. Fluent Conversational English Is Required You must be able to have a normal conversation with me in English. I am not looking for perfect grammar or an American accent. I do need you to: * Understand normal conversational English * Speak comfortably * Ask clear questions * Explain problems * Discuss projects * Understand instructions * Participate in Zoom meetings * Communicate without major language barriers We will speak regularly. If spoken English is difficult for you, please do not apply. I Need Someone Who Takes Work Off My Plate I am a pastor, professor, ministry leader, and administrator. I need someone who can receive an assignment, understand the goal, and move it forward. I do not want to manage every small step. A good candidate will naturally: * Take initiative * Follow through * Meet deadlines * Communicate before a deadline is missed * Research before asking unnecessary questions * Solve routine problems * Keep projects organized * Remember commitments * Follow up * Notice unfinished work * Bring me solutions instead of only problems * Learn new software when necessary * Take ownership I want to be able to say: “Please take care of this.” And have confidence that it will actually be taken care of. Be Honest About Your Skills Do not exaggerate. If you tell me you are advanced in a software program or skill, I may ask you to demonstrate it. I would much rather hear: “I know the basics, but I would need to learn more.” Honesty and self-awareness matter more to me than an impressive list of skills. How to Apply Do NOT send a resume. Instead, answer these questions briefly: 1. What other clients or jobs are you currently working for, and approximately how many hours per week do they require? 2. What U.S. hours are you available to work? 3. Are you willing to make our deadlines a priority when work has been assigned to you? 4. Why are you looking for one long-term position rather than managing many clients? 5. Give me one example of an online administrative responsibility you could take completely off my plate. 6. Tell me one skill you are genuinely strong in and one skill you are still developing. 7. What is the name of the local church you currently attend? 8. What is your pastor’s name? 9. Send me the website or public page for your church. 10. Briefly tell me how you are involved in your local church. 11. Are you willing, if you move forward in the interview process, to provide a brief recommendation or endorsement from your pastor confirming your participation in the church? 12. Plan a Zoom meeting with me in English and answering this question: “If I give you an important assignment with a deadline and you begin running into problems, what will you do?” Keep your response short. Following these instructions is part of the interview. What I Am Looking For I am looking for someone who can become a trusted member of the team. Reliability matters. Loyalty matters. Christian faith matters. Local church involvement matters. Communication matters. Meeting deadlines matters. Taking ownership matters. If you are looking for a stable, long-term position where you can become increasingly valuable to one Christian ministry organization, I would like to hear from you.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
job_title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
description: Who We Are: We are CL Financial (CLFIN . ca), a Toronto-based financial services firm serving families across Ontario and Alberta, with a strong presence in the Filipino community in Canada. We've been around since 2012 and are now in an exciting stage of growth: building new technology, training programs, internal systems, and infrastructure to support where the company is going next. We're a lean team with ambitious plans, and we care about doing things well: clean systems, clear communication, strong design, and thoughtful execution. We're not trying to become a huge corporate machine. We want to stay lean, move quickly, and have really capable people doing meaningful work. About the Role: We're looking for a Strategic Executive Assistant to work closely with our COO across creative, operational, and strategic projects. This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll simply be handed a checklist every morning and told what to do. Sometimes you'll get a clear assignment. Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job. This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term. One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to. What You'll Do: Project Support: - Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups - Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers - Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks Creative & Communication: - Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets - Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs - Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools - Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better" Systems & Operations: - Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines - Test new internal tools and identify improvements - Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work AI & Technology: - Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work - Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly - Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more. Who We're Looking For: You'll probably thrive here if you: - Have excellent written English - Are highly organized and dependable - Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting) - Can work independently without needing constant direction - Learn new tools quickly - Can manage multiple projects without losing the details - Are comfortable receiving direct feedback - Naturally look for better ways to do things - Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting) Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome. Why Work With Us? - Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making - Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work - Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged - Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business - Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow - A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role - A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans - A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background) - The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real) How to Apply: If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting. Please include: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Why this role caught your attention 3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform? We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor for Medical Clinics (Capable of Batch Editing)

job_title: Meta Ads Video Editor for Medical Clinics (Capable of Batch Editing)
salary_detail: Paid Trial First into Full -Time Hire
description: Read this whole post before applying. The instructions at the bottom are part of the test. WHO WE ARE Novaris Global. We run paid advertising for private medical clinics, mostly plastic surgery and aesthetics. Our clients are in Singapore and we are expanding. Our ads run on Meta. When they work, the clinic books consultations. When they don't, we lose money. That is the entire scoreboard. THE MAIN THING YOU WOULD BE DOING Once or twice a month a doctor sits down and records for 30 to 60 minutes straight. He works through a stack of scripts, flubs lines, restarts, goes off on tangents, repeats himself, and says something better on the third take than he did on the first. It is one long messy file. Out of that single file we need 30 to 60 finished Meta video ads. Not 30 exports of the same cut. Thirty to sixty ads that each open differently, run differently, and feel like they came from different creatives. That is how Meta finds a winner, and it is the actual skill we are hiring for. That means you: - Watch the whole file and map what is really in there - D ---------- where one ad ends and the next one starts - Pick the strongest take of every line, not the first one - Cut the sentences that add nothing. Warm ups, throat clearing, repeated ideas, and the line that is technically true but kills the pace - Reorder freely. If the best hook is something he said at minute 34, that line goes to second zero - Recombine. The same three sentences in a different order, with a different opening line and a different first ten seconds, is a different ad - Build each one properly. On screen text in the first two seconds, burned in captions throughout, a lower third with his name and clinic, b-roll, sound design, graphics, end card THE OTHER TWO KINDS OF WORK Not everything arrives as a batch. Some weeks you get a single clip and a brief and we need one sharp ad out of it by tomorrow. And some weeks you get a video sales letter. Long form, five to twenty minutes, a doctor walking through an argument end to end. Completely different edit. The hook still has to land in the first few seconds, but now you are holding attention for fifteen minutes instead of thirty seconds, which means pacing, chapter beats, visual variety, and knowing exactly where a viewer gets bored and what to put there. If you have never cut long form, say so honestly. If you have, lead with it. EVERY AD HAS TO FEEL DIFFERENT This is the part almost every editor fails. When you cut 40 ads from one recording, the lazy version is one template with 40 different hooks dropped in. Meta sees through it, the audience sees through it, and the account stalls. We want visible variety across the set. Different caption styles. Different graphic treatments. One ad that leans on text animation, one that is almost bare and lets him talk, one built around a simple diagram, one with heavier b-roll, one that opens on a graphic before he appears. Different rhythms. Different energy. Someone scrolling should never think they have already seen this ad. Play around. Have opinions. Show us range. THE LINE YOU CANNOT CROSS WHILE DOING IT This is a surgeon, not a dropshipper. Every one of those 40 ads still has to look expensive, clean, and calm. Variety in style, never variety in standards. No meme zooms. No shake. No cartoon sound effects. No AI voice. No stock footage of a family smiling at sunset. If an edit would look at home selling a phone case, it is wrong for us. The hard version of this job is doing both at once. Retention editing that actually holds attention, inside a look a private surgeon would put his name on. Most editors can do one or the other. Medical advertising in Singapore is also regulated, and moves that are normal everywhere else are illegal there. No before and after footage. No testimonials. No "best" or "guaranteed." No countdowns or scarcity. We give you the full rule sheet on day one, but you have to be someone who follows a rule sheet exactly, every time, without being reminded. WHAT YOU NEED TO ALREADY KNOW - Hook rate and hold rate, and what actually moves them. If your answer to a weak hook is "add a zoom," this role is not for you - The first two seconds carry on screen text, because most of Meta watches on mute - A retention beat every few seconds. A cut, a caption change, a graphic, a b-roll insert. Something has to change or they are gone - Captions readable at arm's length on a phone, inside Meta's safe zones, not sitting under the interface - Sound design that supports the point instead of decorating it. A whoosh on every cut is amateur work - 9:16 at 1080x1920, correct loudness, correct export settings, and a first frame that is not a blink - Written English strong enough to judge a sentence. You are d ---------- which of a surgeon's sentences survive. That takes real comprehension, not just an ear for rhythm NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED If you can write, say so. If you can watch a raw recording and tell us "he never said the thing that would make this ad work, here is what he should say next time," that is worth more to us than another year of Premiere experience, and it changes what we pay you. THE SETUP - Full time, 40 hours a week - Your own machine that handles 4K without taking an hour to export - Reliable internet, because you are moving large files - Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, whatever you like. We care about the output, not your toolkit - You work directly with me. Small team, no layers, fast decisions HOW THIS STARTS A paid trial. Real footage, a real brief, real money for your time. We are not going to pretend a reel tells us anything. Plenty of great reels were cut by somebody else. The trial tells us what you actually do when a messy file lands in your lap. If the work comes back genuinely excellent, and we mean excellent and not acceptable, we move straight to a full time offer. If it does not, you keep the money and we part on good terms. BEFORE YOU D ---------- THIS IS TOO MUCH WORK Yes, this application asks more of you than the other posts on this site. That is deliberate. So here is the honest math on what you are applying to. We are hiring one person, once. Whoever we pick stops applying for jobs. You are not applying to a task. You are applying to a department that does not exist yet, with your name on it. Right now every video for every client we have runs through one folder and one to do list. The person we hire builds what replaces that. You set the standard. You make the templates every editor after you works from. You hire those editors and review their work instead of doing it. Head of Video, across every account, fully in house. Not a freelancer we message when something comes up. On the team, in the meetings, in the decisions. You will also see the money side, which almost no editor anywhere gets to see. Hook rate on your cuts. Cost per lead. Which clinic booked how many consultations off which edit. That feedback loop is the entire difference between an editor who is good at software and an editor who is worth whatever they ask for, for the rest of their career. We will hand it to you. And here is why we can pay for that. Our clients do not pay us a flat fee. We take a share of the revenue we generate for them. When your ad wins, we do not save money, we make more of it. So we would far rather pay one exceptional editor well beyond what this platform normally pays than hire five cheap ones and manage them. Your ceiling here is not an hourly rate. It grows with the accounts you are cutting for. A few hours today. If we are right about each other, you will look back on this as the best few hours you ever spent on an application. If none of that moves you, please do not apply. We would rather read ten serious applications than a hundred lazy ones. HOW TO APPLY Do all four. Applications missing any of them get deleted unread. Two of these are what we actually judge: the ads you have already cut, and what you cut for us. The other two take a minute each. Spend your time on the first two. 1. Make THUMBSTOP the first word of your message. 2. Send three to five direct response video ads you personally cut. What counts: ads that actually ran as paid media on Meta, TikTok, or YouTube. Something built to make a stranger take an action. What does not count and will get your application closed: showreels, montages, wedding films, YouTube intros, vlogs, corporate brand videos, event recaps, anything cut to music with no message. Do not send a reel. Send the ads themselves, full length, exactly as they ran. We watch from the first frame, because the first frame is the job. For each one, one line covering: - Who it was for and what it was selling - Whether it ran as paid media, and roughly what it spent if you know - Any numbers you have. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per result. If you have none, say none. We would rather hear that than a guess - What you personally did on it, honestly. If you cut it start to finish, say so. If you did captions and graphics on somebody else's assembly, say that instead. We will find out either way, and the honest answer has never cost anyone the job If your strongest work is under an NDA, send what you can and tell us what we are missing. 3. Cut something from this file: ---------- THE MINIMUM is five seconds. Just the hook. The opening that would stop someone scrolling, with whatever on screen text, sound, graphics, and cutting you think earns those five seconds. Start from any moment in the file you want. A genuinely strong five seconds is enough to get you shortlisted. THE FULL AD IS BETTER. If you send a finished ad cut from this file, hook through to end card with captions all the way, we will watch every second of it and you go to the top of the pile. It is not required. It is an opportunity, and the people who take it are usually the people we hire. Either way, in two or three sentences: why that moment, why that treatment, and what you cut out and why. Do not post this footage anywhere public. 4. Answer this in writing. You receive a 45 minute file of a surgeon recording what he thinks are eight ads. He goes off script constantly and the single best line he says is at minute 38. What do you do in your first hour, before you cut anything? And how do you get 40 genuinely different ads out of it instead of 40 versions of one? Shortlisted applicants go straight to a paid trial on real client footage.

title: Admin Project Manager (Tech) — Moodap

Structuring the backlog: intake bugs, feature requests, and priorities; assign clear ownership and due dates; keep everything ranked and visible. Enforcing process — the developers focus on building; you make sure nothing falls through the cracks, nothing is undocumented, and nothing is "somewhere in a Slack thread" instead of tracked properly. Escalating problems the moment you see them, not after they've become bigger problems. How We Work Direct, honest, and blunt communication is the standard here — with the developers and with the founder. We care about solutions, not blame. If something isn't working, we want to hear it early and clearly, with a plan attached.

title: Copywriter - Linkedin Ghostwriter
description: We are looking for a strong writer, clear thinker and creative communicator to join our team and support our LinkedIn marketing work. We work with business owners and professionals to help them build their authority on LinkedIn, create engaging content, grow their networks and turn relationships into genuine business opportunities. This is a varied role combining: - LinkedIn content writing - Story-based copywriting - LinkedIn graphic creation - Email relationship building and follow-up You do not need to already be a LinkedIn expert. Training will be provided on our LinkedIn strategy, content frameworks, storytelling approach and conversation/outreach processes. However, you must already be a strong writer with the ability to understand information quickly and communicate it clearly. We are particularly interested in someone who can take a complicated subject and make it feel simple. An engineering, technical, analytical or other structured-thinking background would be a strong advantage. 1. LinkedIn Content Writing A major part of your role will be writing LinkedIn content for different businesses and professionals. You may be given: - Interview or meeting transcripts - Voice notes - Client stories - Business information - Rough ideas and notes - Videos or podcasts - Existing marketing material Your job is not simply to summarise this information. You need to be able to understand the material, identify what is interesting and turn it into a strong LinkedIn post. We are particularly interested in story-based business writing. You should naturally think about questions such as: - What is the story here? - What makes this interesting? - Why would the reader care? - What is the business insight? - How can I explain this simply? - How can I make this sound like the person I'm writing for? We are NOT looking for generic content that follows the same "hook + three tips + CTA" formula every time. The writing should feel human, specific and interesting. You will receive training in our LinkedIn content methodology, but strong writing ability is essential before you start. 2. Creating LinkedIn Graphics Creating graphics is a regular and important part of this role. You will be responsible for creating the visual content that accompanies LinkedIn posts. This may include: - Single-image LinkedIn graphics - Quote or statement graphics - Simple branded graphics - Simple diagrams - Thumbnail-style graphics You should be comfortable using Canva or similar design software. You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer. In fact, we generally prefer simple designs. What matters is that you have good visual judgement and can understand the main message of a post and communicate that idea visually without making the design cluttered or complicated. Experience creating LinkedIn graphics or YouTube thumbnails would be a strong advantage. 3. Relationship-Building Emails You will also help us reconnect with people with whom we already have business relationships. You may be given access to previous email conversations and asked to understand: - Who the person is - What they do - How we know them - What we previously discussed - Where the relationship or conversation stopped - What opportunities may exist to reconnect - What would be a genuine reason to contact them again You will then draft a personalised email to restart the conversation. This is not mass email marketing. We don't want generic templates being sent to hundreds of people. You need to be able to read previous conversations, understand context and write something that feels natural, personal and relevant to that particular relationship. 4. LinkedIn Outreach & Conversations Another part of the role will be helping us build relationships through LinkedIn. This may include: - Identifying relevant people to connect with - Sending personalised connection messages - Starting conversations - Responding to messages - Following up naturally - Maintaining conversations over time - Recognising potential business opportunities - Helping move appropriate conversations towards a call We will provide training on our approach. The goal is to have genuine conversations that build trust and relationships. Previous experience in sales, business development, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service or LinkedIn outreach would therefore be an advantage. Who We Are Looking For The most important qualities for this role are writing ability, comprehension and clear thinking. You should be someone who can receive a lot of information, understand what actually matters and communicate it simply. You should: - Be an excellent written English communicator - Write naturally and conversationally - Understand storytelling - Be able to identify a good story from raw information - Understand complicated ideas and simplify them - Be curious and willing to research unfamiliar subjects - Have strong attention to detail - Be able to understand different businesses relatively quickly - Be able to write in different people's voices - Have good visual judgement - Be comfortable creating graphics in Canva or similar tools - Be comfortable communicating with people online - Be open to feedback and training - Be organised and able to manage multiple pieces of content We would particularly value someone with an analytical, engineering, technical, scientific, financial or similarly structured-thinking background. Your ability to understand complex subjects is important. LinkedIn Experience Previous LinkedIn experience is a big advantage, but it is not essential. If you have previously: - Written LinkedIn posts - Ghostwritten for founders or business owners - Managed LinkedIn accounts - Created LinkedIn graphics - Created LinkedIn carousels - Conducted LinkedIn outreach - Managed LinkedIn conversations Please include examples when you apply. However, if you haven't worked specifically with LinkedIn but you are an exceptional writer with strong business comprehension, we would still like to hear from you. What We Will Teach You We will provide training and examples to help you understand: - How we write LinkedIn content - How we identify stories - How we structure different types of LinkedIn posts - How we write in a client's voice - How we create LinkedIn graphics - How we build professional networks - How we start conversations - How we follow up without being pushy - How we move appropriate conversations towards business calls We are not expecting someone to arrive knowing our entire process. We are looking for someone with the underlying ability to become excellent at it. How to Apply Please do not send only a CV or a generic application. We want to see how you think and communicate. Please include the following with your application: 1. Writing Samples Send us 2–3 examples of your best writing. We would particularly like to see business writing that tells a story rather than purely promotional copy. LinkedIn posts are ideal, but articles, emails, scripts, social media posts or other business content are also welcome. 2. Simplifying a Complex Subject Please show us one example where you took something relatively complicated and explained it in a simple, easy-to-understand way. This is particularly important to us. 3. Design Samples Please include examples of graphics you have personally created. These could include: LinkedIn graphics Carousels Social media graphics YouTube thumbnails Infographics Other simple business content Please tell us which parts you personally created. 4. LinkedIn Experience If you have written LinkedIn posts or managed LinkedIn accounts before, please send us links, screenshots or samples. If you haven't, that's okay. Just tell us that you haven't. 5. Sales / Outreach Experience Briefly tell us about any experience you've had with: Sales Business development LinkedIn outreach Lead generation Appointment setting Customer conversations Again, this is an advantage rather than an absolute requirement. 6. Tell Us About You In a few sentences, tell us: What is your background, and why do you think you would be particularly good at understanding complex businesses and turning their ideas into simple, interesting content? 7. Availability and Hours How many hours are you wanting to work per week? And, what's your expected monthly rate? One Final Note Please don't worry if you don't meet every requirement listed above. We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already spent years as a "LinkedIn specialist." We are looking for someone who has the foundations we can build on: Strong writing. Clear thinking. Storytelling ability. Curiosity. Good visual judgement. Attention to detail. And the ability to communicate naturally with people. If you have those qualities, we can teach you the rest.

title: META ADS MEDIA BUYER/ STRATEGIST
description: Do not apply unless you have maximum confidence in your ability to deliver results. We will ask for proof. Ensure you read the whole description. Media Buyer — Meta Ads Specialist Reports to: Head of Growth / Marketing Director Full-time | Performance Marketing | Paid Social About the role We're looking for a results-driven, high-performance Media Buyer who lives and breathes Meta advertising. You've managed substantial budgets, know how to scale without blowing ROAS, and can back everything up with hard data. If you've turned paid social into a predictable growth engine, we want to talk. At a glance Minimum ROAS: 3.0+ Monthly spend managed: $10k+ Experience required: 2+ years Meta Ads Track record: Proven ability to scale Key responsibilities Own end-to-end campaign management across Meta Ads Manager — from strategy and build to optimisation and reporting, across multiple accounts simultaneously. Strategically scale ad spend — increasing budgets and expanding audiences while maintaining a minimum 3.0 ROAS, using proven budget-pacing and bid management techniques. Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers — building a clear testing log and acting on results with speed. Brief and collaborate with the creative team to produce high-converting ad assets — you understand what makes a Meta ad stop the scroll and drive conversions, and you can communicate that clearly. Monitor account health daily — diagnosing performance drops, frequency issues, audience fatigue, and delivery problems before they impact results. Build and manage full-funnel campaign structures — prospecting (TOF), retargeting (MOF/BOF), and retention — with a clear understanding of how each layer interacts. Set up and maintain accurate tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), custom events, and UTM parameters — ensuring data integrity across all campaigns. Deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights — no vanity metrics, just ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and the story they tell. Stay ahead of Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats — proactively adapting strategy before performance is affected. What we require Proven spend experience: you must have personally managed Meta ad accounts at $10k+ monthly spend. You'll be asked to provide account-level results, not agency-level attribution. Demonstrated ROAS performance: a consistent track record of sustaining 3.0+ ROAS at scale. You must be able to show this with real data. Deep Meta Ads Manager expertise: campaign objective selection, CBO vs ABO strategy, Advantage+ campaigns, broad vs interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and manual vs automated bidding. Scaling methodology: you have a clear, repeatable process for scaling budgets — whether through horizontal expansion, budget multipliers, or audience diversification — without destabilising campaigns. Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar attribution tools. You don't just read dashboards — you interrogate data to form hypotheses. Tracking & measurement fluency: solid understanding of iOS 14+ attribution impact, CAPI implementation, and how to maintain reporting accuracy in a privacy-first landscape. Creative instinct: you understand performance creative — hooks, UGC formats, video vs static — and can brief a team or give concrete, actionable feedback on ad assets. Self-sufficient and accountable: you flag problems early, own outcomes, and don't wait for direction. You manage your accounts like they're your own business. Nice to have Experience running Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube alongside Meta as part of a blended paid strategy. Experience in DTC / e-commerce environments where ROAS and blended MER are primary KPIs. Shopify analytics experience and understanding of how paid social integrates with on-site conversion rate. Experience managing multiple client accounts with varying spend levels, verticals, and objectives. Meta Blueprint certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Interview process Application review — Submit a brief summary of your highest-spend account, the ROAS achieved, and how you scaled it. Intro call (30 min) — Walk us through your experience, biggest wins, and how you think about scaling. Paid task / case study — A short paid exercise: audit a real or sample account and present your findings and action plan. Final interview — Deep dive with the hiring manager. We'll go through your case study and align on strategy. Important note We take results seriously. During the process, you'll be expected to share real performance data (anonymised if needed) that validates your experience. Candidates who cannot demonstrate their ROAS track record with data will not progress.

title: MOBILE IOS SOFTWARE ENGINEER
description: Orani is an AI-powered virtual receptionist built for solo and micro service businesses — cleaners, contractors, realtors, detailers — who lose revenue every time a call goes unanswered. Orani gives every independent operator a dedicated business number backed by an AI that answers calls, captures caller intent, and delivers structured summaries and follow-up actions directly to the owner's phone. We're a small, fast-moving team building a product that genuinely helps people run their businesses better. The Role You'll be working across the full product — mobile UI, backend API, and telephony logic. Most of what you'll touch is already built; your job is to fix bugs, ship new features, and raise the overall quality bar. You should be comfortable jumping between a Flutter screen and a Django webhook in the same afternoon. --- What You'll Work On - Building and refining screens in Flutter across iOS and Android - Maintaining and extending the Django backend — API endpoints, business logic, database models - Working with Twilio webhooks and TwiML to control call routing behavior - Integrating with VAPI for AI voice assistant configuration and call handling - Fixing real user-reported issues — onboarding flows, form validation, settings UX - Keeping the EC2 deployment stable and shipping updates without breaking production You're a Strong Fit If You - Have shipped a Flutter app before — you know Dart, widget trees, and state management doesn't intimidate you - Have built or maintained a Django backend — models, views, REST APIs, ORM queries - Have worked with at least one telephony or communication API (Twilio, Vonage, Bandwidth) - Are comfortable reading and writing TwiML or similar call flow markup - Can SSH into an EC2 instance, debug a running service, and deploy a fix without hand-holding - Move fast, write clean code, and communicate clearly about what's done and what's blocked --- Nice to Have - Experience with VAPI or other AI voice platforms - Familiarity with prompt engineering or LLM integrations - Prior work on a consumer mobile app with real users --- What We're Not Looking For Someone who needs a fully specc'd ticket for every task. This codebase is real, the bugs are real, and the users are real. You should be able to look at a problem, understand the system, and figure out the fix. --- Stack: Flutter · Dart · Python · Django · Twilio · VAPI · TwiML · AWS EC2 To Apply Send a short note about something you've built — mobile, backend, or both — and why this kind of product interests you. Links to work are more useful than a resume.

description: Hey, I'm Louie from Matrx Media, a real estate media company in Auckland, New Zealand. We started a year and a half ago and have become very popular in our city. Right now I'm shooting and editing every video myself. I edit to a high standard, and value quality, so have been putting off hiring an editor until now. Coming into spring/summer here, I am about to get very busy and need to take some video editing off my plate. I'm looking for a world-class video editor who uses premiere pro/after effects and loves storytelling. Someone I can send raw clips to and get back edits so amazing that my agents don't even realise it's not me. Check out our video editing style here: ---------- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING: - Property listing videos (1-2 min, 4K a7siii footage plus drone) - High-energy reels (1 min) with agents presentation, speed ramps, transitions, custom text, sound design, colour grade - Sold reels + coming soon reels - Personal branding videos for real estate agents WHAT YOU'LL BE SET UP WITH: - Premiere Pro template, LUTs, MOGRTs - Music library, brand end cards, sound design library, Higgsfield access - Agent preferences sheet + reference library of finished videos to match - Clear edit framework and training in our style (MASCOT) MUST-HAVES: - Strong Premiere Pro skills. description: JOB OVERVIEW Are you a friendly, articulate communicator who's comfortable on the phone with US clients? Rex Visual Services, a real estate media company based in Atlanta, Georgia, is hiring a Part-Time Retention & Growth Specialist to make client feedback calls and help us maintain relationships with our real estate agent clients after their shoots. This is a relationship-based role, not high-pressure sales. Position Details: Position: Retention & Growth Specialist — Client Feedback Calls (Path to Cold Calling) Company: Rex Visual Services Pay: $10/hour, guaranteed 4 hours/week, plus performance bonuses (see below) Hours: ~2 hours/day, 2 days/week (e.g. Monday + Thursday or Friday) — light, dedicated part-time schedule Key Responsibilities: As our Retention & Growth Specialist, you'll be the friendly voice checking in with our past clients after their shoots. You'll follow a proven call script, and your work directly affects our online reputation and referral pipeline. This is a client-facing role — you'll be speaking with our actual clients, so professionalism and a warm, clear phone presence matter a great deal. Your responsibilities will include: Making short (typically 3-5 minute) follow-up calls to past clients using our existing call script Asking for online reviews and helping clients through the process if needed Asking whether the client has referred anyone to us, or received a referral from us, and logging the details Tracking monthly totals for reviews collected and referrals logged in our system (Notion — training provided) Following a simple weekly cadence: a primary calling day, with a short catch-up day later in the week for anyone who didn't answer Compensation Structure: Base pay: $10/hour for a guaranteed 4 hours/week (~$ ---------- /month) Referral Bonus: $10 for every referral you log from a client Review Bonus: $2 for every confirmed new Google review you help bring in Realistic total: most months land around $ ---------- /month based on our current referral volume Growth Opportunity: This role starts with feedback calls, but we're hiring with the intention of growing it. We currently have team members earning $300 to $1,700/month with us, and we want our next hire to grow into a bigger role over time. We're looking for someone who is friendly, warm, and comfortable speaking on the phone with clients. The best person for this role is someone who can genuinely relate to our clients, follow a script while still sounding natural, and take pride in every call. People will judge our company by how you sound, so professionalism and clear communication matter. Qualifications: Fluent, clear spoken English and confidence talking with US-based clients Comfortable following a script while still sounding natural and warm Reliable and organized — logging data accurately matters Prior phone-based customer service, cold calling, or appointment-setting experience is a plus Basic comfort with tools like Notion is a plus (training provided) Application Process: To apply for this opportunity, please email your application to ---------- the subject line, include the one word in this posting that best describes the quality we most want you to bring to every call. Please include: A brief introduction on why you'd be a good fit for phone-based client work A short voice recording (30-60 seconds) of you reading this line: "Hi, this is [Name] calling from Rex Visual Services, I wanted to follow up on your recent photo shoot and see how everything turned out!" followed by a quick sentence about yourself in your own words Any relevant experience with phone-based customer service, sales, or cold calling At Rex Visual Services, we help real estate agents shine with premium listing media. title: CURRICULUM TEAM — WRITERS, EDITORS & DIRECTOR: PART TIME / MAY EXPAND
job_title: CURRICULUM TEAM — WRITERS, EDITORS & DIRECTOR: PART TIME / MAY EXPAND
description: Good Curriculum Does Not Write Itself. Position Summary Elorae supports education programs in Korea, including Leaders Academy, where students study English, writing, speech, and competitive debate. The teaching happens live. The curriculum behind it has to be equally strong. We are building a real Curriculum team, not hiring one generic writer. We want people who can write, edit, organize, and improve educational material across several departments. The priority hire is a Curriculum Director who can set standards, review other people's work, allocate projects, and make the entire team better. We are also hiring strong producers who may specialize in one area. Current roles include: • Curriculum Director • Curriculum Writer, English and ESL • Curriculum Writer, Debate • Curriculum Writer, Speech • Copyeditor You do not need to fit only one box. If you are genuinely strong in more than one role, say so. Combined roles are welcome. What This Team Does Our curriculum is used by real teachers and real students. Work may include lesson plans, student handouts, textbooks, debate preparation materials, speech units, writing prompts, teacher guides, activity sheets, assessment material, and revisions to existing content. Writers need to understand audience. A worksheet for a younger English learner cannot read like a senior high debate chapter. A speech lesson should not feel like a debate lesson with different labels. Good curriculum is not just grammatically correct. It has a purpose, a level, a sequence, and a classroom reality. The Curriculum Director role is different. The Director is expected to judge quality, not simply produce pages. You should be able to look at several pieces of work, identify what is wrong, explain the standard, d ---------- what needs revision, and assign work intelligently across people with different strengths. Who This Is For For writing and editing roles, we are interested in people with backgrounds in education, English, ESL, communications, writing, editing, speech, debate, or adjacent fields. Teaching experience is useful because classroom instincts matter. Excellent written English is essential. For the Curriculum Director, we are especially interested in candidates who have already been responsible for other people's academic output: academic heads, curriculum coordinators, department leaders, senior teachers, editors, school administrators, or similar roles. Years of experience alone are not enough. We need judgment. Speech and debate experience is a major advantage for the Debate and Speech seats. Korean ability is useful but not required. A Word About Your Setup This is remote work. You need your own laptop or desktop, a stable connection of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a workspace where you can focus and join video calls when needed. We work on Korea Standard Time and some overlap with KST business hours is required. Hours and Payment These are part-time roles that can expand based on performance and team need. Strong candidates may hold more than one responsibility. Paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour. The initial ramp is intentionally small so both sides can test fit and real output. Longer-term compensation may shift toward output-based pay depending on the role and the work being produced. September Philippines Interviews We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The jobs themselves are remote. Application Process Complete the VA application form: ---------- Choose Curriculum and rank the roles that best fit you. Include your CV. If you have curriculum, writing, editing, teaching, debate, or academic work samples, include a portfolio or Drive link. Strong samples matter more than a polished cover letter. Attentiveness Test Write "Standards" in your subject line so we know you read the full posting. Warning If you use AI to produce generic educational filler and cannot tell whether the result is actually good, this is not the role for you. If you are applying for Director but your experience is only producing your own work, be prepared to explain how you would evaluate, reject, revise, and allocate the work of others. If your written English is weak, the application will not advance.

description: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant Company: 850 Club Credit Position: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant Type: Part-Time Pay: $7.50/hour Hours: Up to 10 hours per week / 40 hours per month Bonus: $50 for each successful hire who remains with the company for at least 30 days How to Apply Please submit: 1. Your current availability Applications that do not follow instructions, will not be considered. About the Role 850 Club Credit is looking for an organized, proactive Recruiter / Hiring Assistant who can help us find, screen, and organize strong candidates for our growing team. Your job is not simply to post job listings. Your job is to help us hire faster by filtering out weak applicants and making sure only qualified candidates reach the final interview stage. title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description: # Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist **Local SEO | Website Optimization | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation** We are a growing home care company with a clear mission: **Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.** We are building for the long term. Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results. We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team. This is a **direct-hire position**. It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time. ## Your Primary Goal Your main responsibility is straightforward: **Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.** Everything else supports that goal. Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us. Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients. Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results. ## What You Will Own ### Website Management & Optimization You will help continuously improve our website by: - Updating and improving website pages and content - Managing WordPress or a similar CMS - Improving site speed and mobile performance - Improving usability and conversion flow - Identifying and correcting technical SEO issues - Fixing broken links, indexing problems, page structure, and other technical issues - Identifying pages that are underperforming and improving them ### Local SEO You will help us improve local search visibility throughout our service areas. Responsibilities include: - Keyword research based on **search intent** - Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone - On-page SEO - Page titles and meta descriptions - Header structure - Internal linking - Content optimization - Local service-area optimization - Monitoring rankings and making adjustments based on performance - Supporting appropriate citations and local directory consistency ### Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization You will: - Build and improve service pages and landing pages - Develop location-specific pages where appropriate - Improve calls-to-action and messaging - Analyze conversion performance - Make changes based on actual results rather than assumptions - Help turn website visitors into qualified inquiries ### Google Business Profile Management You will manage and improve our Google Business Profiles, including: - Profile optimization - Posts and updates - Photos - Service and business information - Review monitoring - Review-response support - Tracking calls, website clicks, and direction requests - Monitoring local map visibility - Identifying opportunities to improve local search performance ### Call-Driven Digital Marketing We operate a local service business. That means **phone calls matter.** You will help us understand which marketing activities actually create qualified conversations. This may include: - Supporting Google Ads and other digital campaigns - Improving ad landing pages - Assisting with call-tracking systems - Tracking where calls and inquiries originate - Reviewing lead quality - Identifying campaigns and keywords that generate good inquiries - Identifying campaigns that waste money - Improving messaging based on actual client conversations and lead quality ## Reporting & Accountability We expect clear, useful weekly reporting. We do not want large reports filled with numbers nobody uses. We want to know: - How many qualified inquiries were generated? - How many phone calls were generated? - Where did those inquiries come from? - What improved? - What declined? - What worked? - What did not work? - What did you change? - What should we do next? Your weekly reporting may include: - Calls generated - Inquiry volume - Website performance - Organic search performance - Google Business Profile activity - Ranking changes - Landing-page performance - Issues discovered - Work completed - Next priorities ## What We Value We are looking for someone who: - Focuses on **results rather than activity** - Understands that traffic without conversion has limited value - Executes without constant supervision - Thinks in systems and repeatable processes - Looks for the root cause of problems - Takes ownership of their work - Pays close attention to details - Communicates clearly and honestly - Is comfortable being measured on real outcomes - Can explain technical issues in understandable language - Continues improving rather than simply maintaining what already exists We especially value someone who is comfortable saying: **“This is not working. Here is why, and here is what I recommend we change.”** We would rather identify a problem early and fix it than receive a polished report explaining poor results later. ## Required Experience You should have hands-on experience with: - WordPress or a similar CMS - Local SEO - On-page SEO - Google Business Profiles - Google Search Console - Google Analytics - Keyword research - Landing-page optimization - SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar - Call tracking or lead tracking Experience working with a **local service business** is strongly preferred. Experience with home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven business is a plus. ## This Role Is NOT For You If This position is probably not a fit if: - Your primary experience is social-media posting - You primarily focus on followers, likes, or impressions - You rely heavily on spammy backlinks or questionable SEO shortcuts - You prefer discussing strategy instead of implementing it - You need constant direction before taking action - You are looking for a temporary project - You are an agency or outsourcing company - You plan to subcontract the work to someone else - You are currently managing several employers or clients and intend to continue doing so ## Full-Time Commitment This is a **full-time, dedicated position**. If hired, this is expected to be your **primary full-time employment**. We are not looking for someone who is simultaneously working multiple full-time jobs or servicing multiple clients during their scheduled working hours with us. We want someone who can give the role their professional attention, become deeply familiar with our organization, and grow with the company over the long term. ## Role Structure - Full-time - Remote / Virtual - Direct hire - Individual applicants only - No agencies - No outsourcing teams - Long-term opportunity - Consistent working schedule - Performance-focused - Opportunity for increased responsibility based on results ## Application Process We pay attention to how candidates follow instructions. ### Step 1 — Initial Application Please provide: 1. A short summary of your relevant experience 2. At least **two examples** of websites you have worked on 3. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed 4. Examples of SEO work that produced actual calls, leads, or inquiries 5. In **five sentences or less**, answer: **How would you increase qualified phone calls for a local home care company?** 6. List the marketing, SEO, analytics, and call-tracking tools you regularly use 7. Confirm the following: **“I am applying as an individual, not as an agency or outsourcing company.”** 8. Also confirm: **“If hired, this will be my primary full-time position, and I will not work another full-time job or service other clients during my scheduled working hours.”** ### Step 2 — Paid Skills Assessment Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short **paid practical assessment**. This is a real-world task designed to evaluate how you think and execute. You may be asked to: - Review a service page - Identify SEO problems - Identify conversion problems - Recommend practical improvements - Rewrite a section of website content - Provide a short action plan We use this assessment to evaluate: - How you analyze problems - How clearly you communicate - Whether you prioritize correctly - Whether you can execute - Whether you focus on outcomes rather than theory **We do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.** ## Final Note We are building a stable, long-term marketing system. We are not interested in hacks, shortcuts, inflated numbers, or activity for the sake of activity. We want someone who can become a trusted part of our team, take responsibility for an important business function, and continuously improve results. If you take ownership, execute consistently, communicate honestly, and focus on generating qualified inquiries, **this role can grow significantly over time.** ### One Final Instruction If you have read this entire job posting, include the word: **GEMINI** in the subject line or title of your application. Applications that do not include **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

description: We are a US-based health insurance technology company. Our platform handles Medicare and ACA enrollment, commission accounting, and agent management for insurance agencies. Real money, real member data, real compliance obTHE ROLE We are hiring our first dedicated engineer. Today the codebase is built and maintained by the founder with AI assistance, and it has grown faster than one person can properly review. We need someone who can read a large codebase critically, tell us what is wrong with it, and fix it. This is not a ticket-taking role. You will have real ownership over architecture decisions and your opinion will shape what we build next. Over time this can grow into leading a small team. OUR STACK Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS) Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, S3, SES, Secrets Manager), Vercel, GitHub Actions Auth: Google Identity Platform, MFA enforced AI: AWS Bedrock, Pinecone (retrieval-augmented assistant) Comms: Telnyx (SMS and voice) Scale: roughly 550 API endpoints, 75+ frontend pages, a Postgres schema with 30+ migrations, and a commission engine that reconciles carrier statements across 17 insurance carriers. WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS - Build out our staging and deployment pipeline so changes are verified before they reach production - Decompose a large monolithic Express file into maintainable route modules, without changing behavior - Raise test coverage from near zero to something we can actually rely on - Strengthen authorization checks across the API surface - Close out the technical controls on our SOC 2 and HIPAA roadmap (AWS configuration, logging, access review, key management) - Tell us honestly what we should be working on that we are not REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years building and maintaining production web applications - Strong Node.js and Express. You should be comfortable in a large, messy, real-world codebase, not just greenfield projects - Strong PostgreSQL. You should be able to read a slow query, explain why it is slow, and fix it. Tell us the largest schema you have worked with - Hands-on AWS. You have deployed and operated services yourself, not just handed off to someone else - TypeScript and React - You write tests. Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent - You have done code review on someone else's work and can explain what you look for - Excellent written English. Much of our communication will be written - Minimum 3 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (that is roughly 9pm to midnight Manila time). This is a hard requirement, please do not apply if you cannot commit to it NICE TO HAVE - Healthcare, insurance, fintech, or any regulated industry experience - SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar compliance work - Experience breaking up a monolith incrementally - Production experience with LLM APIs and retrieval systems - Open source contributions PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF - Your primary experience is WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or Elementor - You do not have a GitHub profile with real, readable code on it - You cannot commit to the overlap hours above - You are looking for short-term or project-based work. We want someone long-termligations. We operate under HIPAA and are working toward SOC 2 Type II. We are small, we ship constantly, and the product is already in daily production use. HOURS Our team works US hours. The ideal candidate matches that: roughly 9pm to 6am Manila time, covering a full US Central business day. description: # Customer Service Representative – Homecare Operations **Registered Nurse Experience Required** **Join our mission to help seniors live longer, healthier, and happier lives at home.** We are looking for a capable, compassionate, and highly organized **Customer Service Representative with prior Registered Nurse experience** to support our Homecare Sales, Client Services, and Caregiver Recruitment teams. title: E-commerce Business Development & Partnerships Specialist — Shopify Sellers & Referrals
job_title: E-commerce Business Development & Partnerships Specialist — Shopify Sellers & Referrals
description: We are a China-based product sourcing and fulfillment company helping ecommerce sellers with their China supply chain needs. We’re looking for a business development and partnerships specialist to help us connect with Shopify store owners and sellers on other ecommerce platforms, primarily in the US and Europe. Our goal is to bring more qualified sellers into paid trials and long-term cooperation with our sourcing and fulfillment team. We are especially interested in candidates who have worked directly with ecommerce sellers and already have professional relationships that could lead to warm introductions. WHO WE WANT TO CONNECT WITH You will develop opportunities through two channels: 1. Direct seller outreach — our main priority Find and connect with Shopify store owners, independent ecommerce brands, and sellers on other platforms who need China-based sourcing or fulfillment support. Suitable prospects may be looking for: - A reliable Chinese supplier or sourcing agent. - An alternative or backup to their existing supplier. - Support with product sourcing, supplier coordination, or quality control. - Dropshipping fulfillment or bulk purchasing. - Solutions to existing sourcing and fulfillment problems. Prioritize sellers with active sales or a clear purchasing plan, products our team can support, and a genuine need for our services. 2. Referrals and channel partnerships Build relationships with dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, course creators, ecommerce agencies, consultants, and community owners whose students or clients may need our services. The purpose of these partnerships is to generate relevant seller introductions and customer opportunities. EXPERIENCE AND RELATIONSHIPS WE VALUE Have you worked with Shopify sellers as a store operator, customer service representative, virtual assistant, account manager, or sourcing coordinator? That experience could be highly relevant to this role. We particularly value candidates who: - Have supported Shopify or other ecommerce sellers with store operations, customer service, order processing, product sourcing, or supplier coordination. - Have communicated directly with store owners or business decision-makers. - Understand common seller problems involving suppliers, orders, shipping, and customer satisfaction. - Maintain professional relationships with sellers who may need China-based sourcing and fulfillment. - Know dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, agencies, or community owners who could introduce suitable sellers. - Can arrange warm introductions with the other person’s permission. You do not need a large network. A few relevant, trusted relationships can be valuable. Candidates without existing connections are also welcome if they can demonstrate strong customer development skills. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES - Research and qualify potential ecommerce customers and referral partners. - Identify and contact relevant owners and decision-makers. - Where appropriate, approach your existing professional network to explore potential introductions. - Send personalized outreach through appropriate channels, including email, LinkedIn, and relevant online communities. - Handle initial replies and follow up consistently. - Understand prospects’ products, sourcing arrangements, order volume, target markets, and supply chain needs. - Arrange qualified conversations and coordinate quotation requests with our China team. - Help interested sellers move toward trial orders and ongoing cooperation. - Develop referral relationships with educators, agencies, and community owners. - Maintain accurate records of contacts, conversations, opportunities, and next steps in a shared spreadsheet or CRM. - Report which approaches generate qualified conversations and customers. Our China team will confirm product feasibility, approve pricing and service commitments, and handle sourcing and fulfillment operations. REQUIREMENTS - Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly in English during business conversations. - Relevant experience in ecommerce support, B2B outreach, lead generation, appointment setting, sales, or partnership development. - Familiarity with Shopify, ecommerce operations, dropshipping, or China supply chains. - Ability to identify customer needs and qualify opportunities—not simply collect contact lists. - Strong organization, consistent follow-up, and accurate recordkeeping. - Ability to work independently and learn our services. - Good judgment when communicating with potential customers. Please do not promise prices, delivery times, guarantees, or services that our team has not approved. HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS We evaluate: - Relevant, qualified seller conversations. - Warm introductions to suitable sellers and referral partners. - Qualified quotation requests and trial-order opportunities. - New paying customers and repeat cooperation. - Accurate records and consistent follow-up. Contact-list size and message volume alone are not measures of success. We will review results alongside our team’s pricing, response times, and delivery performance. SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION - Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week. - Agreed overlap with our China team during business hours, with flexibility for conversations in the target market. - Base pay: USD $500–$800 per month, depending on experience. - Additional performance bonuses and successful customer referral commissions under a written agreement. - Referral qualification, attribution, and payment terms will be agreed before outreach begins. - Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid practical assessment. - Initial paid 30-day engagement, with the opportunity for long-term cooperation. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with SELLER PARTNER and answer these questions: 1. Relevant experience: Have you provided services to Shopify or other ecommerce sellers? Describe your responsibilities and whether you communicated directly with owners or decision-makers. 2. Customer development: Describe one relevant outreach, sales, or referral project. What did you personally do, and what results did you achieve? Anonymized examples are welcome. If you have not done this before, please say so. 3. Existing relationships: Do you currently know sellers, educators, coaches, or agency owners who might be open to an introduction? Describe the relationship, how recently you were in contact, and why our services could be relevant. Do not provide names or private contact details at this stage. 4. Outreach sample: Write a four-sentence message to a Shopify seller who already has a supplier. Use only the company information in this post; do not assume specific prices, delivery times, or guarantees. 5. Availability and expectations: State your weekly availability, expected compensation, and whether your strengths are direct seller outreach, warm introductions, channel partnerships, or a combination. Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph. No live outreach or introductions are required during the application process. We respect your professional relationships. Do not share confidential customer lists, private account information, or materials belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description: Texas-based plaintiff-side personal injury firm seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal. This is a fully remote position for a candidate who can independently manage a case from the moment a lawsuit is filed through trial preparation, with no training period required. What We're Looking For We are hiring specifically for post-filing litigation work — from petition through trial. This is not a pre-suit or intake-focused role, and we are not seeking anyone who needs to be trained on the fundamentals of personal injury litigation. Minimum Qualifications At least 3 years of demonstrated plaintiff-side personal injury litigation experience Working knowledge of litigation from petition through trial Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure and Texas law as it applies to personal injury litigation Direct, hands-on experience with case management software Experience managing a high-volume active caseload of filed litigation matters Duties and Responsibilities Draft original petitions and initiate new lawsuits Draft and file amended petitions Draft discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission Draft responses to discovery requests received from opposing counsel Complete Defendant's Written Discovery Questionnaires (DWQs) Identify appropriate expert witnesses for each case Prepare and file designation of experts Prepare initial disclosures Prepare for and coordinate depositions, including scheduling, exhibit preparation, and logistics with opposing counsel, court reporters, and clients Track and manage all case deadlines Communicate directly with clients, opposing counsel, and insurance adjusters as needed Schedule This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be resourceful and capable of ensuring physical tasks get done even while working remotely — for example, coordinating with in-office staff to have documents printed, organized, or delivered, or arranging third-party legal support services to handle physical trial preparation, exhibit production, or courier needs. The ability to problem-solve and make these things happen without being physically present is essential. Candidates must be available and reachable approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. Some scheduling flexibility is available for the right candidate. International applicants: this schedule is fixed to Central Time (United States), not your local time zone. If you are located in the Philippines, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time falls at approximately 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time, meaning this would be an overnight shift for you. Please confirm you understand this before applying and that you are able and willing to work these hours on your local clock. Compensation Salary is commensurate with experience. Please include your minimum compensation requirement with your application. To Apply Please include the following with your application: Number of years of plaintiff-side litigation experience? Confirmation that you can independently handle litigation work from petition through trial preparation. Your typical caseload volume and whether managed solo or as part of a team? A description of a time you had to ensure a physical task (printing, filing, document delivery, etc.) got completed without being on-site, and how you made it happen? Confirmation that you are able to work 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. If you are applying from outside the United States, please confirm you understand what this means in your local time zone and that you are able and willing to work those hours.
