job_title: Experienced Native-Style Static Ad Strategist for Meta Ads - Retainer, Performance Bonus and Equity Opportunity
description: We are not looking for someone who places a product image beside three generic benefit icons and calls it a Facebook ad. We are looking for someone who understands how to make a static ad feel native to the feed while still selling with clarity and conviction. We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands and are looking for an experienced Native-Style Static Ad Strategist with a strong understanding of direct-response marketing, persuasive copywriting, manual research, and visual communication. This is not an entry-level role. You must already have hands-on experience developing native-style static advertisements for Facebook and Instagram. This is an ongoing position with a fixed retainer, performance bonuses, and significant long-term growth potential. Exceptional performers may eventually have the opportunity to become a Creative Director, lead a brand, or participate in the ownership of one of our brands. WHAT WE MEAN BY NATIVE-STYLE STATIC ADS We are referring to static Meta advertisements that feel natural inside the Facebook or Instagram feed instead of looking like polished corporate advertisements. These may include: * Real customer story and testimonial creatives * Review and comment-based advertisements * Social media post formats * Reddit and forum-inspired formats * Text message and conversation formats * Founder notes and personal stories * Editorial and article-inspired layouts * Comparison and list-style advertisements * Memes and culturally relevant formats * Raw customer or product photography * Product demonstrations communicated in a single image * Other simple and believable formats that make people stop and read We are not referring to media buying on native advertising networks such as Taboola or Outbrain. THE ROLE Your job will be to research, develop, create, and manage new native-style static advertising concepts for Facebook and Instagram. We believe the best static ads are discovered before they are designed. The final image may look simple, but the research, customer insight, hook, angle, copy, format, and visual hierarchy behind it must be exceptional. Approximately 80 percent of this role is research and strategic thinking. The remaining 20 percent is turning that research into clear and compelling static advertisements. Your research may include: * Successful competitor static advertisements * Meta Ad Library research * Viral organic posts and social media content * Reddit posts and personal stories * Customer reviews and comments * Forums and online communities * Advertorials and editorial content * Memes and emerging native content formats * Emotional stories, frustrations, desires, objections, and transformations * Successful video concepts that could be communicated in a single image * Anything else that reveals what genuinely moves a particular audience AI can assist with organizing information and exploring variations, but it cannot replace genuine manual research. We do not need 50 slightly different headlines generated from the same prompt. We need someone who can uncover an original insight and turn it into a static concept strong enough to carry an entire advertising campaign. YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES Each week, you will: 1. Research and present approximately 20 to 25 strong native-style static advertising concepts. These should be genuinely different concepts, not minor headline or layout variations. 2. Clearly explain the following for every concept: * The target customer or avatar * The customer's awareness level * The central problem, desire, objection, or emotion * The relevant product USP or proof point * The proposed advertising angle * The native format you recommend * The proposed hook or central message * The source or inspiration * Why you believe the concept could perform 3. Receive direct feedback on which concepts are approved or rejected. 4. Turn approximately 10 to 15 approved concepts into production-ready static creative batches. 5. Write all necessary copy, including: * On-image copy * Headlines * Subheadlines * Calls to action where appropriate * Supporting Meta headlines and primary text when required 6. Provide visual references, image direction, rough mockups, layout guidance, and clear instructions for our graphic designers. 7. Create deliberate variations that test meaningful elements such as: * Hooks * Customer avatars * USPs * Proof elements * Images * Native formats * Visual hierarchy 8. Follow up with our designers and ensure that all assigned creatives are completed correctly and on time. 9. Review creative performance, identify why certain ads are winning or losing, and develop intelligent iterations based on the data. Our designers can support final production and polishing. However, you must be capable of communicating your ideas visually and creating clear rough mockups in tools such as Canva or Figma. Your responsibility is the research, big idea, angle, copy, native format, visual direction, production brief, iteration strategy, and timely handoff. title: Virtual Assistant / Content Quality Manager – YouTube Stories/Mysteries Channel
job_title: Virtual Assistant / Content Quality Manager – YouTube Stories/Mysteries Channel
description: Virtual Assistant / Content Quality Manager – YouTube Stories/Mysteries Channel We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can grow into the Content Quality Manager of our documentary-style YouTube channel featuring a real, human host. Our content focuses on political and family scandals like the JFK-Lewinsky affair, and famous mysteries such as Jack the Ripper. The channel is still relatively new, but one of our first videos has already surpassed 500,000 views. We have ambitious long-term plans and are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help us build something exceptional. Our mission is to build a high-quality, human-led storytelling channel, with a strong and warm community, in a world increasingly filled with mass-produced and AI-generated content. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help us build that. Your role You will initially join as a Virtual Assistant, learning our channel, workflow, quality standards, and production process. Over time, we want to train you to become the manager who has complete oversight of the production process — from research and scriptwriting to recording, editing, quality control, to even publishing, overseeing future livestreams, etc. You will essentially become the person who always has the overview and makes sure every project moves forward while meeting our quality standards. This responsibility is extremely important. What we're looking for You need to genuinely care about quality and have an exceptional eye for detail. Ideally, you already have experience with content quality control, content production, or managing/overseeing a YouTube channel. You should: • Have an extremely strong eye for detail and immediately notice when something feels wrong • Review research, scripts, edits, and final videos for quality • Understand what makes a great YouTube video and what keeps viewers watching • Understand the importance of a powerful intro and hook • Know that the first 5 seconds, first minute, and first 5 minutes are each crucial for audience retention in different ways • Understand storytelling, pacing, curiosity, and viewer retention • Be extremely strong at fact-checking and verifying information • Make sure names, dates, footage, photographs, claims, quotes, and other details are accurate • Catch mistakes before a video is published • Give clear and actionable feedback to writers, editors, and other team members • You are also open to feedback yourself. You understand no video is perfect, and there will always be improvements. • Keep an overview of deadlines, revisions, and the complete production pipeline • Communicate quickly and proactively • Never settle for "good enough" when something can clearly be improved Accuracy is especially important. These are real stories about real people and historical events. We want every video to be properly researched and fact-checked, and we expect you to take responsibility for identifying errors before they reach the viewer. Compensation & growth This position is designed to grow together with your responsibilities. • Training phase: $40–50 per completed video project. You will learn our workflow and quality standards while I remain closely involved. • Junior Quality Control: $60–75 per project once you can independently review scripts, research, fact-checking, and video edits, with me primarily doing the final check. • Content Quality Manager: $80–120 per project once you can take real ownership of the quality-control process and independently identify and solve problems before projects reach me. • Long-term management role: As your responsibilities grow beyond individual projects and you begin overseeing the broader production process, we can transition to an hourly rate or fixed monthly compensation. A full project can involve approximately 10–15 hours of work, especially during the learning stages. Quality is much more important to us than rushing through a checklist. Our mission YouTube is increasingly filled with mass-produced content, AI-generated voices, and artificial characters. While AI is great and it helps many creators, there is also a very large group of people who long for something different: something completely human. We want to build something different: a high-quality storytelling channel centered around a real host and even multiple hosts in the future, whom viewers can connect with over the long term. We want to create genuinely enjoyable, well-researched stories and gradually build a really big community around the channel. We interact with the viewers. ` We're looking for someone who genuinely cares about that mission and wants to give their true best to help us achieve it. There are many exciting plans for this channel, and for the right person, this can grow into an important long-term management position with many growth options both in responsibility and salary. If you are highly organized, extremely detail-oriented, passionate about YouTube and storytelling, and genuinely care about producing exceptional content, please apply and tell us about your relevant experience.

description: We are not looking for someone who can generate 50 generic AI hooks. We are looking for someone who can find the one idea strong enough to carry an entire ad campaign. We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands and are looking for a Junior Creative Strategist who understands direct-response marketing, persuasive copywriting, and the importance of deep manual research. This is an ongoing position with a fixed retainer, performance bonuses, and significant long-term growth potential. Exceptional performers may eventually have the opportunity to become a Creative Director, lead a brand, or participate in the ownership of one of our brands. THE ROLE Your job will be to research, develop, and manage new advertising concepts for Facebook and Instagram. We believe that approximately 80% of creative strategy is research and 20% is execution. If the underlying concept is strong enough, most of the difficult work has already been done. Your research may include: * Successful competitor advertisements * Viral organic videos * TikTok and Instagram content * Reddit posts and personal stories * Customer reviews and comments * Forums and online communities * Emotional stories, frustrations, desires, and transformations * Anything else that reveals what genuinely moves a particular audience AI can assist with organizing information, but it cannot replace genuine manual research. We need someone willing to do the detailed and sometimes repetitive work required to uncover exceptional ideas. YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES Each week, you will: 1. Research and present approximately 20-25 strong advertising concepts. 2. Clearly explain the following for every concept: * The target customer or avatar * The central problem, desire, or emotion * The relevant product USP * The proposed advertising angle * The source or inspiration * Why you believe the concept could perform 3. Receive feedback on which concepts are approved or rejected. 4. Turn approximately 10-15 approved concepts into production-ready creative batches. 5. Write complete direct-response scripts for the approved concepts. 6. Provide strong hooks, reference clips, context, and clear instructions for our video editors. 7. Follow up with the editors and ensure that all assigned creatives are completed on time. Our editors will handle the actual video production. Your responsibility is the idea, angle, research, copy, script, creative direction, and timely handoff. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR You should: * Have experience writing scripts for Meta/Facebook advertisements * Understand direct-response copywriting * Know how to research audiences deeply * Understand why different customer avatars respond to different USPs * Be able to identify emotional stories and turn them into advertising concepts * Understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, desires, and buying motivations * Be comfortable creating bold, high-conviction marketing angles * Know how to use strong and specific claims when they can be properly supported * Understand that generic and overly safe advertising rarely wins competitive Facebook auctions * Be highly organized and dependable with deadlines * Be able to communicate clearly with video editors * Have excellent written English * Be open to direct feedback and frequent testing You do not need ten years of experience. However, you must demonstrate strong research instincts, persuasive writing ability, and a genuine understanding of direct-response marketing. This is not primarily a graphic design, video editing, or media buying position. It is a research, copywriting, and creative strategy position. COMPENSATION AND GROWTH The compensation structure includes: * A fixed ongoing retainer * An additional bonus based on the advertising spend generated by your creatives * Access to our internal spend-tracking system Our tracking system allows strategists to see exactly how much advertising spend their creatives generate. You will be able to monitor your results and corresponding bonus in real time. For the right person, this can become much more than a standard freelance position. Strong long-term performers may receive: * Increased responsibility * Higher compensation * Creative Director opportunities * The opportunity to lead a brand * Potential equity or partial ownership opportunities under a separate agreement INITIAL TRIAL The position will begin with a paid two-week trial. During the trial, we will primarily evaluate: * The quality and depth of your research * Your ability to identify promising concepts * Your understanding of different avatars and USPs * Your direct-response writing * Your ability to turn research into clear, production-ready scripts * Your reliability and communication If the trial is successful, we would like to continue working together on an ongoing basis. HOW TO APPLY Please begin your proposal with the words “RESEARCH FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post. Please also answer the following questions: 1. What experience do you have with direct-response advertising and Meta ad scripts? 2. Please share examples of scripts, concepts, or advertisements you have worked on. Include results where possible. 3. How do you normally research new advertising concepts? 4. Tell us about one advertising concept you discovered through manual research and explain why you believed it could work. 5. How do you determine which USP to use for a specific customer avatar? 6. What is your availability, and what fixed monthly retainer would you expect? We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to become an exceptional creative strategist, not someone looking to complete only the minimum number of assigned tasks.

title: Full-Time Meta Media Buyer for E-Commerce | Retainer + Performance Bonus
job_title: Full-Time Meta Media Buyer for E-Commerce | Retainer + Performance Bonus
description: We do not need a media buyer who hides behind complicated campaign structures. We need someone who can look at the numbers, understand exactly what is happening, and make the correct decision quickly. We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands across multiple niches. We are looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer to take full-time responsibility for the performance and scaling of our advertising accounts. This is a long-term position for an individual, not an agency. It should be your primary full-time role rather than one of many small client accounts. HOW OUR SYSTEM WORKS We use a straightforward campaign structure: * ABO campaigns for testing * CBO campaigns for scaling * Automated creative launches * Clear KPI targets and decision-making rules * Approximately 100 new creatives tested across our brands each week Our infrastructure and launch systems are already built. Your value will come from reading the data, monitoring the accounts, identifying problems, making fast decisions, and scaling spend while maintaining the required KPIs. We are not looking for someone who constantly introduces unnecessary campaign structures. We want someone who understands that excellent media buying comes down to disciplined execution, accurate data interpretation, and consistent account management. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You will: * Monitor all Meta advertising accounts daily * Oversee multiple brands across different e-commerce niches * Make sure automated launches run correctly * Identify delivery, tracking, spending, or campaign issues quickly * Evaluate new creatives inside our ABO testing structure * Move proven winners into CBO scaling campaigns * Increase or decrease budgets according to defined KPI targets * Scale winning campaigns while protecting overall profitability * Stop losing campaigns before they waste unnecessary budget * Maintain a clear overview of performance across all brands * Track daily and weekly results * Communicate important changes, problems, and opportunities clearly * Provide feedback about which creatives, angles, and audiences are performing * Handle a high volume of approximately 100 new creatives per week * Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy The role is heavily focused on monitoring, analysis, decision-making, and execution. You will not need to spend your day manually building every campaign because our launch process is already automated. WHAT YOU MUST UNDERSTAND You must be comfortable working with metrics such as: * CPA * ROAS * Break-even ROAS * MER * CPM * CTR * CPC * Conversion rate * Average order value * Daily spend * Budget allocation * Creative-level performance * Account-level profitability You should understand the difference between short-term fluctuations and meaningful performance changes. You must also know when to give a campaign more time, when to reduce spend, when to stop it, and when to scale aggressively. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You should: * Have proven experience managing Meta/Facebook advertising for e-commerce brands * Have strong experience with both ABO testing and CBO scaling * Be extremely comfortable with numbers * Make decisions based on KPIs rather than emotions or guesses * Be able to work across several advertising accounts without losing oversight * Be a fast and disciplined executor * Enjoy spending time inside Ads Manager, dashboards, and spreadsheets * Be highly focused, ambitious, and results-driven * Take ownership instead of waiting to be told about every small problem * Be able to identify issues before they become expensive * Be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment * Be available for consistent daily account monitoring * Be comfortable performing light weekend checks when necessary * Communicate clearly and reliably * Have experience using AI to improve analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency AI experience is valuable, but you must still be capable of interpreting the numbers and making decisions independently. This role is best suited to someone who genuinely enjoys working. You should enjoy seeing campaigns improve, creatives begin spending, and brands scale as a result of your decisions. If you prefer slow environments, limited responsibility, or managing many unrelated clients at once, this will probably not be the right position. COMPENSATION The compensation structure includes: * A fixed ongoing retainer * A tiered performance bonus based on advertising spend achieved while maintaining the agreed KPIs * Increased compensation as responsibility and results grow The better our brands scale within the required performance targets, the more you can earn. You will have the opportunity to work with a variety of products and markets, see new creatives tested at a high volume, and play an important role in rapidly scaling multiple e-commerce brands. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT You will not be joining a slow corporate team or working on one account with a small number of monthly tests. You will be part of a dynamic e-commerce team that: * Launches and tests approximately 100 new creatives per week * Operates multiple brands across different niches * Makes decisions quickly * Rewards measurable results * Uses automation to remove unnecessary manual work * Gives strong performers significant responsibility * Provides the opportunity to scale alongside the company We are looking for someone who wants to become a key long-term part of the team. HOW TO APPLY Please begin your proposal with the words “NUMBERS FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post. Please also answer the following questions: 1. How many years of Meta media-buying experience do you have? 2. What types of e-commerce brands have you worked with? 3. What level of monthly advertising spend have you personally managed? 4. Explain how you normally use ABO campaigns for testing and CBO campaigns for scaling. 5. Tell us about a campaign you successfully scaled while maintaining its required KPIs. 6. Which numbers do you check first when evaluating a newly launched creative? 7. How do you determine whether a weak result is temporary volatility or a real performance problem? 8. How have you used AI to improve your media-buying workflow? 9. Are you available for a full-time, long-term position? 10. What fixed monthly retainer would you expect? We are looking for someone who loves numbers, moves quickly, takes ownership, and finds genuine satisfaction in seeing advertising accounts and brands scale.

job_title: CapCut only editor for Instagram Reels - Soft/warm AI educational video
description: Hi I'm Cindy! I run an AI education brand with a 200k+ audience across two Instagram accounts. My reels teach people how to actually use Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and AI builds. I'm hiring editors to take a finished cut and turn it into the finished video. My style is a cute + scrapbook style and I explain AI concepts and builds. Role description You get the cut with the bad takes and pauses already removed. I also provide my editors an Editing Guide which includes where to grab screenshots/ screen recordings, so you're never working on a blank page. You'll also have the support of my Senior Editors, who can guide you to align closely with my style. Here's the role: - Understand the concept being taught or refer to the Editing Guide for more inspiration. - Source and build the screen recordings. If I'm talking about a tool, the viewer needs to see it in action. You capture or assemble those and align them to the exact words they belong to. - Sound design. Every visual reveal gets a sound cue: a pop, a click, a page turn, a soft ding. There is no music. My voice plus sound effects carry the whole video. - Good pacing. The short version: I explain the idea out loud, and you build everything the viewer needs to see to understand it. Hard requirements - CapCut proficiency. - Comfortable capturing and editing screen recordings - You use AI tools yourself. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be generating images and diagrams with them already. - Strong eye for short-form pacing on Instagram - Warm, cute, arts-and-crafts taste. Never corporate, never tech-bro. - Fluent English, good enough to follow a technical explanation and know what it means - Turnaround of 1 to 2 days per reel Nice to have - You already use Claude or ChatGPT day to day - Experience editing for AI, tech or educational creators - Familiar with current Instagram hook formats and retention edits Hard nos Hard whip-pans, glitch or VHS effects, trending transition packs, generic tech stock footage, corporate imagery, harsh blues and neon. The editing support you get - Editing Guide so you know which assets to grab or record. - CapCut Pro - Reference videos for every video you edit so you have a place to grab inspiration - The cut of each reel, already trimmed - Clear, fast feedback so you can lock the style within a few reels - Support from our Senior Editors PAY - USD $35 per reel, paid through Upwork as a milestone per reel. - Rate increases as you align closer to my style. - Steady, consistent volume. We publish constantly and there is always more work. How to apply Answer the screening questions, and attach 2 to 3 short-form samples you personally edited (CapCut preferred). Position Details **Position:** Administrative Assistant **Location:** Duncanville, Texas **Schedule:** Monday–Thursday, **9:00 AM–2:00 PM** **Hours:** Approximately **20 hours per week** **Job Type:** Part-Time **Pay:** $4.50 per hour ## Key Responsibilities * Answer and direct incoming phone calls * Respond to emails, texts, and general student inquiries * Perform accurate and timely data entry * Maintain and update student records and school databases * Assist with student enrollment and onboarding paperwork * Review student files for missing documentation and follow up with students * Scan, upload, file, and organize documents * Prepare letters, forms, reports, rosters, and other school documents * Schedule appointments and maintain calendars * Assist prospective students with basic program and enrollment information * Follow up with prospective and current students by phone, email, and text * Track student attendance, documentation, and required paperwork * Assist instructors and management with daily clerical needs * Help maintain an organized and professional front office * Assist with orientations, graduations, workshops, and school events * Perform other administrative and clerical duties as assigned ## Qualifications * High school diploma or GED required * Previous administrative, receptionist, clerical, school, or healthcare office experience preferred * Strong computer and data-entry skills * Excellent telephone and email communication skills * Strong organizational and time-management skills * Ability to multitask and prioritize assignments * Dependable, punctual, and professional * Ability to maintain confidentiality of student and business information * Comfortable learning new computer programs and student-management systems * Microsoft Office and Google Workspace experience preferred * Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus ## Who We Need We are looking for someone who is **self-motivated and takes initiative**. Because we are a growing school, this position requires someone who can wear multiple hats, recognize what needs to be done, and complete assignments without needing constant supervision. The ideal candidate is friendly and professional with students but also understands the importance of **accuracy, deadlines, organization, confidentiality, and follow-through**. ## About Absolute Allied Health Academy Absolute Allied Health Academy is a career school dedicated to preparing students for careers in the healthcare industry through quality education, hands-on training, certification preparation, and career-focused support. ### To Apply Please submit your **resume** along with a brief introduction explaining your administrative or clerical experience and why you would be a good fit for Absolute Allied Health Academy.

title: Tiktok Editor

You’ll take raw footage and turn it into polished, conversion-focused videos that include background music, captions, text overlays, and the correct product links. Key Responsibilities Edit TikTok Shop product videos from the footage we provide Add appropriate background music that fits the product and vibe Create and add captions (using the exact captions we supply) Add clean, well-timed text overlays Ensure the correct product link is attached for each video (TikTok Shop / product tagging) Post the finished videos according to our schedule and guidelines Maintain consistent branding, pacing, and quality across all videos Requirements Proven experience editing short-form video (TikTok, Reels, or similar) Strong CapCut (preferred) or equivalent mobile/desktop editing skills Experience with TikTok Shop or product-link videos is a big plus Ability to follow detailed instructions precisely (especially captions and product links) Good English communication and responsiveness Reliable internet connection and ability to meet daily/weekly turnaround times Portfolio of previous TikTok-style or product videos required Nice to Have Experience managing or posting content directly on TikTok accounts Understanding of TikTok Shop best practices (hooks, pacing, CTAs) Familiarity with trending audio and text styles that convert What We Offer Steady stream of videos Clear guidelines and feedback so you can work efficiently Opportunity for ongoing work based on performance How to Apply Please send: A short introduction about your relevant experience Links to 2–3 examples of TikTok-style or product videos you’ve edited Your typical turnaround time for a single video We’re looking to start ASAP with the right person. Only applicants who include portfolio links will be considered.

Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your edits will directly influence sales and brand growth. ???? Many team members book calls with founders of major ecommerce brands and industry experts through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co. ?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore together, and actually get to know each other. ? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. ???????????????????? ???????? The Skinnify Story Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness. ???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step. ???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone - even the busiest and least motivated. ???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable. ? Quality – Our products are built to last - high-quality, durable, and reliable. ???????????????????? title: Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time
job_title: Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time
description: Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time, Growth Opportunity We are a small but growing U.S.-based creative brand looking for a smart, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant to join our team. This role will work directly with the Founder and requires a high level of organization, discretion, accountability, and follow-through. You will help the Founder stay organized, keep priorities moving, and ensure that important administrative, financial, client, and creative tasks do not fall through the cracks. This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role. We are looking for someone multi-talented, resourceful, and comfortable wearing different hats in a growing business. One day you may be following up on an invoice or organizing QuickBooks records, and the next you may be scheduling social media content, updating a Canva graphic, or helping coordinate a client project. The position will begin part-time, with the opportunity to gradually transition into a full-time role as the business grows and responsibilities increase. What You’ll Be Doing Your responsibilities will include: - Working directly with the Founder to manage priorities, schedules, reminders, and follow-ups - Helping maintain strong organization across the business and proactively identifying items requiring attention - Providing administrative and executive support - Assisting with client communication and tracking outstanding items - Using QuickBooks Online for basic bookkeeping, invoice management, expense categorization, and payment tracking - Organizing business documents, receipts, invoices, and records - Helping manage and schedule content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other platforms - Writing and proofreading captions and basic marketing content - Using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools for basic content editing - Organizing photos, videos, and other digital assets - Assisting with research and other operational tasks - Following through on assigned tasks without requiring constant reminders Who We’re Looking For You may be a great fit if you are: - Exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple priorities at once - Able to anticipate needs rather than waiting to be told what to do - Proficient in QuickBooks Online - Comfortable managing social media content - Familiar with Canva, CapCut, or similar basic editing tools - Tech-savvy and able to learn new systems quickly - Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking initiative - Dependable with strong attention to detail - Professional, personable, and relatable - Comfortable working independently in a remote environment - Experienced working with U.S. or other international brands or clients English Requirement Mastery-level written and spoken English is required. You will communicate directly with the Founder, team members, and occasionally clients. You should be able to communicate naturally, professionally, and confidently in English without relying heavily on AI for routine business communication. Hours & Growth This role will initially be part-time. We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with the company rather than simply taking on another short-term freelance project. As the company grows and you demonstrate your capabilities, the position is expected to expand in hours, responsibilities, and compensation, with the potential to become full-time. How to Apply Please send us: 1. A brief introduction about yourself and why you believe you would be a good fit for this role. 2. Your experience supporting a founder, executive, or small-business owner. 3. Your experience using QuickBooks Online. 4. Your experience managing social media for a business or brand. 5. The editing/design tools you are comfortable using. 6. Your experience working with U.S. or international clients/brands. 7. Your current availability and preferred working hours. 8. Your expected hourly rate. 9. Links or examples of social media accounts, graphics, videos, or other relevant work you have helped manage. Important: At the beginning of your application, include the words “Creative EA” so we know you read the entire job description. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, take ownership of their work, and become a trusted part of the business.

job_title: MARKETING TEAM: DESIGN, MEDIA, SOCIAL, SEO & WEB (PART TIME / MAY EXPAND)
description: Good Work Should Be Impossible to Miss. Elorae works with education programs mainly in Korea that already have strong students, strong events, strong teaching, and a lot worth showing. The problem is not a lack of material. The problem is turning that material into a consistent public presence that looks good, sounds right, reaches people, and stays current. We are building a Marketing team rather than hiring isolated freelancers who never talk to each other. The team can include a Director plus specialists. Some candidates may cover more than one seat if the work is genuinely strong. Current roles include: • Marketing Director • Graphic Designer • A/V Editor • SEO Specialist • Social Media Manager • Website Manager What This Team Does Graphic Design: event graphics, social posts, promotional materials, thumbnails, handouts, branded assets, and visual cleanup across active programs. A/V Editing: short-form video, event highlights, student/performance clips, promotional edits, reels, and other media that can go from raw footage to publishable content without drama. Social Media: planning, scheduling, posting, captions, community engagement, platform management, and turning a pile of possible content into a consistent publishing rhythm. SEO: improving discoverability, page structure, metadata, search performance, content targeting, and finding practical opportunities rather than producing reports nobody uses. Website Management: keeping sites clean, current, functional, and reliable. Content updates, structural improvements, SEO implementation, testing, and maintenance all matter. Vibe coding is fine if the output is tested and stable. Marketing Director: d ---------- what deserves attention, coordinating the specialists, maintaining standards, reading results, and making sure design, social, web, SEO, and media actually reinforce one another. Who This Is For We want people who have done real work for real clients, employers, organizations, publications, channels, or projects. Your portfolio should make your case for you. For visual and media roles, Canva can be part of your workflow but it should not be the limit of your ability. Adobe tools, Figma, professional editing software, motion graphics, or equivalent skills are advantages where relevant. For Social Media, we care about judgment and results, not simply whether you personally use Instagram or TikTok. Show us accounts you managed, content you produced, growth you influenced, or campaigns you helped run. For Website/SEO, we care about live work, reliability, testing, and whether you understand what happens after something is published. A broken production site is not a learning exercise. For Marketing Director, show that you can prioritize and coordinate other people's output, not just make your own. A Word About Your Setup This is remote work. You need your own laptop or desktop, a stable connection of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a workspace suitable for focused work and video calls. We operate on Korea Standard Time and some KST overlap is required. Hours and Payment These are part-time roles that can expand based on performance and team need. A strong person who can genuinely cover two adjacent seats may be more valuable than two mediocre specialists. Paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour. Longer-term compensation may shift toward output-based pay depending on role and deliverables. Website reliability work may be structured differently because availability matters as much as individual outputs. September Philippines Interviews We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The jobs themselves are remote. Application Process Complete the VA application form: ---------- Choose Marketing and rank the roles that best fit you. Include your CV and portfolio/work samples. For Design, A/V, Social Media, SEO, and Web candidates, an application without evidence of actual work is unlikely to advance. Attentiveness Test Write "Signal" in your subject line so we know you read the full posting. Warning If your portfolio is mostly templates with no evidence that you made decisions yourself, do not expect it to carry the application. If you need to be chased to post, update, test, or finish work, this team will not be a good fit. If something breaks and your first instinct is an excuse rather than a fix, do not apply for Website Manager.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
job_title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines Location: Philippines – 100% Remote Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor Service Days: Monday to Friday Reports To: Australian Client Manager Client Contact: No direct client communication required About the Role We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients. This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback. You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities. This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment. Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations · Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients. · Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations. · Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise. · Process accounts payable and accounts receivable. · Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments. · Review aged receivables and aged payables. · Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments. · Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts. · Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules. · Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions. Account Code and GST Code Review This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work. You will be required to: · Review and correct account codes. · Review and correct GST tax codes. · Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes. · Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants. · Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions. · Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications. · Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts. · Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager. · Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required. Australian Payroll · Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll. · Set up and maintain employee payroll records. · Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements. · Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments. · Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation. · Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding. · Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation. · Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts. · Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts. · Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements. BAS, IAS and Compliance Support · Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review. · Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts. · Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods. · Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger. · Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments. · Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations. · Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports. · Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents. · Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly. Month-End and Year-End · Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files. · Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts. · Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities. · Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals. · Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off. · Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable. · Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules. · Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation. Financial Reporting · Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets. · Prepare cash flow and management reports where required. · Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts. · Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors. · Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager. Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage. Relevant experience may include: · Individual and sole trader tax returns. · Company tax returns. · Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers. · Partnership tax returns. · Rental property schedules. · Depreciation and capital allowance schedules. · Tax reconciliation workpapers. · Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL. Essential Experience and Skills Applicants must have: · At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience. · Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients. · Advanced practical experience using Xero. · Strong practical experience using MYOB. · Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online. · Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers. · Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding. · Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes. · Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience. · Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills. · Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers. · Excellent written and spoken English. · Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. · The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines. · High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct. · Ability to use AI tools Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement. Qualifications The following qualifications are highly regarded: · Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce. · Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping. · CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies. · Xero Advisor Certification. · MYOB or QuickBooks certification. Software You must be confident using: · Xero · MYOB · QuickBooks Online Independent Contractor Arrangement This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position. The contractor will: · Provide services remotely from the Philippines. · Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements. · Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations. · Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice. The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours. The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met. Timesheets and Work Records The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording: · Date. · Client or entity. · Task performed. · Time spent. · Work completed. · Outstanding issues and next steps. Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records. Remote Work Requirements Applicants must have: · A reliable computer or laptop. · Stable high-speed internet. · Backup internet. · A quiet and secure home office. · A suitable headset for online meetings. · The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems. · A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security. How to Apply Please submit: · Your current resume. · A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience. · Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience. · Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience. · Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared. · Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos. · Your earliest available commencement date. · Confirmation of your internet. · Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor. Full-time only, and you quit your current job cleanly. * No experience with AI UGC/AI ANIMATIONS/AI SONGS (Fal.ai / Suno.ai / etc....) -> What We're looking for Editors who can THINK. Take what the script says and bring it to life. Animation, transitions, sound design, a cross-section, whatever makes the idea land. Accent doesn't matter. Articulating your thinking does. -> How to apply Put your price in the first line of your application. Then send 3 things. If one is missing, we won't review it. 1. A personalized 1-minute Loom: you, your experience, the brands you've worked with, and what you genuinely crush. 2. A link to YOUR portfolio. If we find ads in it that aren't yours, you're out. 3. Your best ad with the numbers behind it (spend, ROAS or CPA, how long it ran), plus one paragraph on why your price is justified. -> How hiring works 1. A 15-minute call. 2. A paid test brief: a real VSL from our queue. 3. Onboarding. We move fast for the right person. TLDR: We want talent, but hungry talent. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing relationships with TikTok influencers to drive brand awareness, engagement, and ultimately sales in the local market. Key Responsibilities: 1. KOL Strategy Development: - Develop and implement a comprehensive TikTok KOL influencer strategy aligned with brand objectives, market trends, and consumer insights in Vietnam. - Create campaigns that drive engagement, brand awareness, and conversion, with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes. 2. KOL Research and Identification: - Identify and establish relationships with top-tier and micro-influencers in Vietnam who align with the brand’s values, target audience, and goals. - Stay up-to-date with TikTok trends and emerging influencers to ensure the brand is always at the forefront of the platform. 3. Campaign Execution & Management: - Oversee end-to-end influencer campaign execution, from briefing and content creation to final delivery and performance analysis. - Ensure influencers’ content aligns with brand guidelines, voice, and overall marketing strategy. 4. Collaboration and Negotiation: - Negotiate contracts, terms, and compensation with influencers and influencer agencies to ensure mutually beneficial partnerships. - Collaborate with internal teams (creative, PR, and marketing) to ensure influencer content is integrated seamlessly into the overall marketing strategy. 5. Performance Tracking and Reporting: - Monitor the performance of KOL campaigns on TikTok, track key metrics (engagement, reach, conversions), and optimize strategies accordingly. - Provide regular reports and insights to management on campaign effectiveness, ROI, and influencer impact. 6. Community Building: - Build and nurture long-term relationships with influencers to foster loyalty and repeat collaborations. - Engage in community management by interacting with influencers’ audiences and ensuring positive brand sentiment. 7. Market and Competitor Insights: - Monitor competitors' influencer strategies on TikTok and analyze trends in influencer marketing within Philippine’s digital landscape. - Use data and insights to continuously improve and adapt the influencer strategy. Qualifications: - Proven experience in influencer marketing or KOL management, ideally in the TikTok ecosystem, preferably within Philippines. - Strong understanding of TikTok trends, features, and best practices. - Excellent negotiation and communication skills. - Creative mindset with an ability to think outside the box to create viral content. - Fluent in English (both written and spoken). - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Preferred: - Experience working with a brand in the lifestyle, fashion, or e-commerce industry. - Existing network of TikTok influencers in Philippines.

Work schedules will generally fall within one of the following shifts: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM CT The specific schedule will be determined based on company needs and discussed during the hiring process. Because this position includes answering business calls, communicating with clients, scheduling appointments, and handling time-sensitive matters, applicants must be able to reliably and consistently work their assigned Central Time schedule. Computer & Workstation Requirements Because this position involves working with multiple programs, documents, websites, emails, appraisal software, and other systems at the same time, you must already have an appropriate workstation. You must have: A reliable computer capable of handling your daily workload At least two computer monitors/screens that can be used together as one workstation Reliable high-speed internet A working microphone and audio setup for calls and meetings A dependable backup plan for internet or power outages A desktop computer plus a completely separate laptop that cannot function as a second connected display does NOT meet the two-screen requirement. You must be able to work across at least two screens simultaneously from the same workstation. Please do not apply if you do not currently meet this requirement. We Want Someone Who Contributes We do not want someone who does something a certain way simply because “that’s how it has always been done.” If you notice a better, faster, more organized, or more efficient way to do something, we want you to tell us. We want someone who: Takes ownership of assignments from beginning to completion Follows up without being asked Notices when something still needs attention Thinks ahead Identifies problems and suggests solutions Brings new ideas to the company Researches better ways of doing things Is comfortable respectfully recommending changes Wants to help the company grow, not simply complete tasks If you are given responsibility for something, we should not have to continuously remind you that it still needs to be completed. We want someone who develops their own system for keeping track of responsibilities, deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items. AI & Technology You do not need to be an AI expert. However, you must be comfortable learning new technology and figuring things out independently. We may ask you to research ChatGPT, AI tools, automation, websites, marketing systems, software, or other technology that could help our business. We want someone who can research it, learn it, test it, help implement it, and then come back and clearly teach us how to use it. If you encounter something you do not know how to do, your first response should not always be, “I don't know how.” We value people who are willing to research, troubleshoot, learn, and attempt to find a solution. If you are carefully reading this job posting, use the exact subject line “Michael Jackson Is Dancing” when submitting your application. You Should Be Highly organized and detail-oriented Reliable and consistent Strong in written and spoken English Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients by phone Professional and confident Able to work independently A strong problem solver Comfortable learning new technology Able to follow instructions carefully Proactive and willing to take initiative Comfortable receiving feedback Interested in a long-term position and growing with one company Able to consistently work during your assigned U.S. Central Time schedule Able to manage multiple responsibilities and follow-ups without constant supervision Experience with customer service, executive assistance, real estate, mortgage, scheduling, ChatGPT, websites, marketing, CRM systems, or automation is a plus. Appraisal experience is a plus but is NOT required. Pay & Growth Starting pay is $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. We plan to conduct a performance review after approximately 90 days. Strong performance, increased independence, and greater responsibility can lead to increased compensation and advancement. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company over the long term. How to Apply Please answer each of the following questions: Briefly introduce yourself and describe your work experience. Describe your experience answering phones and communicating with clients. Tell us about your experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools. Limited experience is okay. Give one example of something you did not know how to do but successfully researched and learned on your own. Tell us about a time you noticed something at work that could be done better. What did you recommend or change? If you were assigned something that required follow-up several days later, how would you make sure it was completed without your manager reminding you? Describe your primary computer and workstation setup. Confirm that you currently have at least two monitors/screens that can be used simultaneously as part of the same workstation. Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for internet or power outages. Which of the following Central Time schedules can you consistently work: 8 AM–5 PM, 9 AM–6 PM, or 10 AM–7 PM? Please list all that apply. What hourly rate are you requesting between $5 and $7 USD/hour, and why? Why are you interested in a long-term position? Voice Recording Required Along with your written application, please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your work experience. This position requires regular communication with U.S.-based clients by phone, so the voice recording will help us evaluate spoken English, communication style, professionalism, clarity, and comfort speaking. Applications submitted without the requested voice recording may not receive further consideration. title: AI & Automation Assistant + Dev
description: We're Sequoya. We build AI agent teams for businesses, and we are growing fast! We have taken on a lot of new clients recently and we need two more people. On pay, up front so you are not guessing. $1,000 AUD a month is the starting point. It is negotiable depending on experience. More importantly, salary grows in proportion to up-skilling: get good quickly and you will be earning more quickly. We are hiring for two different roles in this one listing. Read both. Apply once, and tell us which one you think you are. We are hiring people to grow into these seats, not finished articles. You do not need to have done the exact job before. What matters is that you are technical, hungry, and good at working things out. We will teach you the rest, you will be mentored closely by our founder, and you will get your own AI agent to help you build, plan and get things done. Role 1: Delivery Lead You are the person who makes sure client builds keep moving. Right now our founder drives every build personally. That does not scale, and that is why this role exists. You will not be thrown in the deep end. You start in a delivery admin and project management seat, working closely with our founder and learning how we do things. We do want you to pick it up quickly, because the point is that you grow into the full role. Where you are heading: - Own the build schedule. Know what is due, what is blocked, and on what. - Make sure everything a build needs is ready before it starts, so nobody is waiting around on day one. - Keep the founder's list clear. Put the things on it that genuinely need him, and handle the rest. - Own our build pages: the documents that say what a build is and what has to happen in it. - In time, run builds end to end yourself. You start on an internal project, not on client work. Your first stretch is on our own systems, so you learn how the business actually works and how we deliver before you go anywhere near a client. You are a fit if you are organised in a way other people can rely on, you write clearly, you are comfortable around technical things without needing to be a developer, and you chase things down without being asked twice. Role 2: Junior Engineer We are hiring this one junior on purpose, and you will not be turned loose on client builds. You will stand up systems in our own environments, working from templates we have already proven. Moving anything into a client's system is handled by our founder. Your job is to build the thing properly in a safe space, and to get better fast. What you'll do: - Build and configure agent systems: automations, integrations, agent workflows. - Connect things up. APIs, webhooks, and the tools our clients run on. - Troubleshoot when something is not behaving, and keep it running. - Document what you built so the next person is not guessing. You are a fit if you have built real things, you can learn a tool you have never seen before without giving up on it, and you care whether what you shipped actually works. About us, and how we work Tight team, no bureaucracy, a lot of trust. We work with AI agents every day, not as a gimmick but as how the work gets done, and you will be given your own. We move fast and we care a lot about being accurate, because our clients pay real money and they can see everything we do. You will be working closely with the founder from day one, and the plan is that you keep growing into more. How to apply Send us a short video. Under 10 minutes. We would rather hear five good minutes than twenty-five. Tell us: 1. Which of the two roles you think you fit better, and why. 2. Something you have built, and show it to us if you can. 3. How you work out a tool or a problem you have never seen before. 4. Why you are applying for this. Don't be shy, we are a friendly group and we read every one. Applications without a video will not be considered. And please reply quickly when we get in touch, because we move fast and so should you.
