title: Executive & Operations Assistant to Founder
description: Executive & Operations Assistant to Founder Remote – Philippines | Part-Time Initially | Long-Term Opportunity About Northwest Floors Northwest Floors is an established flooring business based in Cheshire, UK. We supply and install LVT, carpets, laminate, engineered wood and other flooring products for residential and commercial customers. We are a growing business with a showroom, fitting teams, suppliers and a busy schedule of installations. I’m the owner of the business and I’m looking for an exceptional Executive & Operations Assistant who can become my right-hand person. This is much more than a traditional Virtual Assistant position. I’m looking for somebody who can gradually help me run and coordinate the day-to-day operation of the business, while also supporting me personally as the owner. My goal is to spend more of my time on sales, customers, relationships, marketing and growing Northwest Floors — and less time chasing people, coordinating jobs, answering routine emails, checking orders and remembering hundreds of small things. Your job will be to help make that happen. ⸻ The Person I’m Looking For The most important qualities I’m looking for are: Ownership, initiative, organisation and communication. I don’t want somebody who waits all day to be given tasks. I want somebody who notices things. If a fitter hasn’t confirmed tomorrow’s job, you notice. If a supplier hasn’t confirmed a delivery, you chase it. If a customer is waiting for an update, you make sure they receive one. If someone says they’ll send something tomorrow, you remember tomorrow so I don’t have to. If you spot something that could become a problem next week, you raise it before it becomes a problem. Ultimately, I want somebody who starts to think: “What can I take care of so Alex doesn’t need to?” ⸻ Your Responsibilities The position will develop as you learn the business and gain my trust. Initially, your responsibilities will include: Executive Assistance * Managing and organising my email inbox * Drafting and responding to emails on my behalf * Identifying emails that genuinely require my attention * Managing my business and personal calendar * Organising appointments and meetings * Helping protect my time and avoid unnecessary interruptions * Turning my WhatsApp messages and voice notes into organised tasks * Keeping track of things I’ve said I’ll do * Chasing people on my behalf * Helping with occasional personal administration, appointments, bookings and research * Producing concise daily updates so I know what genuinely needs my attention The objective is for you to gradually become an external brain for me, making sure things don’t get forgotten. ⸻ Customer Communication You will become an important point of contact for our customers. This will include: * Answering routine customer emails * Communicating with customers through email, telephone and WhatsApp * Confirming appointments and installation dates * Keeping customers informed about their upcoming flooring installation * Informing customers of fitter arrival times * Following up outstanding quotations * Chasing deposits where appropriate * Gathering information required before installations * Helping resolve routine questions * Following up after installations * Coordinating snagging or outstanding work * Helping ensure final balances are collected You must be confident communicating in English and comfortable speaking directly with UK customers. Customer service is extremely important to us, so communication should always be professional, friendly and proactive. ⸻ Managing Flooring Projects A major part of this position will eventually be taking ownership of projects after the sale has been made and the customer has paid their deposit. I enjoy meeting customers, helping them choose their flooring and making the sale. What I want to move away from is having to personally manage every detail that happens afterwards. Once a project is handed over, you will help coordinate the journey through to completion. This will include: * Checking the job information is complete * Confirming fitting dates * Liaising with fitters * Liaising with Josh in our showroom * Checking materials have been ordered * Confirming supplier deliveries * Making sure materials have arrived before they’re required * Checking preparation requirements * Ensuring fitters have the information they need * Keeping the customer informed * Coordinating access and other trades where required * Monitoring jobs while they are taking place * Recording changes or additional work * Collecting completion information * Collecting photographs from our fitters for our records and social media * Coordinating snagging or return visits * Making sure completed jobs are invoiced * Following up outstanding balances I don’t expect you to understand all of this immediately. We will teach you. Over time, however, I want you to understand our processes well enough to take genuine ownership of them. ⸻ Working With Our Team & Fitters You’ll act as an important link between me, Josh, our fitters, customers and suppliers. Part of your job is making sure information gets to the right person and that agreed actions actually happen. For example, if Josh needs to order flooring for an upcoming installation, you may not necessarily place that particular order yourself. However, you may be responsible for making sure it has been ordered, checking the supplier has acknowledged it and confirming it will arrive in time. The same applies to our fitters. You will help confirm their schedules, make sure they have job information and follow up when information is outstanding. The aim is that I no longer need to be the person remembering and chasing everything. ⸻ Stock Control & Forward Planning You will also help manage our regularly used stock and installation materials. I don’t simply want someone who counts stock. I want somebody who looks ahead. You will regularly review our confirmed jobs for approximately the next 4–6 weeks and make sure we are likely to have enough materials available. This will include monitoring items such as: * Smoothing compounds * Primers * Flooring adhesives * DPM products * Underlays * Plywood * Flooring accessories * Other regularly used installation materials You will: * Carry out regular stock checks * Maintain accurate stock records * Understand what stock has already been allocated to specific jobs * Look at upcoming jobs and estimate likely requirements * Check supplier lead times * Identify potential shortages early * Liaise with Josh and our fitters about requirements * Recommend or arrange replenishment * Flag unusual stock usage or discrepancies * Help prevent unnecessary over-ordering * Produce a simple forward stock forecast The objective is: We should know what we’re going to need before we need it. I don’t want us discovering on the morning of an installation that we’ve run out of an important product. ⸻ Learning About Flooring You do not need previous flooring experience to apply. However, you must genuinely want to learn about the industry. I don’t want somebody who is still saying “I don’t really understand flooring” a year after joining us. We will dedicate a minimum of one paid hour every week specifically to flooring education and product knowledge. This could include learning about: * LVT * Carpet * Laminate * Engineered wood * Different installation methods * Subfloors * Moisture * Smoothing compounds * DPMs * Plywood preparation * Adhesives * Underlays * Measuring and wastage * Common installation problems * Our major manufacturers and product ranges I can also arrange for you to speak directly with our suppliers and manufacturers and participate in product training so that you can learn from people within the industry. You will be encouraged to ask questions. The purpose isn’t to turn you into a flooring installer. It’s to give you enough understanding that when a customer, fitter or supplier discusses a flooring issue, you understand what they’re talking about. The more you learn, the more decisions you’ll eventually be able to make independently. ⸻ Administration & Financial Organisation As the position develops, you will also help us keep our administration organised. This may include: * Matching supplier invoices against orders * Checking purchase information * Assisting with QuickBooks administration * Monitoring outstanding customer balances * Checking deposits have been received * Maintaining job records * Keeping CRM information accurate * Checking paperwork is complete * Helping with basic reporting You don’t need to be an accountant. The important thing is being accurate, organised and comfortable working with numbers and systems. ⸻ How I Want Problems Handled Things inevitably go wrong in a flooring business. Deliveries get delayed. Customers change dates. Fitters become unavailable. Unexpected preparation is discovered. I don’t expect you to magically solve everything. But I also don’t want every problem simply forwarded to me with: “Alex, what should I do?” I want you to investigate first. Ideally, you come to me with: “This has happened. I’ve looked into it. We have option A or option B. I recommend option B because of X. Are you happy for me to proceed?” As your knowledge and experience grow, there will be more situations where you won’t need to ask me at all. That’s how I want this position to develop. ⸻ Communication With Me I don’t want 30 interruptions every day. Part of your job will be understanding what genuinely requires my attention. I’d like us to develop a simple system where I receive a concise update containing things such as: HANDLED Things you’ve dealt with that I don’t need to worry about. WAITING Things we’re waiting for somebody else to provide. NEEDS ALEX Decisions or actions that genuinely require me. HEADS-UP Something you’ve spotted that could become an issue. The ultimate goal is for me to be able to look at one short update and understand what is happening across the business. ⸻ What Success Looks Like After you’ve been with us for a while, success should mean: I can concentrate on sales and growing Northwest Floors without worrying that something operational has been forgotten. Customers receive updates without chasing us. Fitters know where they’re going and what they’re doing. Materials are ordered and arrive when required. We know what stock we’re going to need next month. Outstanding actions are followed up. Our systems are organised. Our calendar is organised. Our customers receive great service. And when something requires my attention, I receive the information I need to make a quick decision. Eventually, I want to be able to take a holiday and know that the business continues operating without me constantly checking my phone. ⸻ Who Will Be Successful In This Role? You’ll probably be a great fit if you are: * Extremely organised * Naturally proactive * Curious * Comfortable taking responsibility * An excellent communicator * Confident speaking and writing in English * Comfortable speaking with UK customers * Good at following things through * Comfortable politely chasing people * Able to prioritise * Calm when things change * Good at problem-solving * Detail-focused * Comfortable with technology * Willing to learn * Trustworthy * Discreet * Happy to admit when you don’t know something and then find the answer * Interested in understanding the whole business rather than simply completing individual tasks Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, Office Manager or similar role would be particularly useful. Experience with CRM systems, QuickBooks, WhatsApp Business, email management and calendar management would also be beneficial. Previous flooring experience is not required. A willingness to become knowledgeable about flooring is required. ⸻ Hours & Long-Term Opportunity This will initially be approximately 20–25 hours per week. Because our business, customers and fitting teams are based in the UK, you must be able to work with a meaningful overlap with UK business hours. We can agree the exact working schedule with the successful candidate. This is not intended to be a short-term freelance project. I’m looking for somebody who wants to build a long-term working relationship with me and Northwest Floors. For the right person, I expect the position, responsibility and hours to grow over time. As my trust in you increases and your knowledge of the business develops, I want to progressively give you more autonomy. ⸻ About Me I’m the owner of Northwest Floors and I’m entrepreneurial by nature. I move quickly, have lots of ideas and often have several things happening simultaneously. You may sometimes receive a three-minute voice note from me containing six completely unrelated things. I need somebody who can take that information and turn it into organised actions. I don’t expect perfection. I don’t expect you to know everything. I do expect honesty, initiative, communication and ownership. If you make a mistake, tell me. We’ll fix it, learn from it and improve the system so it’s less likely to happen again. I’m looking for somebody who can eventually become a genuine right-hand person within the business. ⸻ How To Apply Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste VA application. I’m much more interested in how you think and communicate than receiving the perfect CV. Start your application with the words: OWN THE OUTCOME This lets me know you’ve actually read the job description. Then answer the following: 1. Tell me about a previous position where you supported a business owner or manager and had to manage lots of moving parts. 2. Give me a real example of something you noticed and dealt with without waiting for somebody to ask you. 3. One of our flooring fitters is due at a customer’s home tomorrow morning. At 3pm today, you discover the flooring hasn’t arrived and the fitter isn’t answering their phone. The customer currently believes everything is going ahead normally. What would you do? 4. I send you a three-minute voice note containing six unrelated tasks. Explain exactly what you would do with it. 5. A customer asks you a flooring question and you don’t know the answer. What do you do? 6. Part of this position involves spending at least one paid hour every week learning about flooring. How would you approach learning an industry you currently know very little about? 7. You look at our schedule and notice we have several large LVT installations coming up next month. What would you check or do without waiting for me to ask? 8. What hours are you available to work in UK time? 9. What hourly or monthly salary are you looking for? 10. Please send me a short voice recording introducing yourself, telling me a little about yourself and explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position. I’m looking for someone who wants more than a list of tasks. I’m looking for someone who wants to understand the business, take ownership and become an important part of where we’re going. If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Video and Content Editor
description: # Video Editor / Short Form Content (Full Time) **Type:** Full time **Salary:** $600/month retainer **Hours:** Flexible, built around output rather than a clock. We need overlap with MST Colorado USA or feedback and handoffs. I need someone who turns raw footage into content that actually gets watched. Long form recordings, talking head clips, screen recordings, phone footage, whatever I send you. You cut it, caption it, and make it ready to post. Most of the work is short form. Reels, TikToks, Shorts, ad creative. Some weeks it will be five clips. Some weeks it will be twenty. You need to be able to move fast without the quality dropping off. Taking long form youtueb videos and clipping. adding captions, getting ready for ads. Speed and efficienty and effective is the GOAL This is not a job where I send you a storyboard. I send you a raw file and a rough idea, and you come back with something I can post. What you will actually be doing - Cutting long form recordings into short clips that stand on their own - Captions, hooks, pacing, b roll, sound design, light motion graphics - Ad creative for Meta. Multiple versions of the same concept for testing - Thumbnails and cover frames - Keeping files organized so nothing gets lost or re-edited twice - Occasionally shooting simple screen recordings or assembling from stock Tools Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci, Final Cut, whatever you are fastest in. I care about the output, not the software. After Effects is a plus. OPUS CLAUDE YOU NEED TO BE USING AI OR YOU WILL BE LET GO IMMEDIATELY You should also be comfortable with the AI tools that speed editing up. Auto captioning, transcription, clip finding, upscaling, voice cleanup. If you are still cutting captions by hand, you are too slow for this. AI is non-negotiable This is the most important part of the posting, so read it twice. Editing today does not look like editing five years ago. Auto captions, AI cut detection, transcript based editing, AI upscaling, voice cleanup, AI b-roll and stock search, even rough assembly, all of it should be part of how you work. We use tools like Claude and Opus for scripting, planning, and content decisions, so being comfortable working alongside AI tools day to day matters, not just inside your editing software. If you are still doing everything by hand the slow way, you will not keep up with the pace we need. Because AI is doing a lot of the heavy lifting now, I expect real output. Not fewer hours for the same result, more finished content in less time. That is the trade. You use the tools, you move faster, and the volume reflects it. Tell me exactly which AI tools you use and what each one does for you in your process. If your answer is vague or you skip this part, I will assume you are not actually using AI and this is not a fit. Who this works for - You have a real eye for pacing and hooks, not just technical editing skill - You watch short form content enough to know what is working right now - You hit deadlines without being chased - You take feedback without getting precious about the work - You can hold a consistent style across dozens of pieces Who this does not work for - You need every cut spelled out for you - You are slow but "thorough" - You disappear for two days when you hit a problem - You only do one style and cannot adapt How to apply Do not send a generic application. I will skip it. Send me: 1. Three examples of short form work you edited. Links, not descriptions. 2. One long form video you cut down, plus the clips that came out of it if you have them. 3. What you edit in, and roughly how long a 60 second clip takes you start to finish using your current AI-assisted workflow. 4. Which AI tools you use at each stage of editing (captions, cutting, cleanup, etc.) and what each one does for you. 5. Your realistic weekly output using that workflow. How many finished short clips can you turn around per week at a quality you are proud of. 6. Start your message with the word ORANGE so I know you read this all the way through. If you also shoot, write hooks, or handle posting and scheduling, mention it. It changes what this role can grow into.

title: Dispute & Chargeback Manager + Customer Support VA Wanted for Fast-Growing eCommerce Company
job_title: Dispute & Chargeback Manager + Customer Support VA Wanted for Fast-Growing eCommerce Company
description: Hey there, We’re looking for an experienced Dispute & Chargeback Manager / Customer Support VA to join our eCommerce business long-term. This is an important role because you will be responsible for protecting revenue, making sure disputes are handled correctly and on time, and communicating professionally with customers. We are specifically looking for someone who has real hands-on experience with disputes and chargebacks. We are not looking for someone who has only worked in general customer support or has basic knowledge from watching tutorials. Because dispute volume changes from week to week, you will also handle regular customer support 6 days per week when there are fewer disputes. Your responsibilities You will be responsible for: - Monitoring disputes and chargebacks and making sure no deadline is ever missed - Collecting all relevant dispute evidence - Preparing and submitting strong, organized dispute responses - Fighting chargebacks through platforms such as Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Stripe for the following payment methods: paypal, creditcard and Klarna - Communicating with customers professionally and trying to resolve disputes before they escalate - Persuading customers to voluntarily close disputes when appropriate - Keeping our dispute tracking sheet completely up to date - Handling normal customer-support tickets when dispute workload is lower - Following our customer-support and refund SOPs carefully - Knowing when to solve a case yourself and when something should be escalated What we are looking for You should: - Have previous hands-on eCommerce dispute/chargeback experience - Understand different dispute reasons such as item not received, fraudulent transaction, product not as described, refund/cancellation disputes, etc. - Have experience with Shopify Payments/Stripe and PayPal - Be highly organized and good at managing deadlines - Have excellent attention to detail - Write clear and professional English - Be comfortable dealing with angry or difficult customers - Be able to follow detailed SOPs without constantly needing reminders - Be available for customer support 6 days per week - Take responsibility for mistakes instead of hiding them - Be able to work independently and think logically Important Please do not apply if your only experience is answering customer-support emails. We will ask detailed questions about your previous dispute-management experience, and shortlisted applicants will receive a practical test involving realistic dispute and customer-support cases. We care much more about what you can actually do than how good your application sounds. When applying, answer these questions 1. How many disputes/chargebacks did you personally handle per month in your previous role? 2. Which platforms did you personally use to submit disputes? 3. Explain what evidence you would collect for an Item Not Received chargeback when tracking shows the order was delivered. 4. Tell us about one dispute you lost and why you think you lost it. 5. How did you make sure you never missed dispute deadlines? 6. Have you handled eCommerce customer support as well? Which helpdesk/platform did you use? 7. Are you available to work/check customer support 6 days per week? 8. What hourly rate are you looking for for this role? We are looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term member of the company, take ownership of this department and eventually require very little supervision. If you genuinely have strong dispute-management experience, we would love to hear from you.

title: Meta Ads and GoHighLevel Specialist
description: ***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you. ***About us: Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems. ***Role Mission Be the driving force behind the client acquisition process of established online coaches, consultants, and info product founders. These are expert-led businesses where the founder IS the brand. Your job is to oversee Meta ad campaigns such as lead ad campaigns, low-ticket course campaigns, and appointment/VSL campaigns — making sure that ad spend is turning into leads, customers, booked calls, and sales. You own two tightly connected lanes end to end: the Meta ads that put the founder's offer in front of the right people, and the GoHighLevel infrastructure that captures, nurtures, and routes every lead toward a call. This is not a support role for someone who waits to be told what to do — we're looking for a proactive, driven, high-energy operator who is ready to stand alongside the Founder and take real responsibility over marketing performance. ***Role Responsibilities Meta Ads - End-to-End Campaign Ownership - Strategy: Build the paid strategy around the funnel and offer stage lead magnet opt-ins, appointment/booked-call campaigns, webinar registrations, and low-ticket product sales for coaching and consulting offers. Map each campaign to a clear objective and a target cost per result. - Audience targeting: Research and build custom audiences (pixel, CRM lists, engagement) and lookalikes; layer interest, behavior, and demographic targeting; set exclusions to avoid overlap and waste; and build retargeting audiences from website, video, lead-form, and CRM data. - Creative production: Research winning competitor ads in the coaching/consulting space (offers, hooks, angles, formats); format and produce scroll-stopping static and video ad creatives; write ad copy (primary text, headlines, CTAs) that positions the founder as the authority; and run a steady pipeline of creative variations to test. - Campaign build & launch: Set up campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta Ads Manager - including lead ad forms, appointment campaigns, placements, and conversion events and wire tracking end-to-end with pixels, Conversion API, and GoHighLevel before a single dollar goes live. - Budget management: Allocate and pace daily/lifetime budgets across campaigns, scale winners, cut losers early, and manage frequency, CPM, and delivery to protect efficiency as spend grows. - Performance optimization: Monitor spend and cost per booked call daily; run structured A/B tests across creatives, audiences, and offers; flag anomalies (spend spikes, tracking discrepancies, fatigue) immediately; and act on the data with a proposed fix rather than reporting and moving on. Creative Research & Production (Ad & Funnel Assets) - Leverage AI to analyze competitor ads, industry trends, and the messaging angles of competitor landing pages and creatives. - Set up Claude copywriting projects with accurate project instructions and context files from competitor analysis, copywriting guidelines, and company internal assets. - Leverage AI to produce first-draft copywriting assets such as email campaigns, appointment reminders, campaign hooks & headlines, and landing page copy. - Leverage existing company data such as sales call transcriptions, best-performing content, and validated landing pages to create new ad copy and emails under AI assistance. - Leverage AI to create ad images and scroll-stopping graphics. GoHighLevel CRM Setup & Management - Set up GoHighLevel sub-accounts from scratch with domain, email, SMS (with A2P verification), custom fields, company details, and account snapshots accurately established. - Build funnels such as lead magnet, webinars, VSL, and low-ticket digital product funnels — including setting up forms, integrations, and connecting automated email sequences. - Email management with deliverability best practices, contact tagging, smartlist segmentation, and automated email sequence setup. - Pipeline management with contact tagging, pipeline staging, and setting up triggers for automated opportunity creation / update. - Manage the email list through deliverability best practices, contact tagging, and smartlist segmentation. - Set up integrations across Meta and Google, as well as other platforms, using either GoHighLevel's internal features or Zapier. Marketing & Ads Performance Tracking - Set up tracking across Meta Pixels, Meta Conversion API, Google Analytics, and UTMs. - Build dashboards and spreadsheets to accurately track and report key metrics across Meta ad campaigns and the GoHighLevel pipeline — content/opt-ins ? booked calls ? show rate. - Comfortable identifying optimization opportunities based on weekly campaign data, and delivering reports that end with insight and recommendation — what to kill, scale, or test next — never just numbers. . Workflow Documentation - Document recurring tasks and processes into clear SOPs and process maps, with the help of AI. - Document funnel templates, automated workflows, forms, and other sub-account setups into shareable snapshots. Role Requirements: - Minimum 3 years virtual work experience in paid media and marketing operations — experience with coaches, consultants, course creators, or founder-led personal brands highly preferred (agency background highly preferred but not mandatory). - Proven, hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — strategy, audience targeting, creative production, budget management, and performance optimization — with results you can speak to. - Proven experience using GoHighLevel at agency and sub-account levels, especially lead magnet, VSL, and webinar funnels. - Strong grasp of tech stack integrations and tracking setups across Meta and Google Analytics (Pixel, Conversion API, UTM). - Excellent written and spoken English — able to write ad and email copy in a founder's voice convincingly. - Confident and proactive in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to improve productivity and output quality. - Proactive, driven, and high-energy — ready to take real responsibility over marketing performance alongside the Founder -rather than wait for instructions. - Self-starter with extreme ownership, systems thinking, and a can-do attitude: flags problems before being asked, brings solutions with problems, and never marks a task done that isn't. - High attention to detail around funnel formatting, ad campaign setups, and reporting accuracy — previews funnels on mobile, tests tracking before spend, and checks every link before anything goes live. - Comfortable communicating with sophisticated entrepreneurs, with strong verbal and video presentation. Role Results (KPIs) - 100% GHL CRM hygiene — well-maintained pipelines, tags, workflows, and campaigns. - ?95% QA pass rate on funnels, automations, and ad campaign setups submitted. - ?95% reporting accuracy across campaign tracking (Meta Pixel, Conversion API, UTM, Google Analytics). - Meta ad campaigns hit or beat the agreed cost-per-booked-call target, with spend paced correctly and no undetected tracking gaps. - <30-minute response time to lead outreach opportunities and Founder messages during shifts. - Weekly performance reports delivered on time, each ending with at least one actionable recommendation. - Measurable improvement quarter over quarter in the numbers that matter to an expert business: opt-ins, booked calls, show rate, and cost per acquisition. Please do NOT private message us regarding this job. We have a hiring process in place and will only accept applicants who can follow the process. Go to this link to apply: ----------

title: Full-time IT/Operations/GHL Manager
description: Full Time | 40 Hours per Week | Compensation Based on Experience About the Role We are looking for a resourceful, technically capable, and proactive IT & Systems Manager to build, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve systems across multiple businesses and projects. This is a hands-on role covering GoHighLevel and similar platforms, websites and pages, accounts and sub-accounts, forms, calendars, email, workflows, custom fields, webhooks, integrations, automations, communities, funnels, video editing, presentations, and other technical systems as needed. Your main responsibility is simple: make sure our technical systems and assets work correctly and create a good experience for the people using them. Responsibilities You may be responsible for: Building, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting technical systems across multiple businesses, communities, creators, campaigns, and projects. Creating and updating websites, landing pages, funnels, community pages, and other digital assets, including content, forms, calendars, links, images, and related components. Configuring GoHighLevel and similar platforms, including accounts and sub-accounts, email, custom fields, workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, domains, permissions, webhooks, integrations, and automations. Making sure pages, forms, calendars, email, automations, domains, accounts, and other components are connected to the correct systems and configured properly. Testing complete user flows and identifying broken links, incorrect configurations, missing steps, poor mobile experiences, or other problems before users encounter them. Connecting systems through native integrations, Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, and similar tools. Creating, editing, and correcting videos when needed, including presentation videos, intros, effects, animations, transitions, audio, screen recordings, and basic production work. Preparing and testing technical systems and assets for launches, campaigns, webinars, communities, creators, presentations, and other initiatives. Maintaining organized accounts, access, naming conventions, documentation, templates, and basic SOPs. How We Work Take ownership of your work through completion. Communicate progress without waiting to be asked, raise meaningful issues early, test your own work, and proactively identify and address problems rather than waiting for every task to be assigned. Independent thinking and resourcefulness are essential. When you encounter something you do not know, use AI extensively to research, diagnose, and solve the problem. Also use documentation, tutorials, knowledge bases, internet research, community resources, and software-company support. If specialized help is ultimately required, identify the right resource while continuing to own the issue through resolution. When disagreeing, do it productively. Proactively investigate before challenging, while escalating immediately if even reasonable investigation could create material harm or serious risk. Otherwise, make reasonable progress and validate concerns with facts before raising them. When raising a concern, bring what you learned and, whenever possible, a recommended solution, practical options, or clear next step. Be settled, connected, and ready before meetings. Follow through on commitments, communicate when something is delayed or blocked, and correct mistakes quickly when they happen. Think from the user's perspective. Technical correctness matters, but so do clarity, usability, consistency, and the complete experience of the person using what you build. We do not expect perfection or that you will know everything. We do expect independent problem-solving, proactive action, communication, accountability, and follow-through. What We're Looking For You should have: Strong written English and communication skills. Reliable internet and the ability to work consistently and independently. Strong attention to detail, organization, and technical aptitude. The ability to encounter unfamiliar technical problems and independently work toward solutions. A genuine passion for technology and especially AI. A habit of staying current with new AI tools, capabilities, and trends, particularly how AI is changing technology, marketing, and business. Natural curiosity about new tools and the ability to identify practical ways they can improve systems, automation, marketing, content, and user experience. Experience with some of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know everything: GoHighLevel, Votel, WordPress, websites and funnels, CRM systems, forms and calendars, email configuration, workflows, custom fields, APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, domains and DNS, integrations, communities, marketing automation, CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, Adobe Premiere, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and similar platforms. Do not skip applying because you do not check every box. We would rather hire someone capable, dependable, curious, and resourceful who knows how to figure things out than someone who claims to know everything. What Success Looks Like When you are assigned something, you think beyond the individual task and consider the complete system and user experience. If you build a page, for example, you make sure it is in the correct account, contains the right content, has working links, connects to the correct form or calendar, sends information where it should go, works on desktop and mobile, makes sense to the user, and has been tested before you call it complete. When you encounter something unfamiliar, you research it, use AI and available support resources, test potential solutions, and keep moving. You look ahead for problems and opportunities rather than waiting for someone else to identify every next step. Working Relationship This is intended to be a long-term working relationship for the right person. We hire on a month-to-month basis, with the expectation that the first month gives both parties an opportunity to establish a strong working rhythm and determine whether continuing together makes sense. We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable, long-term part of the team, not someone looking for a short-term project or a few days of work. This is a freelance/independent contractor role. Continued work depends on performance, reliability, communication, business needs, and mutual fit. To Apply Please include: A short introduction about yourself. Your relevant technical and systems experience. Your experience with GoHighLevel or similar platforms. Examples of websites, funnels, automations, integrations, or other systems you have personally built or managed. Your video editing and production experience, if any. The AI tools you currently use and how you use them to solve technical problems. An example of a new AI tool, capability, or trend you have recently explored and why you found it useful. Your availability, timezone, and internet speed. Why you are interested in a long-term role like this. Scenario: You are asked to implement something and initially believe there may be a technical problem with the requested approach. It does not appear to create an immediate serious risk. Walk us through what you would do before raising the concern, and how you would communicate it if your investigation confirms there is a better approach. Please start your application with the words: IT READY

title: UX App designer and human psychology expert

description: UX Designer & Behavioral Psychology Consultant (Contract, Remote) ---------- We built an app that works, but people keep telling us it's confusing. We want someone who can look at how people actually behave when they use our app, figure out where the friction and confusion is really coming from, and give us clear, practical recommendations we can act on. That means reviewing our flows, talking to us about user behavior patterns, and possibly reviewing session recordings or analytics if we have them. From there, you'll put together a set of recommendations grounded in actual behavioral principles, not just design trends. Cognitive load, decision fatigue, mental models, all of that. We want to understand not just what to change, but why it's confusing in the first place. Depending on scope, this could extend into redesigning specific flows or screens once we've agreed on the direction. What we're looking for Someone with real UX design experience, ideally with apps rather than just websites. Beyond that, we need someone who genuinely understands psychology as it applies to product design. That might mean a background in cognitive or behavioral psychology, UX research with a psychology lean, or just years of experience applying that thinking to real products. We'd rather see strong reasoning and a track record than a specific degree. You should be comfortable auditing an existing product critically and telling us hard truths if that's what the data shows. We want someone who can back up their recommendations with actual reasoning, not just opinions on what looks nice. Good to have Experience with fintech or e-commerce apps, familiarity with tools like Figma, Maze, or Hotjar, and any past work where you can point to a measurable improvement after your recommendations were implemented. Details This is a remote, contract-based engagement. Scope and timeline will be discussed based on what the audit uncovers, this could be a one-time deep review or an ongoing relationship if it's a good fit. Send us your portfolio along with a short note on how you'd approach a project like this.

title: FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT
job_title: FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT
description: FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now. WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS We run paid video ads at real scale. We need volume, every single day, forever. Your job: produce 10 short-form video ads per day. Different products, different angles, same relentless output. Most of these are not creative masterpieces. Be clear-eyed about what you'd be doing: Simple product ads built from footage, images and assets we hand you. Recreating proven ad structures. We give you a reference ad that's working in the market — you rebuild that format with OUR product, OUR footage, OUR copy. You're reproducing a structure, not copying someone's file. Working from our swipe file. We keep a reference library of formats that convert. You'll learn it, internalize it, and pull from it fast. High-volume iteration on winners. When an ad performs, you spin out 10 variations designed to beat it. New hook, new opening 3 seconds, new caption style, new music, new order. Hooks, captions, pacing, sound. Fast. Clean. Consistent. Every day. This is not a job where you get to be an artist. This is a job where you get to be the most reliable person in the company. If the word "volume" makes you tired, stop reading. If the idea of one client, one seat, work handed to you every morning, no invoice-chasing, no pitching, no ten-clients juggling act — if that sounds like relief — keep reading. WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER You show up. Every scheduled day. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day. You clear the day's list. Around 10 ads a day on average. Consistently. You stay. We are building a team, not renting a freelancer for two months. Your editing is good enough — and gets better. Notice that skill is fourth on this list. That is not a mistake. We can teach you our formats, our hooks, our caption style, our pacing — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "surdeg" as the first word in the title when applying for this job is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the title structure, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the title structure. What we cannot teach is a person who is at their desk at the same time every day for the next two years. If you have that, and your edits are decent, you will beat a more talented editor who disappears for three days without a message. HOURS — AND YES, THEY'RE NORMAL ONES Monday to Saturday, 8 hours per day, on Philippine time. Roughly 09:00–18:00 PHT with a break. We'll lock your exact hours together before you start. No graveyard shift. No night work. No waiting up until 2am for a Western client. I start my own day very early, so I'm already online and reachable through most of your workday. You get to sleep at night like a normal human being. Occasional Sunday pushes when a launch demands it. Paid extra, never assumed, never unpaid. You keep your regular Philippine holidays. Tell us in advance, that's all. If you cannot commit to six days a week, every week, do not apply. That is the entire job. PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY This is a real monthly salary, not piece work. I am not going to pay you per clip and have you racing to grab the easy ones. Some ads take five minutes. Some take an hour. You get paid for clearing the day, not for counting files. Monthly salary: $520 USD. Paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will. On top of that: $60 USD consistency bonus, every month you clear your daily list on every scheduled day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job and it is entirely within your control. $50 USD push bonus in any month where you clear meaningfully more than your assigned lists — when we ask for a surge before a launch and you actually deliver it. $15 USD per winner. Any ad of yours that becomes a top performer in our account. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. More ads out the door means more chances at a winner, which is exactly why we don't need to pay you by the clip to make you fast. Your first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month. The raise ladder, in writing: When Monthly salary With bonuses, realistically Start $520 ~$580–630 After 1 month $550 ~$610–660 After 3 months $580 ~$640–690 After 6 months $620 ~$680–730 Every step is automatic if you're still clearing your lists. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget." I put the first raise at one month on purpose. Most clients dangle a raise at six months and half of them never pay it. I'd rather prove to you inside four weeks that when you deliver, the number actually moves — and then keep proving it. Winner bonuses sit on top of every row above. How the daily target actually works. Every morning you get a list. On a light day that might be twelve quick iterations off a winner. On a heavy day it might be six builds from raw footage. I size the list, not you — so you are never punished for drawing the hard jobs, and never rewarded for cherry-picking the easy ones. Ten a day is the average we're aiming for across a week, not a rule applied to every single day. What counts as done: delivered on time, follows the brief, correct format and aspect ratio, captions clean, no technical errors. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it. WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY Please save us both the time. Do not apply if: You are juggling other clients and this would be "one of them." You need creative freedom and ownership to feel motivated. Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection. You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts. You cannot work six days a week. You want to negotiate the salary upward before you've proven a single month. You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better. You want to "grow into a Creative Director role." That's not this seat. I'm not being harsh for fun. I hired for this before and lost good people because they wanted a different job than the one I actually had. This time I'm describing it exactly. HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point. 1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this: | [most short-form ads you've ever finished in ONE day] | [main editing software] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net] Example: XXXXXX | 8 | CapCut | 8 | 6 | 45mbps The codeword is written somewhere in this post. I'm not telling you where. If you actually read the whole thing, you already have it. Wrong format, missing codeword, missing a field — deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances. 2. Your message must contain these six things, in this order, and nothing else: Line 1 — The most finished edits you have ever delivered in a single day. Who was it for, and what were they. One or two real sentences. Generic answers are deleted. Your setup — Computer and specs. Internet provider and speed. Backup internet. What you do when the power goes out. Be specific and boring. "I have good internet" is a failed answer. Longevity — The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client. How long, and why it ended. Be honest. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one. Your work — 2 to 3 links to short-form ads or edits you made. Not a reel. Pick the ones closest to simple product ads. Your judgment about what to show me is part of the test. One honest answer — What would make you quit this job? Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing." Last line — Your single most-used keyboard shortcut while editing, and what you use it for. Do not attach a generic CV. It will not be read. THE THREE STAGES Stage 1 — The application above. Takes 20 minutes if you're serious. Most people won't do it. Stage 2 — The volume test. Unpaid. If your application is sharp, I send you a folder of raw footage and one reference format. You deliver 3 finished ads within 24 hours. I am not grading beauty. I am grading: did you follow the brief exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you ask smart questions instead of guessing. This is a real preview of the daily job. Stage 3 — Paid trial week. Full structure, real work, real feedback. This is where the seat is won. WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT One client. One team. Daytime hours. Same work, same people, every day. A real monthly salary paid on time, twice a month, without you ever having to ask. A raise on a schedule, not on a whim — the first one after four weeks. Direct feedback from someone who will tell you exactly what's wrong so you can fix it and get better fast. If you're the kind of person who is tired of chasing clients and just wants a seat, a number to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that. Show me you can follow instructions. That's the whole first test.

What this actually is: I trade futures using automated strategies (bots). Right now I do all the testing myself, and I have another business with 45 employees that takes up most of my time. I want to hand the backtesting off to someone who is better at statistics than I am. This is a three-person operation. Me, a guy in Manila who watches the bots during live trading (10-4 EST), and you. You'd be the one testing — running strategy variations all day, across different markets, figuring out which settings actually hold up and which ones just got lucky. I'm not going to hover over you. I'll give you the platform, the strategy, paid AI tools, and a clear picture of what we are trying to accomplish. Then I need you to go dig. If you need someone assigning you tasks every morning, this isn't the right fit. The work: You'll spend your day in NinjaTrader's Strategy Analyzer running backtests. Change one setting, run the test, record what happened, compare it to the baseline, move to the next one. Over and over, across several markets. The hard part isn't clicking buttons — it's knowing what the numbers mean. Most results look good until you poke at them. A strategy that made money over two months on one market usually falls apart the moment you test it somewhere else, or on a different period, or with realistic costs. Your job is to find the ones that don't fall apart. Things I care about: net profit, profit factor, max drawdown, how many trades it took, and whether it stays consistent across different time periods. Win rate by itself means almost nothing to me. I'll also give you AI (Perplexity/Claude) to work with. A big part of this job is feeding results in, talking through what they mean, arguing with it, and using that back-and-forth to d ---------- what to test next. You need to be able to tell when the AI is confidently wrong. AI is an amazing tool, but it makes plenty of mistakes and needs to be guided. Everything gets written down in proper files — what was tested, the exact settings, what the result was. I've lost a lot of work not backing up previous results before I realized the AI was compressing our convos and not saving the files I gave it. What I need from you • A degree in statistics, math, actuarial science, engineering, physics, economics with heavy math, or something similar. This one I'm firm on. • You actually understand sample size, variance, expectancy, and over-fitting — not just the terms, but why they matter. • You're a self-learner. You'll be learning futures trading, the platform, and my strategy mostly on your own. I'll answer questions, but I can't teach you line by line. • Very careful with details. The settings screens have dozens of fields, and one wrong box means the whole day of testing was worthless. • You can write clearly in English. I need short, honest daily updates I can read in a few minutes. • You'll tell me when the data doesn't prove anything. I'd much rather hear "the sample is too small to say" than a hopeful guess. • Decent computer, stable internet, quiet place to work. I can provide a VPS if we need one, but you need a way to log into it. You do not need any trading experience. Seriously. I'd rather have a sharp stats grad who's never placed a trade than someone with trading opinions and no math. Everything about markets can be taught. Nice if you have it, but not required: Excel or Sheets for organizing results, some Python or R, and any experience with time-series data or experiment design. How to apply Skip the generic cover letter — I'll know, and I won't read it. Send me: 1. Your degree, school, and graduation year. 3. Something quantitative you've worked on — school, thesis, or job — and what you concluded from it. 4. Whether you've used any of the AI tools, and what for. 5. Your available hours in US Eastern time. 6. Something you taught yourself, and how you went about it. Doesn't have to be technical.

We have developed our own content production process, and you will be trained to work according to our guidelines. What matters most to us is that you are reliable, comfortable working with AI, able to follow a structured process, and willing to learn. You will not be responsible for launching or publishing the finished products. Your responsibility ends with the completed and quality-checked content package. How our AI workflow works We do not expect you to write an entire book yourself. We also do not expect you to create one “perfect prompt” and reuse it for every project. Instead, you will learn our structured AI-assisted production process. A simplified example looks like this: Project Brief → AI Production → Independent AI Review → Revision → Quality Check → Completed Content Package An important part of our process is that the AI producing content does not simply approve its own work. We use separate AI systems or independent AI instances for production and quality review. Your role is to manage this process reliably according to our instructions. What we are looking for You may be a good fit if you: have practical experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools, are comfortable learning new AI tools, can follow detailed instructions and checklists, work reliably and in an organized way, are comfortable managing longer projects with multiple files and versions, can recognize when something looks unusual, incomplete, inconsistent, or obviously wrong, are willing to stop and ask rather than blindly accepting an AI result, have good written English, can work independently once a process has been explained, are interested in books, digital content, and AI-assisted content creation. Professional book-writing experience is not required. Formal AI qualifications are not required. Advanced prompting expertise is not required. We are looking for someone who can learn and reliably operate a good system—not someone who claims to know everything about AI. What matters to us At Peak Media World, we believe AI should make good work more efficient—not replace quality standards. We value: Reliability over speed. Quality over quantity. Following a good process over improvising. Thinking before blindly accepting an AI result. If something does not look right, we want you to notice it, stop, and check rather than simply move on. title: Experienced Appointment Setter / DM Closer
description: 100K Solutions is looking for an **experienced Appointment Setter / DM Closer** to join our team long-term. We need someone who can take ownership of our inbound leads and DMs, communicate professionally, qualify prospects, follow up consistently, handle basic objections, and turn conversations into **qualified booked appointments**. This is not a basic VA position where you simply copy and paste scripts. You need to understand sales conversations, know how to build rapport, recognize buying signals, and move prospects toward the next step without sounding robotic or overly aggressive. ### Responsibilities - Respond to new inbound leads and DMs quickly. - Communicate with prospects through social media, SMS, and our CRM. - Qualify leads based on their goals, current situation, urgency, and ability to invest. - Turn qualified conversations into booked appointments. - Follow up consistently with leads who do not respond or are not ready immediately. - Re-engage older leads already in our pipeline. - Handle common objections around price, timing, trust, and readiness. - Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows. - Keep accurate notes and update every lead's status inside the CRM. - Make sure no qualified lead falls through the cracks. - Follow our scripts and sales process while still communicating naturally. - Provide daily updates on conversations, follow-ups, appointments booked, and lead status. - Communicate important lead information to our closer and management team. ### Requirements - Previous experience as an **appointment setter, DM setter, sales VA, or DM closer is required**. - Strong written English and communication skills. - Experience handling inbound leads and sales conversations. - Comfortable qualifying prospects and asking sales-related questions. - Experience handling objections and following up with prospects. - Ability to communicate naturally instead of relying completely on copy-and-paste responses. - Strong organization and attention to detail. - Experience using a CRM is preferred. - Ability to follow systems, scripts, and instructions. - Must be reliable and available during agreed working hours. - Must be able to work independently without constant reminders or supervision. - Must be coachable and willing to improve based on feedback. ### What We're Looking For We want someone who understands that **following up is just as important as responding to new leads**. Every lead should have a clear status and next step. We do not want prospects sitting untouched because they did not respond to the first message. We also care about **quality over simply filling the calendar**. Your job is not to book everyone. Your job is to identify serious prospects, properly qualify them, and book people who are genuinely interested in our services. Performance will be measured based on response time, follow-up consistency, qualified appointments booked, show rate, CRM accuracy, communication, and overall results. We are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company**. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibilities, compensation, and performance-based incentives. We will provide training on our specific services, offers, scripts, qualification process, CRM workflow, and booking procedures, but you should already have a solid understanding of appointment setting and sales fundamentals. **We are looking for someone reliable, experienced, organized, sales-driven, and capable of taking ownership of our DM and appointment-setting process.**
