Think speaker highlights, event promos, thought-leadership clips, LinkedIn content that earns attention from senior executives. Prism & Pearl (prismandpearl.store) — B2C eCommerce. Luxury moissanite and sterling silver jewellery. Premium, elegant, understated. Product-led reels and paid social that sell without shouting. Brio & Bloom ( ---------- ) — B2C eCommerce. Sensory toys and comfort products for children with diverse needs. Warm, calm, reassuring, aimed at parents. Newly launched, so there's real scope to shape how it looks and sounds. You'll be working across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok and LinkedIn — organic reels and paid ads. What you'll be working with You'll get a genuine mix of source material, and part of the skill is knowing what to do with each: ● Raw conference and event footage we film at our summits — speaker sessions, audience moments, venue atmosphere ● Product video for the two eCommerce brands ● Stills, stock and licensed footage to build from where there's no video ● AI-generated video, where it makes sense Some pieces will be cut from hours of event footage. Others you'll build from almost nothing. Being comfortable with both is important. Being able to move between those registers is essential. A LinkedIn clip for executives and a jewellery ad and a gentle piece for parents of neurodivergent kids are three completely different jobs. One signature style won't work here. What we need from you Storytelling first. You can find and tell a story in 15 seconds, and communicate a value proposition without it feeling like an ad read. Genuine autonomy. You take a goal and run with it. You suggest things nobody asked for. You flag when something isn't working. We don't want to art-direct every cut. Real editing craft. Pacing, rhythm, timing, captions, sound. AI helps you go faster — it doesn't do this part for you. AI as a serious tool. You use AI in your workflow and you're across what's available. If you're using platforms we haven't thought of, tell us — we want to learn from you. To be clear: this is not a prompt engineering role. We need a real editor who uses AI to work faster and better, not someone whose only skill is generating clips. If you can produce AI footage but couldn't fix the pacing of a cut or explain why a hook isn't landing, this isn't for you. Quality over quantity. We're not asking for a content factory — a few strong pieces a week, done properly. We would rather have three reels that work than ten that don't. Excellent written English. You'll be writing hooks, captions and on-screen copy for an Australian audience. Captions go on every video — most social is watched with the sound off, and they need to be accurate and well-timed. Using AI to speed this up is encouraged, as long as you check it. Music and licensing sense. You'll source your own tracks, with our input. Most of this work is paid Meta advertising, so you need to understand what's safe to use in an ad versus what's fine on an organic post. Getting this wrong gets ads rejected. Commercial understanding. You know the difference between B2B and eCommerce marketing, and why an ad that works for one would fail for the other. Practical requirements ● Your own editing software and AI platforms. We're not precious about which — CapCut and Canva are perfectly fine if that's how you get great results. Premiere Pro and After Effects are welcome but not required. We care about the finished piece, not the tool. ● Reliable high-speed internet ● Available within 10:00am–6:00pm AEST/AEDT (8:00am–4:00pm Philippine time; 7:00am–3:00pm from October when Sydney moves to daylight saving) Nice to have: experience with events or conferences; motion graphics; experience running or editing paid social campaigns. How we'll work together at the start We'll review and give feedback on your first 5–10 pieces — our Marketing Manager and leadership team. This isn't micromanagement; it's how we get aligned on what good looks like for each brand. Once we're confident in your work, you'll run with it. The goal is for you to work independently, and we'll get there quickly if you take feedback well. If you're looking for a role where someone directs every cut indefinitely, we're not it — but we won't drop you in cold either. Hours, salary and terms ● Hours: 20–30+ per week, producing a few finished pieces weekly ● Salary: AUD $800–$1,400 per month (approximately PHP 37,000–63,000 at current rates), depending on demonstrated experience ● Type: Long-term and ongoing. We want someone to stay. ● Start date: We're looking for someone to begin within the next two weeks, so please tell us your earliest availability. How to apply A broad portfolio is essential. Applications without one won't be considered. We want to see range, not just your best single piece. Include B2B and B2C work if you have both, and paid social alongside organic if you can. Please answer these: 1. Your portfolio. Show us reels, short-form ads and social video across different brands and audiences. 2. Pick one of our three brands, look at what they're currently doing, and pitch us a reel concept. A few sentences is plenty — the hook, the story, why it would work for that audience. This is the question we care most about. We're not looking for a polished proposal; we want to see how you think when nobody's briefing you. 3. Tell us about a time you improved a project beyond what was asked. What did you suggest, and what happened? 4. How do you use AI in your video work? Which platforms, at what point in your process, and what you still do yourself. If you're using something we probably haven't heard of, tell us about it. 5. Which editing software you use, and your setup. Any tool is fine — we just want to know how you work. 6. Your available hours in Philippine time, and confirmation you can work within our window. 7. Your expected monthly salary in AUD, and the hours per week that reflects. 8. Your earliest start date. We read every application properly and reply to shortlisted candidates.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Tech & AI Channel
job_title: YouTube Video Editor – Tech & AI Channel
description: PROFESSIONAL LONG-FORM YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR (TECH) Hey, I'm Giovanni! I'm looking for a talented long-form video editor to team up with me and grow my YouTube channel, TechGio. If you love clean, premium talking-head content and you're excited about tech and AI, keep reading. I think you're going to like this one! ABOUT THE CHANNEL TechGio started as me documenting my own journey into tech sales, then turning around to help other people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that content is still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, and day-in-the-life. Here's what's exciting right now: the channel is expanding! I'm going deeper into the tech industry and AI (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for people in the industry). On top of that, I'm building my own startup and I'm going to share the founder journey and behind-the-scenes of building a company while working full-time. So it's tech sales, AI and tech updates, and startup life. All talking-head, all long-form, all real. I've worked with an editor before and it was a great experience. Now I'm ready to go bigger: more videos, more polish, and one editor who becomes a true long-term partner on this. Not a one-off gig. Someone who grows with the channel and wins when it wins. That's you, hopefully! WHAT YOU'LL DO I batch-film, so you'll get raw talking-head footage (Sony A7 IV), screen recordings, and a short brief for each video with the hook, structure, and the moments I want to hit. From there, you run the edit: - Trim the raw clips, cut dead air, keep it tight and engaging. Retention is the name of the game. - On-screen text and captions: callouts, key numbers, lists. Clean, sharp, well-timed. This is a big part of the style. - Simple, polished animations: diagrams for AI concepts, tool and UI highlights, smooth transitions. Think Jeff Su, not MrBeast. - Screen recording polish: zooms, cursor highlights, blur anything sensitive. - Music and sound design that fits the vibe, with clean dialogue audio. - Color, final export, and organized project files. - Quick revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually just one round. Thumbnails are a bonus, paid separately if that's something you do. WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR - You've edited long-form YouTube talking-head content before, ideally for tech, business, or productivity channels, and you have published videos to show for it. - You're strong in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or something similar, and you can make text and motion look premium. - You use AI in your workflow. - You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows in the edit when the editor cares about the content. - You're fast and reliable. First cuts within 48 hours, and if something's going to slip, you tell me before it does. I'll always do the same for you. - You're hardworking, coachable, and want to keep getting better. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with. - Fluent English. We'll collaborate on Slack or WhatsApp, mostly async, so clear communication matters. One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started or if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or event videos. Nothing against that work, it's just not what this role is. I need someone who can hit a high bar from day one. WHAT YOU GET This is a partnership, and I want it to be a great one for both of us. Here's what that looks like: - Steady, consistent work: 8–12 videos a month once we're rolling. - Rate increases as your work speaks for itself. Good work gets rewarded here, I truly mean that! - Tools covered. If you need software, plugins, stock music, or assets to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for them. - Real growth. As the channel and everything around it takes off, there's going to be a lot more to make. You get first look at all of it! - A real voice. I want your ideas on pacing, hooks, and style. You're a creative partner here, and I'm excited to build this with someone who wants to collaborate, not just take orders. QUICK FACTS - Channel: ---------- - Long-form YouTube only. No Shorts. - 2–3 videos per week - $50–$100 per video based on experience and quality (roughly $500–$1,000+ per month) - Fast turnarounds on edits, ideally within 48 hours - Paid per video. Long-term. THE STANDARD Watch a couple of these before applying so we're on the same page: - Jeff Su: ---------- (the golden example — clean, tight, sharp text, subtle motion, never overdone) - Liam Ottley: ---------- (clear diagrams and callouts that make AI simple) - Dan Martell: ---------- (bold text, strong pacing, premium feel) And my channel for how previous videos were edited: ---------- HOW TO APPLY Start your message with the word "Mission" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me: 1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited, and exactly what you did on each. 2. Your tools, including which AI tools you use. 3. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual first-cut turnaround. 4. Your rate per video. The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way! I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see what you've made and hopefully build something great together! — Giovanni

title: Structural Revit / CAD Drafter
description: We are looking for an experienced Structural Revit / CAD Drafter based in the Philippines to support Australian structural engineering projects. The successful candidate must have: Minimum 3 years of direct structural drafting experience on multi-storey or high-rise buildings Proven experience working on Australian structural engineering projects Strong hands-on experience with Autodesk Revit Structure Strong AutoCAD structural drafting capability Practical experience using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 Experience producing construction documentation for reinforced concrete buildings Ability to work independently from engineers' mark-ups, sketches, calculations and design instructions Good understanding of Australian structural documentation standards and drawing conventions Ability to coordinate structural models with architectural and services models Preference will be given to candidates who have worked directly for Australian structural engineering consultancies or outsourcing/BIM companies servicing Australian engineering firms. Candidates must be able to provide the actual names of Australian projects and companies/consultancies they have worked for or supported. Generic statements such as "worked on Australian projects" will not be sufficient. Key Responsibilities The Structural Revit / CAD Drafter will be responsible for producing and maintaining structural models and construction documentation for Australian projects including: Reinforced concrete apartment buildings Class 2 residential developments Mixed-use developments Multi-storey commercial buildings High-rise residential towers Basement structures Podium structures Transfer structures Post-tensioned and reinforced concrete floor systems Concrete and structural steel elements where required The role will involve both Revit modelling and detailed structural documentation, rather than modelling for visualisation purposes only. Detailed Revit Skills Required Candidates must demonstrate strong working knowledge of Revit Structure, including the following. Structural Model Creation Ability to independently model: Concrete columns Reinforced concrete walls Core walls Blade walls Basement walls Retaining walls Concrete beams Transfer beams Band beams Downstand beams Upstand beams Slabs Suspended slabs Ground slabs Transfer slabs Podium slabs Ramps Stairs Footings Pad footings Strip footings Raft slabs Pile caps Piles Ground beams Structural steel framing where required Candidates should understand the difference between simply creating Revit geometry and creating a properly structured engineering BIM model suitable for construction documentation. Levels, Grids and Model Setup Must be comfortable with: Establishing and modifying structural levels Managing floor-to-floor levels Structural set-down levels Basement levels Transfer levels Roof levels Grid creation and management Grid coordination with architectural models Managing project coordinates Shared coordinates Survey points Project base points Linked model positioning Revit Families Candidates should have practical experience with: Loading and managing structural families Editing family parameters Type parameters Instance parameters Creating simple parametric structural families Modifying existing structural families Shared parameters Nested families where required Structural framing families Column families Foundation families Annotation families Detail component families Title blocks Tags The candidate does not need to be a full-time Revit family developer but must be capable of modifying and creating families required for normal structural documentation. Structural Views and Documentation Must be able to independently prepare: General arrangement plans Structural floor plans Foundation plans Basement plans Column layouts Wall layouts Slab layouts Beam layouts Transfer level drawings Roof structural plans Structural sections Building sections Wall sections Beam sections Slab sections Foundation sections Structural elevations Construction details Typical details Enlarged details Strong understanding of: View templates View ranges Underlays Plan regions Crop regions Scope boxes Dependent views Callouts Sections Elevations Detail views Drafting views Annotation and Drawing Production Must be competent in: Structural dimensions Spot elevations Levels Tags Beam tags Column tags Wall tags Slab tags Foundation tags Keynotes Text notes Leaders Detail lines Filled regions Masking regions Symbols Section markers Detail references Revision clouds Revision management The candidate should be capable of producing clean, readable construction drawings rather than relying on engineers to complete drawing presentation. Revit Schedules Experience creating and maintaining schedules including: Column schedules Wall schedules Beam schedules Slab schedules Foundation schedules Structural framing schedules Material schedules Element schedules Quantity schedules where required Candidates should understand: Filtering Sorting Grouping Calculated parameters Formatting schedules Shared parameters Schedule templates Worksharing and Model Management Strong knowledge of Revit worksharing is required, including: Central models Local models Cloud worksharing Worksets Synchronisation Reload latest Relinquishing elements Ownership issues Model health Purging Warnings Auditing models Managing linked models Managing model size and performance Candidate should understand correct collaborative BIM working practices rather than treating Revit as a standalone desktop drafting program. BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud Experience Practical BIM 360 or Autodesk Construction Cloud experience is mandatory. Candidates should be familiar with: Autodesk Docs BIM Collaborate BIM Collaborate Pro Cloud-hosted Revit models Publishing models Consuming models Model coordination Version management File permissions Folder structures Document management Issue tracking Mark-ups Reviews Uploading and downloading project documentation Managing linked cloud models Working with architectural and services models hosted in ACC Candidates should be comfortable working within a live Australian project's ACC environment. Revit Coordination Candidates must understand multidisciplinary coordination between: Structural Architectural Mechanical Electrical Hydraulic Fire Facade Civil models Typical responsibilities include: Linking architectural models Linking services models Checking grid alignment Checking level alignment Identifying penetrations Identifying clashes Reviewing slab penetrations Reviewing wall openings Reviewing services risers Coordinating stairs and cores Coordinating facade interfaces Reviewing structural zones against architectural requirements Experience using Navisworks or ACC Model Coordination is advantageous. Structural Drawing Knowledge The candidate must understand typical Australian structural drawings and terminology including: RLs FFL SSL TOS TOB U/S NGL slab thicknesses slab set-downs step-downs rebates penetrations cast-ins construction joints movement joints isolation joints transfer structures column transitions wall transitions temporary penetrations pour strips post-tensioning zones stressing pockets conventional reinforcement zones A strong understanding of reinforced concrete building construction is highly desirable. Australian Project Experience – Mandatory The candidate must have worked on Australian structural engineering projects. During the application and interview process, candidates will be required to identify: Name of Australian structural engineering consultancy they worked for or supported Name of Australian builder/developer where relevant Actual project names Project location Building type Number of storeys Their specific responsibilities Revit version used Whether the model was hosted in BIM 360 / ACC Whether they produced construction documentation themselves Whether they worked directly with Australian engineers Example: Project: ABC Residences, Parramatta NSW Building: 28-storey reinforced concrete residential tower + 4 basement levels Consultant: XYZ Structural Engineers Role: Structural Revit Drafter Responsibilities: Structural modelling, GA plans, slab plans, beam layouts, column/wall layouts, sections and coordination using BIM 360. Candidates unable to provide specific project examples may not progress to interview. Minimum Experience Applicants should have: Minimum 3 years structural Revit experience Minimum 3 years experience working on multi-storey/high-rise projects Demonstrated Australian project experience Strong reinforced concrete documentation experience Advanced Revit Structure skills Strong AutoCAD skills BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud experience Experience working from engineering mark-ups Experience coordinating with architects Experience dealing with drawing revisions and construction-stage changes Candidates with 5+ years experience will be highly regarded. AutoCAD Requirements The candidate should also be proficient in AutoCAD including: Structural detailing Xrefs Layer management Blocks Dynamic blocks Paperspace Modelspace Viewports CTB/STB plotting Drawing standards External references Revision management PDF mark-up incorporation Converting and cleaning consultant CAD backgrounds Preferred Additional Skills Highly regarded skills include: Navisworks Bluebeam Revizto Dynamo BIM interoperability Revit model auditing Revit model optimisation Revit standards/template development Reinforcement modelling Post-tensioning documentation Structural steel detailing Clash detection ISO 19650 familiarity Australian BIM standards Autodesk Desktop Connector Communication Requirements The successful candidate must be able to: Read and understand written engineering instructions in English Understand Australian engineering terminology Communicate clearly through Teams, Slack, email or project management systems Raise RFIs when information is unclear Identify inconsistencies between architectural and structural documentation Explain drafting/model coordination issues clearly Work directly with Australian engineers and project managers Strong spoken English is preferred, but technical comprehension, written communication and reliability are more important than accent. Candidate Portfolio Requirements Every shortlisted candidate must provide a portfolio containing examples of actual structural documentation they have personally worked on. You will work directly with the Founder and Creative Director to manage the administrative and operational details behind our weddings, events, proposals and luxury experiences. ## Your key responsibilities * Monitor and organise business inboxes * Respond to routine client and supplier emails * Draft professional correspondence * Follow up outstanding information, quotes and confirmations * Create and update tasks in Trello * Maintain client and supplier records * Update guest lists, payment schedules and event information * Schedule client and supplier meetings * Save contracts, invoices, quotes and documents correctly * Update Studio Ninja, TTO and other business systems * Assist with event run sheets and production schedules * Check supplier contact details, timings and event information * Maintain organised Google Drive folders * Document and update standard operating procedures * Prepare meeting agendas and record actions * Complete a short daily accountability update in Trello * Identify missing information, approaching deadlines and potential problems ## What we are looking for We need someone who is proactive and takes genuine ownership of their work. You should be someone who: * Follows tasks through to completion * Checks your work before submitting it * Notices when information is missing * Follows up without needing reminders * Communicates early when there is a delay or blocker * Can manage several clients and deadlines at once * Is confident communicating with clients and suppliers * Can work independently after receiving clear direction * Is interested in growing with the business Strong attention to detail is essential. Our event documents include names, dates, supplier contacts, payment deadlines, guest information and live event timings. This information must be accurate. ## Systems we use Experience with some of the following will be helpful: * Gmail and Google Workspace * Google Drive * Trello * Studio Ninja * TTO or That’s The One * Calendly * MailerLite * Xero You do not need experience with every system. Training will be provided but you must be confident learning new software. However, you must be proactive. ## Experience required You should have previous experience as an: * Executive Virtual Assistant * Executive Assistant * Operations Assistant * Administrative Coordinator * Project Coordinator * Event or hospitality administrator Experience in weddings, events, hospitality, travel or a luxury service business will be highly regarded. Excellent written and spoken English is required. ## Hours and availability The role will begin at approximately 10 hours per week. You must be available across Monday to Friday with some overlap during Perth, Western Australia business hours. Some flexibility may occasionally be required around major event dates. This will be discussed and agreed upon in advance. The right person will have the capacity and desire to increase their hours as the role develops. ## How to apply Please begin your application with: **Ordinary isn’t in our vocabulary.** Please also answer the following questions: 1. How many hours are you currently available each week? 2. Are you available during Perth business hours? 3. Are you interested in increasing your hours in the future? 4. Tell us about a time you noticed and resolved a problem before your manager needed to ask. 5. Which CRM and task-management systems have you used? Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical task.

title: Video Editor – Social Media & Reels
description: About the Role We are looking for a talented and reliable Video Editor to join our team on a part-time, long-term basis and create high-quality video content for Shym Saunas, an Australian premium sauna brand. The main focus of this role will be editing Instagram Reels, Facebook videos, short-form social content, product videos, promotional videos and other brand content using our existing video library and new footage. We are looking for someone who understands that good social content is not simply about adding transitions and effects. You should have a strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, music, visual flow and audience retention, while maintaining a premium and authentic brand feel. What You'll Do Edit short-form videos and Reels for Instagram and Facebook. Turn raw footage into engaging social media content. Create different edits from existing video footage where appropriate. Select strong hooks, opening shots and sequences to capture attention. Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and simple motion graphics where appropriate. Edit product-focused videos while maintaining accurate representation of the actual products. Create promotional and campaign videos for product launches, sales and seasonal campaigns. Work with existing footage from our video library and organise/select the best clips for editing. Follow creative direction and brand guidelines. Make revisions based on feedback. Export videos correctly for Instagram, Facebook and other social platforms. What We're Looking For Proven experience as a video editor, particularly for social media/Reels/short-form content. Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality editing. Good understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling and audience retention. Experience creating content for brands, ecommerce or lifestyle businesses is highly desirable. Strong attention to detail. Ability to follow a creative brief and take feedback well. Good English communication skills. Reliable and able to meet agreed deadlines. Good eye for premium, natural and authentic visual content. Very Important – Product Accuracy Shym Saunas sells premium products, so accuracy is extremely important. You must not alter, invent or incorrectly represent product features, product configurations or product details when editing videos. We will provide the correct product footage and references, and you will be expected to work carefully with the supplied material. We also want our content to feel authentic and premium rather than obviously AI-generated. AI tools can be used to assist your workflow where appropriate, but the final content must look natural and professionally produced. Software You should be comfortable working with professional video editing software such as: Adobe Premiere Pro DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro CapCut After Effects or similar motion graphics tools Experience with Canva and AI-assisted editing tools is a plus, but strong editing ability and creative judgement are more important than the specific software you use. To Apply Please include: A link to your best video editing portfolio. 2–3 examples of Reels/short-form videos you have edited. Briefly explain what software you use. Tell us how many hours per week you are available. Tell us your expected hourly rate. Tell us about your experience editing content for brands, ecommerce or social media. If given 30 minutes of raw sauna/product footage, briefly explain how you would d ---------- which sections should become a 30–60 second Reel. Please do not send generic portfolio links only. We are particularly interested in seeing your short-form social media work. This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person, with the potential for increased hours and responsibility based on performance. This approach deliberately puts the product-accuracy requirement prominently in the advert. That's important given Artem's recent feedback about AI-looking creatives and inaccurate product representation.

title: DTC SUPPLEMENT BRAND — VIDEO EDITOR
description: THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE. We're looking for someone with years of experience behind them who wants to try something new. If you're early in your career or looking to learn on the job, this isn't the right fit. We need someone who already knows how to do this work and is ready to apply it to a mission they believe in. ABOUT US We're a mission-driven health supplement startup focused on habit breaking. We're on pace to do $1M+ per month within the first 90 days. We're building a brand that solves real problems for people who want to change their behavior and break destructive cycles. We're systematized: locked prompting workflows, proven AI animation templates, and fast feedback loops. Your job is to turn a strategist's script and a sample video into finished ads that ship clean and move people toward change. YOUR ROLE We want a video editor who shares our mission and can turn a strategist's script plus a sample video into a finished, performance-ready ad. You're not waiting weeks for feedback. You have direct access to strategists, clear revision paths, and concepts that ship every 2-3 days. Every scene is the same two moves: build a first frame, animate that frame. WHAT YOU'LL DO 1. FIRST FRAME GENERATION (GPT image generation) 2. ANIMATION PROMPTING & GENERATION (Omni via Google Flow or Seedance 2.5 via Kie AI) 3. VOICEOVER PRODUCTION (ElevenLabs) 4. QC & ASSEMBLY WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required * You've personally generated AI video using Omni or a similar image-to-video tool, end to end * You understand prompt engineering for video generation: dialogue formatting, emotional direction, physical beats, framing locks * You can QC your own output: you catch spelling mistakes, lip sync drift, character inconsistency, framing creep before you deliver * You know the difference between regenerating and repairing in post—and you regenerate * You're familiar with GPT image generation and can iterate on avatar prompts * 9:16 vertical video native, not adapted * Reliable overlap with North American hours * Mission alignment: you believe in helping people break habits and change behavior Strongly preferred * Experience with Seedance 2.5 or similar long-form video generation (20-30 seconds in one clip) * Google Flow or other Omni-based workflows * ElevenLabs voiceover generation at scale * Familiarity with animation rule sets: locked framing, multiple physical beats, vocal arcs * Experience with Kie AI HOW YOU WORK * Scene breaks and shot decisions are yours. You watch the sample, read the script, and d ---------- where the frame changes. * You verify every clip against a QC checklist before you deliver to QC—spelling, framing holds, character consistency, lip sync, monotone stretches. * If a clip needs more than a couple of regenerations, you flag it instead of burning credits silently. * You deliver into QC with a video link, not into review. You never move a task into review yourself. * You read revision notes, make the change, and resubmit the same path. If you disagree, you say so in the task. * You ask one focused question when something is genuinely missing (script, avatar description, duration). You don't guess. PRACTICAL * Part time, remote * Overlap with North American hours required * Tools: Google Flow, Kie AI, GPT image generation, ElevenLabs, ClickUp, Slack * We provide: Kie AI company account (pre-topped with credits), Google Flow accounts (being provisioned) * You provide: ElevenLabs account (billed to us on your invoice at end of batch with receipt) * Cost discipline: generations run $15-30 per concept. Only start generating once the script is final. SCREENING 1. Share your portfolio. Walk us through one concept where you built the avatar in GPT image generation, animated it in Omni (or similar), and added voiceover. What did you iterate on? 2. Show us one first-frame avatar you generated in your portfolio. What was the brand, and what were you going for in the look? 3. Which of these have you done yourself: locked framing in an animation prompt, added multiple physical beats to direction, written a vocal arc across emotional states? List only what you've done. 4. Describe your QC process. What do you check before you hand off a finished video? 5. What's your time zone, and what hours can you reliably overlap with North America? 6. Why does this mission matter to you? What's your connection to habit breaking or behavior change? HOW TO APPLY You must include your favorite color + Video Editor in the subject line of your application for it to be considered. This shows you actually read it and is very important. If it's not in there, your application will be skipped. DM with: * Your portfolio * One concept where you did all three: generated the avatar, animated it, and added voiceover * A screenshot of a first-frame avatar you generated * Which animation rules you've implemented yourself * Your time zone and available hours * Why this mission resonates with you * Anything else you think we should know We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Growth Strategist - Meta Ads + Direct Response Copy (Full Time, EST Hours)
job_title: Growth Strategist - Meta Ads + Direct Response Copy (Full Time, EST Hours)
description: Perfect Growth Agency is a digital marketing agency running paid acquisition for service businesses in North America. We are hiring ONE full-time Growth Strategist to take ownership of ad performance across our existing client accounts. This is a thinking role, not a button-pushing role. You will not be handed a complete brief and told what to build. You will be given a client, an account, and a goal, and we expect you to dig in, ask sharp questions, and come back with a plan. ABOUT THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying) This role runs on US Eastern Time, which means working nights in the Philippines. We would rather be upfront about this than have you find out in month two. If a night schedule does not work for your life right now, please skip this one, no hard feelings. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Write the ad copy and the landing page copy. This is a major part of the job, not a side duty - Learn our existing client accounts deeply: their customers, their offers, what has been tested, what is working and what is fading - Report weekly per client. Not a numbers dump, a clear story: what we tested, what we learned, what is next - Propose and run the next moves: new angles, new hooks, new creative, budget and structure changes - Concept the creative, then brief our video editors and AI design tools clearly enough that they get it right first time - Build landing pages using AI tools, and diagnose why a page is not converting - Make the daily Meta ads calls: kill, scale, or iterate YOU ARE A FIT IF - You write direct response copy. Not "I can write" but: you understand awareness levels, you can take a rough draft or AI output and pull it up to a standard, and you can explain what you changed and why - You have 2+ years hands-on Meta ads experience with real budget, and can walk through an account you personally ran and defend every decision you made - You have written and built landing pages and understand what makes them convert - You use AI daily as a real part of how you work, not as a novelty - You ask WHY before HOW. The how you can research and figure out. The why you push on - You communicate clearly in writing and on video NOT IN THIS ROLE GoHighLevel builds, video editing, sales calls, client account management. We have people for those. Your job is thinking, writing, testing, and performance. SALARY AND GROWTH USD 800 to 1000 per month to start, depending on experience. Reviewed at 3 months with a clear path to USD 1400+ based on results. Paid on time, every time. Weekends off. This is a long-term role and we are hiring someone to grow into a lead seat as we scale, not a short-term contractor. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word ANGLE. Applications without it are not read. Then send links to 3 to 5 pieces of copy you wrote that actually ran. Ads still live in the Meta Ad Library, landing pages or sales pages (the URL is fine even if it has since changed), emails, or your own portfolio. Public links only, so nothing breaches an NDA. If most of your work is not public, send what you have and tell us the context. Then answer these three, briefly: 1. One Meta account you personally ran: the niche, roughly the monthly ad spend, and your best result 2. The best performing hook you ever wrote, and why you think it worked 3. Tell us about a campaign you d ---------- to kill. What did you see, and how long did you wait before pulling it? Short answers are fine. We are reading for how you think, not how much you write. We read the copy before we read the CV. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short Loom video walking through one real campaign they ran.

title: Bookkeeper Australia/ USA
description: # Part-Time Bookkeeper – Music Industry **20 hours per week | Remote / Flexible** We are looking for an experienced and highly organised **Bookkeeper** to work approximately **20 hours per week**, supporting a group of businesses operating across **Australia and the United States within the music and entertainment industry**. This role would suit someone who is confident working independently, is extremely detail-oriented, and has strong hands-on experience with **both Xero and QuickBooks**. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records across multiple entities and will need to be comfortable working with different currencies, jurisdictions, bank accounts and business structures. ## Key Responsibilities * Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple Australian and US entities * Maintain accounts using **Xero and QuickBooks** * Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payment platforms * Process and categorise income and expenses accurately * Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable * Enter and reconcile supplier invoices and payments * Maintain accurate records of artist, touring, production and business expenses * Track payments to artists, contractors, suppliers and other service providers * Assist with payroll and contractor payments where required * Maintain supporting documentation, invoices and receipts * Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations * Assist with multi-currency transactions and reconciliations * Prepare regular financial reports for management * Maintain clean and accurate balance sheets and general ledgers * Work with external accountants and tax advisers in both Australia and the US * Prepare bookkeeping records and supporting information for BAS, GST, sales tax, payroll and other statutory reporting as required * Assist with year-end preparation and provide information requested by accountants * Identify discrepancies or unusual transactions and proactively follow them up * Help improve bookkeeping systems, processes and financial controls across the businesses ## About You You will ideally have: * Strong professional bookkeeping experience * **Excellent working knowledge of both Xero and QuickBooks** * Experience managing the books for **multiple companies or entities** * Experience working with businesses operating in **Australia and the United States** * A good understanding of Australian bookkeeping requirements, including GST and BAS * Familiarity with US bookkeeping and accounting processes * Experience with multi-currency accounts and international transactions * Strong bank and credit-card reconciliation skills * Excellent attention to detail * The ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines * Strong communication skills and the confidence to follow up when information is missing * A high level of discretion when dealing with confidential financial information Experience in the **music, entertainment, touring, events or creative industries** would be highly regarded. ## The Role This is a **part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week**. There is flexibility around how the hours are structured, however we are looking for someone who can be consistently available throughout the week rather than completing all hours in one block. The role will involve working closely with the business owners and external accountants in Australia and the United States. We are looking for someone who doesn't simply enter transactions, but who takes **ownership of the books** — keeping accounts current, spotting issues, chasing missing information and making sure the financial records across all entities remain accurate and organised. ## To Apply Please provide: * A brief summary of your bookkeeping experience * Your experience using **Xero and QuickBooks** * Details of any experience working with Australian and US companies * Any experience within music, entertainment or other creative industries * Your availability * Your hourly rate * Your location and time zone We are looking for someone reliable and experienced who is interested in developing a long-term working relationship with the business.

title: Administration Assistant - Music Industry
description: # Administration & Artist Support Assistant **YoYo Management / YoYo Music** We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and digitally savvy **Administration & Artist Support Assistant** to work across our artist management and music business. This is a varied role suited to someone who loves organisation, is comfortable working independently and can bring structure to a fast-moving creative business. You will work across multiple artists and projects, helping us keep information, promotional materials, photographs, documents and day-to-day administration organised and up to date. A major initial focus of the role will be helping us **reorganise and streamline our digital filing systems and artist assets**, followed by taking responsibility for keeping those systems organised going forward. ## Key Responsibilities ### Artist Files, Photos & Promotional Assets * Reorganise and maintain digital folders for each of our artists. * Sort and catalogue artist photographs, press shots, live images, artwork, logos, videos and other promotional assets. * Ensure current and approved images and materials are clearly identified and easy for the team to access. * Archive outdated photographs, artwork and promotional materials. * Maintain organised folders for press kits, biographies, press releases, tour assets, social media content and other artist materials. * Ensure files are consistently and sensibly named so that information can be found quickly. * Help identify duplicate, missing or outdated files and clean up existing folder structures. * Maintain current versions of artist biographies, EPK materials, promotional photographs and other commonly requested assets. ### General Administration * Provide day-to-day administrative support across the business. * Organise and maintain company files, documents and records. * Assist with email administration and follow-ups where required. * Keep contact databases, mailing lists and industry contacts organised and up to date. * Assist with calendars, appointments, meetings and scheduling. * Prepare and organise documents, spreadsheets and information for meetings. * Follow up outstanding information, documents and approvals. * Assist with invoices, receipts and basic accounts administration where required. * Help maintain templates and systems for frequently used documents and processes. ### Artist & Project Support * Assist management with administration relating to releases, touring, promotion and artist projects. * Keep track of deadlines, deliverables and outstanding tasks across different artists. * Organise information relating to releases, press, marketing, touring and promotional campaigns. * Assist with tour administration including itineraries, accommodation information, travel documents and schedules when required. * Help prepare and distribute promotional materials to labels, publishers, agents, promoters, media and other industry partners. * Keep artist information and key documents current and readily accessible. ### Systems & Organisation We are particularly looking for someone who can look at the way we currently organise information and **help us make it better**. This will include: * Reviewing our existing Google Drive/Dropbox/shared folder structures. * Creating logical and consistent filing systems across all artists. * Developing simple naming conventions and folder structures. * Creating master folders and templates that can be replicated for new artists and projects. * Making sure important information isn't sitting in random emails, downloads folders or individual computers. * Helping establish straightforward administrative processes that the whole team can follow. * Maintaining those systems once they have been established. ## About You You will ideally be: * Exceptionally organised with strong attention to detail. * Someone who genuinely enjoys bringing order to messy folders, files and information. * Confident using Google Drive, Dropbox, Google Docs/Sheets, Microsoft Office and similar platforms. * Comfortable working with large numbers of photographs, digital assets and documents. * Tech confident and able to learn new software quickly. * Proactive — able to see what needs doing rather than waiting to be given every individual task. * Reliable and good at following tasks through to completion. * Able to prioritise when several things are happening at once. * Comfortable working in a creative environment where priorities can change quickly. * Discreet and trustworthy when dealing with confidential artist and business information. * A strong communicator with good written English. Experience in **music, entertainment, artist management, events, media or another creative industry would be an advantage**, but is not essential. Excellent organisational skills and the right attitude are more important. ## The Person We're Looking For This isn't a role where every day will look the same. One day you might be reorganising thousands of artist photographs and creating a clean promotional asset library; the next you could be updating an artist bio, organising travel information, chasing an outstanding document, updating a contact database or helping management prepare for a release or tour. We need someone who is comfortable becoming the **organisational backbone of the business** — someone who learns where everything is, understands what is happening across our artists and projects, and helps make sure things don't fall through the cracks. title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description: Location: Remote Type: Full-time Salary: Competitive To apply: Details at the bottom of the page Most supply chains at small brands run on hope. Someone places an order, assumes the supplier is on track, and finds out otherwise when stock runs out or a shipment arrives wrong. That's not how Säker operates. We run a methodical supply chain across three markets: US, Canada, and EU; with multiple suppliers, freight forwarders, and receiving warehouses moving simultaneously. The person in this role is the connective tissue. They make sure suppliers know what's expected, freight forwarders have what they need, warehouses are ready to receive, and nothing falls through the cracks between any of them. It's coordination work, and it matters. When it's done well, inventory flows and nobody notices. When it isn't, everything stops. If keeping complex operations quietly on track sounds like the kind of work you're good at, keep reading. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Supplier Coordination Keeping suppliers on schedule; confirming production timelines, following up on open orders, collecting documentation, and making sure nothing is missing before a shipment moves. Freight and Logistics Coordination Working with freight forwarders across air and sea lanes to book shipments, track movement, and flag delays before they become problems. Keeping all parties: suppliers, forwarders, and warehouses; aligned at every handoff. Warehouse Receiving Coordination Making sure receiving warehouses have what they need ahead of every inbound shipment. Confirming quantities, labels, and documentation are correct before goods arrive. Compliance and QC Documentation Collecting and filing test certificates, inspection reports, and supplier compliance documents. Coordinating third-party inspection scheduling and following up on findings. Administrative and Operational Support Maintaining purchase order records, updating inventory trackers, and keeping internal files organized. The behind-the-scenes work that keeps everything else running cleanly. HOW YOU'LL WORK You'll report directly to the Supply Chain & Inventory Planner. Direction comes from the Planner, with visibility to the founder on key operational decisions. Turnaround varies by task. Supplier follow-ups and shipment coordination move fast. Compliance documentation and PO administration move on longer timelines and require careful follow-through. You'll work primarily in Prediko, Sellerboard, Amazon Seller Central, and Google Workspace, with tasks tracked in ClickUp. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Shipments arrive on time, in full, and without surprises. Suppliers are followed up before anyone has to ask. Documentation is filed before it's needed. Warehouses are ready before goods arrive. The Inventory Planner spends less time on coordination and more time on planning. Nothing slips; not because someone caught it at the last minute, but because the system is being maintained well enough that last-minute catches aren't necessary. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 1–3 years in supply chain, procurement, or operations — consumer goods or e-commerce preferred Strong organizational skills and comfortable managing multiple open items across suppliers, timelines, and channels Clear written communicator in English; confident following up with external partners Comfortable working independently and figuring things out before asking Proficient in Google Workspace and Excel BONUS POINTS Experience with Amazon FBA, freight logistics, or third-party QC inspections Familiarity with Prediko, Sellerboard, or similar tools Background in apparel, outdoor, or consumer goods WHAT WE OFFER Real operational scope from day one: suppliers, freight, warehouses, and compliance all in one role A fast feedback loop with the Inventory Planner and founder, not layers of approval High standards, low politics, clear direction A brand with a real point of view, not another pet company chasing cuteness Competitive compensation and room to grow as the brand scales The chance to build something you can actually point to LOCATION AND WORK STYLE This role is fully remote. Compensation is competitive and based on experience. HOW TO APPLY Send an email to ---------- with: A short introduction Your portfolio One project you're proud of, and why Use the subject line: Supply Chain Coordinator - Your Name We care more about how you think than how your resume looks.

description: About the Role We are a growing US-based healthcare organization looking for a hands-on Marketing Technology & Web Specialist to join our team full-time. You will report directly to the CMO and be responsible for implementing and maintaining the technology behind our websites, landing pages, forms, tracking, attribution, and marketing integrations. This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can take a request and actually implement it, whether that means modifying a Webflow form, building a landing page, fixing a tracking pixel, connecting a new marketing platform, configuring a subdomain, or troubleshooting why attribution data is missing. You will also work directly with our vendors and other specialists when systems connect. For example, you may work with our call-tracking provider’s engineers to complete an integration, meet with our paid media team to troubleshoot conversion tracking, or work with our CRM & Automation Specialist to make sure lead data is passing correctly into our internal systems. What You’ll Be Responsible For Websites, Forms & Landing Pages * Maintain and update our Webflow website * Build and modify pages, forms, fields, dropdowns, and other website elements * Build, duplicate, and modify landing pages in Unbounce * Implement technical and layout changes for conversion-rate tests * Ensure pages and forms work properly across desktop and mobile * Maintain existing designs and styling provided by our creative team * Monitor and improve page performance and load speed * Troubleshoot website and form issues Marketing Tracking & Attribution * Configure, test, and maintain Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, GA4, and other marketing tracking * Manage our Google Tag Manager environment * Audit and troubleshoot tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and tracking scripts * Identify duplicate, conflicting, or broken tracking * Verify that forms, phone calls, and other conversions are attributed to the correct sources and campaigns * Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual leads * Make sure new pages, forms, and campaigns launch with the appropriate tracking in place Call Tracking & Marketing Integrations * Maintain the technical side of our WhatConverts call-tracking and attribution setup * Manage Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) and related tracking * Connect and configure new marketing tools and integrations * Work directly with software vendors and their technical teams when needed * Implement required changes on our side of integrations * Test integrations to verify that data is flowing correctly in both directions * Troubleshoot UTMs, GCLIDs, lead IDs, webhooks, forms, and other attribution data Experience with WhatConverts specifically is not required if you have experience with similar platforms such as CallRail and can learn new systems quickly. Working With Our Other Specialists You will work closely with our paid media team, creative agency, software vendors, and CRM & Automation Specialist. We have a separate CRM & Automation Specialist responsible for ClickUp, Make, Zapier, lead routing, internal workflows, and backend automations. You will not be responsible for taking over that role. Where the systems connect, you will work together. For example, if a Webflow form captures a UTM parameter but it does not appear correctly in our CRM, you may troubleshoot the website and tracking side while the CRM & Automation Specialist checks the backend automation and field mapping. Similarly, our paid media partners manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns. You will not manage the campaigns themselves, but you will work with them to make sure the technical tracking supporting those campaigns is implemented and working correctly. Our creative partners handle primary branding and graphic design. You should be able to implement and modify existing designs, but you do not need to be a graphic designer. Must-Have Skills * Webflow: Strong hands-on experience with Webflow, including forms, CMS, responsive layouts, styling, and modifying existing websites * Google Tag Manager: Strong experience with tags, triggers, variables, custom events, data layers, Preview Mode, and debugging * Conversion Tracking: Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and GA4 tracking * Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to investigate technical problems, identify the root cause, implement a solution, and verify that it works * Marketing Integrations: Comfortable working with forms, webhooks, attribution data, tracking scripts, and connections between marketing platforms * English Communication: Strong written and spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking directly with the CMO, vendors, developers, and other technical specialists Strongly Preferred * Unbounce * JavaScript, HTML, and CSS * Chrome DevTools or similar browser debugging tools * Cloudflare and DNS management * WhatConverts, CallRail, or other DNI/call-tracking platforms * Experience with UTMs, GCLIDs, and marketing attribution * API and webhook integrations * Experience troubleshooting website-to-CRM data flows What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically curious, and takes ownership. If the CMO asks you to modify a form, you should be able to make the change. If a tracking pixel is not working, you should be able to investigate it. If a new platform needs to be integrated, you should be able to implement the technical work on our side and work directly with the platform’s engineers when necessary. You are not replacing our paid media team, CRM & Automation Specialist, or creative agency. You are the technical person on the marketing team who makes sure the technology they depend on works correctly. How to Apply Please include a brief 5–8 sentence answer to the following scenario in your application: Imagine you are auditing our Google Ads tracking and suspect that our lead conversion tag is double-counting conversions, causing Google Ads to report more leads than we are actually receiving. Describe the exact step-by-step process you would use to determine whether duplicate conversions are actually firing on the website, what you would examine to identify the root cause, and how you would verify that the issue has been resolved. title: Supply Chain Manager
description: Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain. The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels. Where the Supply Chain Coordinator is responsible for day to day execution, the Supply Chain Manager sets the framework, the priorities and the improvement agenda. The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain. Responsibilities: 1. Inventory and planning - Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand variability and actual lead times. - Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints. - Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal peaks and deal periods. - Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed threshold, by finance. - Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers. - Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels. 2. Network and logistics - Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed. - Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail. - Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold. - Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker. - Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance. 3. Supplier performance - Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations. - Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up. - Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager. - Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings. 4. Performance and reporting - Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement. - Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation. - Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners. - Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals. Must have 1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network. 2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process. 3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs. 4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is. 5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool. 6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment. 7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation. Decisive in practice 1. Works independently and takes initiative without having the work laid out in advance. 2. Has previously had at least one direct report. 3. Operates effectively in an environment without heavily embedded systems and documented processes. 4. Pushes back on management and supports a differing view with figures. Nice to have, not required 1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background. 2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations. 3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one. Editing customers' portraits illustrations (Minimum 7 an hour.) Editing designs before they are sent to customers. Desirable skills & experience. Knowledge in navigating & using the Google Drive. Clean editing skills using your chosen editing software. Attention to detail. Proven ability to work in a time sensitive environment with strict deadlines & quotas. Excellent English language skills & understanding in order to understand customers specific editing requests and ad hoc communication. Experience with using Shopify. Ability to follow instructions carefully and fully. A very keen eye for detail when quality checking customers designs. File organization. File and data security.

title: Product Developer — 3D CAD · Work from home + paid travel to China
job_title: Product Developer — 3D CAD · Work from home + paid travel to China
description: PRODUCT DEVELOPER (INDUSTRIAL DESIGN / ENGINEERING) Design real products, sold worldwide. Full-time. Work from home 80%. 9-5 Philippine time. 5 EUR per hour. Travel to Manila and to our China office, fully paid by us. =============================================== READ THIS PART FIRST =============================================== We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are a Dutch company that went from zero to millions in revenue in a few years. We design and sell our own products under six brands: cookware, bathroom, sleep and home. Around 1.5 million units sold. Everything is designed in-house, made in our own China network, and shipped from our own warehouses. Most of our Filipino team members have been with us since the beginning. That is not an a ---------- . We hire slowly, we hire carefully, and once you are in, we invest heavily in you. We now need one more Product Developer to work directly with me on new products. If you are looking for a quiet job where nobody asks much of you, this is the wrong post. If you want to build a career, own real products, travel for work, and get paid more as you grow, keep reading. =============================================== WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO =============================================== You join a product development team of four. You will work on products from the first sketch to the moment a customer opens the box. Turn ideas, market gaps and customer complaints into real product concepts. Model parts and assemblies in 3D CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks). Create technical drawings and specs our factories can build from. Work with our engineers in Suzhou and Yancheng on samples, tolerances and quality. Review samples, find what is wrong, and iterate until it is right. Think about materials, cost, packaging, and how the product will survive shipping. Kill your own bad ideas fast and move on to the next one. You will not be doing one small task forever. Our products go from concept to market in weeks, not seasons. You will see your work in the real world quickly. =============================================== WORKING FROM HOME, AND COMING TO US =============================================== 80 percent of the time you work from home. Your own setup, your own space, 9-5 Philippine time so you overlap with the team. The other 20 percent is where it gets interesting. We meet the Manila team in person on a regular basis. I will fly you to our China office when a project needs you there: sample reviews, factory visits, working next to our engineers. Within your first six months we will sit down together in person, in Manila or in China. We arrange and pay for everything. Visa, flights, accommodation, food. It costs you nothing. You do not need to have travelled before. You do not need to figure out the paperwork. That is our job. What you do need is the willingness to get on a plane. If flying abroad for work is not something you want, please do not apply. If it is something you have always wanted and never had the chance to do, this may be the best opportunity on this website. =============================================== WHAT WE DO FOR YOU =============================================== Let me be direct about what we are offering, because it is not just a salary. A STABLE JOB. Our Filipino team members have been with us for years. We are not a project-based agency that lets people go when a client leaves. We sell our own products, and we are growing. AN ACTIVE GROWTH TRACK. Not a vague promise. We sit down with you, set goals for the company and personal goals for you, and give you more responsibility as you prove you can carry it. More responsibility means more money. The people who came in early and grew with us are now the ones running things. ROOM TO MAKE MISTAKES. You will make expensive mistakes. A tool that was cut wrong, a sample order that was a waste, a product that flops. That is part of developing products, and it is part of learning. We do not punish honest mistakes. We look at what went wrong, fix the process, and move on. What we do not accept is hiding a mistake, or not learning from it. DIRECT ACCESS. You work with me, not through five layers of management. When you have a good idea, you can get it made. =============================================== WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU =============================================== We do not hire just anyone. Our standards before you get in are high, and they should be, because of how much we put into you afterwards. REQUIRED: Strong 3D CAD skills in Fusion 360 or SolidWorks. You can model parts and assemblies and produce drawings a factory can work from. Show us. A background in industrial design, product design or mechanical engineering, or you taught yourself to the same level. We care about what you can do, not which school you went to. Real interest in physical products. You are the kind of person who picks up an object and thinks about why it was made that way. Good written and spoken English. You will be talking with Dutch and Chinese colleagues daily. Reliable internet and a computer that can run CAD properly. Willingness to travel abroad, with our full support. NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED: Experience with injection moulding, casting, stamping or sheet metal. Rendering skills such as KeyShot, Blender or Fusion render. Experience talking directly with Chinese suppliers. Anything you have designed and actually had made, even a personal project. WHAT MATTERS MORE THAN YOUR CV: You take ownership. When something is unclear, you ask. When something is broken, you say so. You do not wait to be told what to do next. You want to be good at this, not just employed. Years of experience is not a filter for us. If you are early in your career but genuinely talented and hungry, apply. If you have ten years behind you, apply. We will judge you on your work and your attitude. =============================================== THE OFFER =============================================== 5 EUR per hour. Roughly 330 PHP per hour, around 58,000 PHP per month at current rates. 8 hours a day, 9-5 Philippine time, Monday to Friday. Full-time and long-term. We are hiring for years, not for a project. All travel, visa and accommodation costs covered by us. Pay grows as your responsibility grows. This is the starting point, not the ceiling. =============================================== HOW TO APPLY =============================================== Do not send a generic application. We read every one, and generic applications go straight to the bottom. Send us the following. 1. YOUR PORTFOLIO. A link or a PDF. We want to see 3D CAD work: parts, assemblies, drawings. Personal projects are fine. Show us the process, not just pretty renders. 2. ANSWERS TO THESE FOUR QUESTIONS. Keep them short and specific. Which CAD software do you use, how long have you used it, and what is the most complex thing you have modelled? Go to ---------- , look at our brands, and pick one product. What would you change about it, and why? Why do you want this job specifically, and where do you want to be in three years? Are you willing to fly to Manila and to China for work, with all costs covered by us? Yes or no. 3. PUT THE WORD SAMPLE IN YOUR SUBJECT LINE so we know you read the whole post. If your application stands out, we will schedule a call. If the call goes well, we will give you a small test project, so we both know what we are getting into. We are taking our time to find the right person. If that is you, this could be the job you stay in for the next ten years. =============================================== Kranis B.V. Poeldijk, Netherlands Manila, Philippines Suzhou and Yancheng, China
