You will be responsible for the visual craft of our videos: editing, B-roll, typography, titles, motion graphics, on-screen text, transitions, diagrams and visual pacing. We want someone who understands that great motion design is often about restraint. Our aim is not to make every moment move. It is to create videos that feel clean, intelligent, contemporary and consistent. The Studio’s quality philosophy is that production should support the learner rather than compete for their attention. What you’ll do You will receive AI presenter footage produced by our Course Producer, together with scripts, scene breakdowns and visual directions. Your responsibilities will include: Editing AI presenter footage into polished final videos Creating motion graphics in Adobe After Effects or similar platforms Creating B-roll using AI video generation Adding appropriate B-roll and supplementary footage Designing and animating titles, headings and key phrases Creating simple diagrams, frameworks, comparisons and process animations Adding screenshots, illustrations and supporting visual assets Creating elegant transitions between scenes Using punch-ins, reframing and other editing techniques where appropriate Integrating music and sound design when required Ensuring consistent typography, sizing, spacing and animation behaviour Maintaining visual consistency across a series or programme Developing reusable After Effects templates and graphic systems Exporting finished videos to the required specifications Reviewing completed videos and identifying opportunities to improve pacing, clarity or visual communication You will also help us gradually establish a clear post-production system for each member of our AI faculty, including consistent approaches to typography, graphics, B-roll and visual treatment. The visual style we are looking for One of the reasons we are creating this role is that we want greater visual discipline. We are specifically looking for someone who understands that professional post-production does not mean adding more things. We want: fewer fonts, used consistently purposeful rather than constant movement clean and restrained motion graphics strong visual hierarchy intelligent typography graphics that clarify ideas B-roll that genuinely supports the narrative thoughtful pacing consistency across videos subtle variation between faculty members without creating visual chaos A good editor should sometimes watch a section and d ---------- that the best thing to add is nothing. Our internal visual-production guidance describes the desired style as “thoughtful, clean, human, intelligent and practical,” with clarity prioritised over decoration. What you’ll work on The Studio produces several kinds of content, including: educational course videos YouTube videos short-form social media videos programme trailers faculty introduction videos explainer videos framework and model animations promotional content Some videos may be largely presenter-led with only occasional visual support. Others may require substantially more motion graphics, B-roll or visual storytelling. Your judgement about the difference will be important. Essential skills We’re looking for someone with strong practical experience in: Adobe After Effects Adobe Premiere Pro motion graphics video editing typography for video titles and lower thirds B-roll integration visual storytelling pacing and rhythm working with brand guidelines organising video projects and assets You should be comfortable creating motion graphics yourself rather than relying entirely on templates. You should also have a strong eye for design and be able to recognise when a video feels visually busy, inconsistent or over-produced. Particularly valuable experience It would be useful, though not essential, if you have experience with: educational or training videos YouTube content talking-head or presenter-led content AI-generated video HeyGen or Synthesia animated diagrams and frameworks social media video sound design colour correction Photoshop or Illustrator building reusable After Effects template systems How the role fits into the team You will work closely with our Course Producer. The workflow will broadly be: Course Architect → Course Producer → Post-Production Editor → Review The Course Producer will create and refine the AI presenter performance, including voice, delivery, pronunciation, lip-sync and scene generation. You will then take those scenes and create the finished visual experience. This separation allows the Producer to concentrate on getting the AI performance right while you concentrate on specialist editing, motion design and visual polish. You may also work directly with our Course Architect when a particular framework, model or teaching idea needs to be communicated visually. We work as an integrated Studio rather than a production line. Editors are encouraged to notice when a graphic is unnecessary, when a visual could explain something better, or when removing something would improve the finished lesson. That kind of contribution is explicitly part of how we want the team to work. What good looks like After a few weeks, we would expect to see: significantly more polished finished videos consistent fonts and typography recognisable graphic systems fewer unnecessary animations better use of B-roll stronger visual hierarchy clear stylistic consistency within each faculty member’s content reusable animation templates that speed up future production a recognisable visual identity emerging across The Coaches Business Studio less post-production work being carried by the Course Producer Most importantly, the editing should make the teaching easier and more enjoyable to follow. The person we’re looking for We are likely to work well together if you: care about the details of your craft have strong visual taste can explain why you have made a creative decision are comfortable receiving feedback can distinguish personal preference from good design enjoy creating systems as well as individual videos take ownership of the finished result notice inconsistencies without waiting for someone else to point them out enjoy experimenting without becoming attached to every experiment We are building something new, so we value curiosity and initiative alongside technical skill. title: Meta Creative Strategist & AI Ad Creator
job_title: Meta Creative Strategist & AI Ad Creator
description: We run a growing portfolio of consumer brands in the New Age/western spiritual space, and we are looking for someone to help own our Meta advertising creative. This is NOT a normal graphic design job. And I am NOT looking for Meta ads management. If you are looking for a role where someone gives you a headline, image and exact instructions and you make it look nice, this is probably not for you. We are looking for someone who can: Research → Ideate → Create → Analyze → Iterate You should be able to understand an offer and its customer, develop your own advertising angles, write strong hooks, create visual assets using AI, turn them into finished ads in Figma, and then learn from the performance data. Your main responsibility will be creating high-performing Meta ad concepts, primarily static ads. You will: Research customers, competitors and advertising trends. Study Meta Ad Library. Develop new hooks, angles and creative concepts. Write short direct-response headlines and copy. Create finished static ads in Figma. Use Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro heavily for image generation, editing and creative production. Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and ideation. Create meaningful variations of winning ads. Review Meta performance data. Identify patterns in winners and losers. Build new creative tests based on what we learn. We do NOT want 20 versions of the same ad with slightly different colors. We want genuinely different advertising ideas. Our ads may include AI-generated imagery, testimonials, screenshots, text messages, native social posts, reviews, editorial or news-style concepts, curiosity-driven ads, emotional direct-response ads, simple text-heavy ads, highly designed ads, and deliberately ugly or native-looking ads. The best ad is the one that performs. Not the one that looks prettiest. Our brands operate within areas such as tarot readings, psychic readings, love and relationship guidance, astrology, spirituality, manifestation, personal insight, and celestial or seasonal events. You do NOT need to personally believe in tarot or astrology. You DO need to be comfortable working in this niche and interested in understanding the psychology of the customer. Our preferred stack is: Figma — main design tool. Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro — heavily used for generating and manipulating visual assets. ChatGPT and other AI tools — research, ideation, hooks and creative development. Meta Ad Library — research. Video skills are a bonus. If you can also make simple 15–30 second ads using CapCut or Premiere, b-roll, AI voiceovers, slideshows or animated statics, that is valuable. However, creative strategy and static ads are the priority. The most important part of this role is that we need someone who can THINK OF THE ADS, not just make them. Eventually, we want you to be able to come to us and say: “This angle is outperforming the others. I think this is why. Here are six new concepts I want to test next.” That is much more valuable to us than perfect Photoshop technique. You are probably a good fit if: You understand direct-response advertising. You constantly notice interesting ads. You enjoy thinking about why people click and buy. You can generate lots of different creative ideas. You can write strong hooks and headlines. You are good with Figma. You are very comfortable using AI. You move quickly. You like testing ideas. You are comfortable being judged by performance data. You are not emotionally attached to your designs. Experience creating paid Facebook or Instagram advertising is strongly preferred. Experience with ecommerce, DTC, digital products, info products, lead generation or performance marketing is also useful. You are probably NOT a good fit if: Your background is mainly logos and branding. You need detailed creative briefs for every ad. Your main goal is making everything look beautiful. You dislike writing copy. You rarely use AI tools. You do not care about advertising psychology. You are not interested in performance data. This is intended to be a long-term, full-time role. We operate multiple brands and test significant volumes of advertising creative. Someone who becomes genuinely good at finding winning creative concepts will have substantial room to grow with us and take on increasing responsibility across the portfolio. How to apply: 1. Send your portfolio, especially paid Facebook or Meta static ads. 2. Send your three best ads. For each one, briefly tell us: What was the angle? Who was the customer? Why did you think it would work? Do you know how it performed? 3. Tell us about your Figma experience and how regularly you use it. 4. Tell us about your AI workflow. What image-generation or editing tools do you use? We are particularly interested in experience with Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro. Tell us what you actually use AI for rather than simply saying you know how to use it. 5. If you can create short-form video ads, include your three best examples. 6. Find ONE Meta ad currently running from any company that you think is excellent. Send us the ad or a screenshot and explain why you think it works. This part of the application is important. 7. Start your application with the words: PURPLE TAROT Applications that do not include this will not be considered. Strong applicants will be invited to complete a short paid creative test.

Our team is made up of ambitious, intelligent and creative people who move quickly, test aggressively and constantly look for ways to improve. We are now looking for an exceptional **Creative Strategist / AI Static Ad Expert** to join our team long-term. This is NOT simply a graphic design position. We are looking for someone who understands **direct-response advertising, creative strategy, AI and consumer psychology** and can take winning ads, understand WHY they are working, and develop new variations and completely new concepts around them. Our main focus is **static advertising**, although video editing experience is a major advantage. Job Responsibilities: * Create high-quality static ad variations based on our existing winning creatives. * Analyse winning advertisements and identify the hooks, angles, messaging and visual elements responsible for their performance. * Develop completely new creative concepts rather than simply copying existing advertisements. * Create new hooks, angles and visual approaches for different stages of customer awareness. * Develop **Top of Funnel creative concepts**, including native-style ads with longer-form text and copy designed to educate, create curiosity and introduce customers to new problems or solutions. * Use AI extensively to speed up creative research, ideation, copywriting and production. * Use **Claude** to help develop creative concepts, angles, hooks, copy and detailed prompts. * Turn these concepts into strong visual prompts that can be produced using tools such as **Gemini** and other leading AI image-generation platforms. * Continuously create multiple variations of winning concepts for creative testing. * Research competitors and advertising trends to identify new creative opportunities. * Work closely with the rest of our marketing team to develop creatives around products we are currently scaling. * Understand feedback and rapidly iterate creatives based on performance and direction. * If experienced with video editing, create video variations and new video concepts alongside static creatives. * Constantly stay up to date with new AI platforms, models, workflows and creative-generation techniques. Skills & Capabilities: * Strong experience creating **direct-response static advertisements**, preferably for e-commerce brands. * Excellent understanding of creative strategy and what makes someone stop scrolling, read an ad and take action. * Strong understanding of customer psychology, hooks, angles, awareness levels and advertising concepts. * Highly experienced with AI and genuinely interested in staying ahead of new AI developments. * Very familiar with **Claude** for creative ideation, copywriting, concept development and prompt creation. * Experience using **Gemini** and other AI image-generation tools to turn concepts into finished creatives. * Familiar with current AI tools for image generation, image editing, copywriting, creative research and content creation. * Able to look at a winning advertisement and create multiple fresh variations without destroying the elements that made the original successful. * Able to develop completely new concepts independently rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. * Strong visual judgement and extremely high attention to detail. * Experience with Photoshop, Canva or similar creative software is beneficial. * **Video editing experience is a major bonus**, particularly for creating variations of existing winning video ads. * Fluent English is REQUIRED. You must be able to communicate ideas, concepts and feedback clearly and professionally. * Familiar and comfortable working through **Slack**. * Highly intelligent, proactive and capable of solving problems independently. * Coachable and able to take feedback without needing constant supervision. * Comfortable working in a **fast-paced environment** where creatives are constantly being tested and improved. Who We're Looking For: We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a design and recreates it. We want someone who can think. You should be able to look at a product, customer avatar or winning advertisement and start thinking: * What other angles could we test? * What new hooks could work? * Why did this creative perform? * How could we create 10 genuinely different variations? * What would work for a customer who has never heard of this problem? * What visual could stop someone scrolling? * How can AI help us produce and test these ideas faster? We want someone who becomes an important part of our creative operation and helps us continuously find new winning advertisements. Long-Term Opportunity: We are a fast-paced and growing team, and we are specifically looking for someone who wants a long-term position rather than another short freelance project. The right person will have the opportunity to grow alongside the company, take on greater responsibility and increase their compensation as they prove their value. If you consistently impress us with your ideas, work ethic and creative performance, your position and compensation will always be reviewed accordingly. Trial & Compensation: We will initially begin with a **1-week paid trial**. This gives us both an opportunity to see how well you understand our workflow, creative standards, communication and expectations. If the trial is successful, we intend to move you into a **full-time long-term role** within our team. The hourly rate will be discussed during the interview and will depend on your experience, creative ability and overall fit. We are willing to pay well for genuinely exceptional talent. How to Apply: Please send us: * Examples of static ads you have personally created. * Your portfolio of direct-response/e-commerce creative work. * Examples of AI-generated creatives you have produced. * Which AI platforms you currently use regularly. * How you currently use Claude, Gemini or any other AI tool within your creative workflow. * Any video advertisements you have edited, if applicable. * A short explanation of how you would approach creating new variations from an existing winning static ad. title: Client Ops Associate
description: Full Time | Remote | Reports to Head of Ops/Delivery About the company CivSav is a digital marketing agency built specifically for agriculture and heavy machinery companies across the USA. We run SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, and email/lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo) for a growing roster of ag clients. We're also a team that leans into new tools and AI, and we want people who are genuinely curious about where all of it is headed. About the role We're hiring a Client Ops Associate to be the operational backbone of our client relationships. This is not a call-center support role and it's not a senior strategist role — it's the seat where someone proves they can be trusted with a client relationship, and grows from there. You'll start by making sure nothing falls through the cracks: onboarding new clients, keeping tabs on what's been delivered versus what's been promised, and handling the day-to-day questions clients have. If you're good at this — organized, calm under pressure, and someone clients trust — this role is the direct path to owning a full book of clients as a Key Account Manager. We are deliberately hiring this as an assistant-level role with a real growth path, not a dead-end support job. The person we hire in twelve months should look nothing like the person we hire today. What success looks like New clients are onboarded smoothly: accounts and access collected without chasing, kickoff calls run on time, nothing missed. Clients get fast, clear answers to routine questions, and you know exactly when something needs to go to a specialist or to leadership instead of you handling it yourself. Nothing executed for a client goes untracked. If someone asks "where are we on X client," you have the answer in under a minute. You build a track record of good judgment — knowing what you can d ---------- on your own and what needs a second opinion — that earns you more client ownership over time. Key responsibilities Customer support First point of contact for routine client questions and requests. Follow a clear escalation path: technical issues to the relevant specialist, anything involving expectations, money, or a frustrated client to your manager. Keep client communication professional, timely, and honest — we do not overpromise to make a moment easier. Onboarding Run new clients through our onboarding process: collecting domain, ad account, Klaviyo, and analytics access. Onboarding clients on Meta and GHL. Schedule and run kickoff calls using our onboarding playbook. Make sure every new client is fully set up and hands off cleanly to the delivery team. Project management assistance Track what's been executed for each client across SEO, ads, email, and web — using our shared tracking system. Flag work that's stalled or at risk before it becomes a client complaint. Keep a clear, current record any manager can check without needing to ask you directly. Growth path Months 0–3: support, onboarding, and tracking, fully trained on our systems, all client-facing work reviewed before it goes out. Months 3–6: independently own a small group of standard-tier clients — ongoing check-ins, reporting, routine decisions — with regular check-ins with your manager. Months 6–12+: full ownership of an assigned client roster as a Key Account Manager, with review shifting to spot-checks and true escalations only. Progression is based on demonstrated judgment and reliability, not just time served. About you — required Excellent written and verbal English communication. Highly organized — you naturally track details without being told twice. Comfortable talking to clients directly, including when a conversation is a little uncomfortable. AI-savvy and genuinely interested in AI — you keep up with what it can do and you're smart about where it actually helps. Genuinely ambitious about growing into a client-ownership role, not just looking for a support job. Reliable internet, quiet workspace for client calls, and availability during US business hours. About you — preferred Marketing agency experience is a real advantage here. If you've worked in a marketing or digital agency before — client success, account coordination, or delivery — you'll have a meaningful head start. You'll already understand the rhythm of juggling multiple clients, the difference between what's promised and what's delivered, and how to keep a client calm while specialists do the work behind the scenes. It's not a hard requirement, but candidates who've lived in an agency environment will move through our growth path faster. Beyond that, the following help: Prior experience in customer success or account coordination. Familiarity with basic digital marketing concepts (you don't need to run SEO or ads, but you should be able to follow a conversation about them). Familiarity with GHL and Meta Business Suite. Experience with a task-tracking tool (ClickUp, Jira, spreadsheets, or similar). How to apply We read every application carefully, and we pay close attention to how instructions are followed — it tells us a lot before we ever get on a call. Send us a message through this platform. In it, include the following, in order: Your first sentence must be your headline: "Hi, I'm YOUR NAME from CITY/COUNTRY and I'm applying for the Client Ops Associate role." Three sentences on the most relevant experience you have for this specific role. Three sentences on a time you had to stay organized while juggling multiple people's expectations at once — what happened, and how you kept it from falling apart. Three sentences on where you want to be in two years, and why this role is a step toward that. Your name, email, and phone number. In one sentence: what's the single best thing AI has brought to the way you work? A short Loom video (2–3 minutes) telling us why you're a good fit for this role. Loom is free — sign up at ---------- , record straight from your browser, and paste the shareable link in your message (set so anyone with the link can view). Keep it under 3 minutes. We're looking at how you communicate and think on your feet, not production quality. Attach your current resume or CV. Candidates who follow these instructions completely move to the next stage, which includes a short scenario exercise designed to show us how you think under a bit of pressure — not to trick you, but to make sure we're both confident before we ever put you in a room with a client.

If you have never worked in cold calling, outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment setting, please do not apply. What You’ll Be Doing Making high-volume outbound cold calls to homeowners Following a proven script without sounding robotic Building quick rapport with homeowners Handling common objections Booking qualified free roof inspection appointments Entering appointment information accurately Maintaining strong daily call activity and attendance Communicating results clearly with management Who We Want You should be: Confident on the phone Persistent without being rude or pushy Comfortable hearing “no” many times throughout the day Able to control a conversation and guide it toward an appointment Energetic and motivated throughout a full calling shift Reliable and consistent Able to speak clear, fluent English A strong accent is okay as long as homeowners in the United States can easily understand you. Required Experience You must have previous experience in at least one of the following: Cold calling Appointment setting Telemarketing Outbound sales B2C lead generation Applicants with experience in roofing, solar, home improvement, insurance, real estate, or similar homeowner-focused industries will be strongly preferred. Technical Requirements Reliable computer Fast and dependable internet connection Quality headset Quiet work environment Ability to work U.S. business hours Compensation Hourly base pay Performance bonuses for qualified appointments Opportunity for higher pay based on consistent results Long-term position available for top performers We care much more about results, reliability, and phone skills than fancy resumes. Please send: Your name How many years of cold-calling or appointment-setting experience you have The industries you have cold called for Your expected hourly rate Your internet speed The hours you are available to work A voice recording between 30–60 seconds In your voice recording, say: “Hi, my name is [Your Name]. title: Family Law Intake Specialist (Remote)

title: Digital Marketing  and Ecommerce Merchandiser
description: # WooCommerce Product Merchandising Assistant We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce Product Merchandising Assistant based in the Philippines to help organize and link related products on our e-commerce website. This position requires prior hands-on experience working in the backend of WordPress and WooCommerce. You must also have previous experience in e-commerce marketing, product merchandising, cross-selling, upselling, or managing related products. ## Primary Responsibilities Your main responsibility will be setting up “Frequently Bought Together” product recommendations within our WooCommerce website. We will provide you with a Google Drive spreadsheet identifying which products should be linked together. You will: * Review the product combinations provided in the spreadsheet. * Locate the correct products in the WordPress/WooCommerce backend. * Accurately link the designated frequently bought together products. * Verify product names, SKUs, sizes, variations, and other relevant information. * Confirm that every product combination matches the spreadsheet. * Track your completed work and update the spreadsheet. * Review the completed product combinations with our team. * Make any necessary corrections before the recommendations are published. * Help identify missing products, incorrect links, duplicate products, or combinations that do not make sense. * Maintain consistent and accurate merchandising throughout the website. You will not be expected to d ---------- all the product combinations yourself. We will provide clear instructions and a spreadsheet showing which products should be linked. However, we want someone with enough e-commerce merchandising experience to recognize potential mistakes and make useful recommendations. ## Required Experience Applicants must have: * Prior hands-on experience with WooCommerce. * Prior experience working in the WordPress backend. * Experience linking related products, frequently bought together products, upsells, or cross-sells. * Previous experience in e-commerce marketing or product merchandising. * Experience working with products, SKUs, variations, and categories. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Experience using Google Sheets or Google Drive. * Good written and spoken English. * The ability to follow detailed instructions and complete repetitive work accurately. * Reliable internet access and dependable communication. ## Preferred Qualifications The following experience is helpful but not required: * Experience merchandising apparel, military products, outdoor equipment, or websites with a large product catalog. * Experience with WooCommerce frequently bought together plugins. * Experience creating product bundles or improving average order value. * Basic knowledge of conversion optimization and online shopping behavior. * Experience working with U.S.-based e-commerce companies. ## What We Are Looking For The right person will be: * Extremely accurate and detail-oriented. * Comfortable working with a large product catalog. * Able to distinguish between similar products, sizes, colors, and variations. * Dependable and consistent. * Comfortable asking questions when instructions or product combinations are unclear. * Able to identify and report mistakes instead of guessing. * Interested in a potentially long-term working relationship. Accuracy is more important than speed. Linking the wrong products can create a poor customer experience, so every product combination must be carefully verified. ## Application Instructions To apply, please answer the following questions: 1. How many years of experience do you have working with WordPress and WooCommerce? 2. Describe the WooCommerce work you have completed in previous positions. 3. Have you previously set up frequently bought together products, related products, cross-sells, upsells, or product bundles? Please explain. 4. What experience do you have with e-commerce marketing or product merchandising? 5. Which WooCommerce plugins or product merchandising tools have you used? 6. Have you worked with products containing multiple sizes, colors, variations, or SKUs? 7. What steps would you take to make sure the products you link match the spreadsheet accurately? Please begin your application with the words **“WooCommerce Merchandising”** so we know you carefully read the entire job description.

title: Executive Outreach & Administration
description: 𝐀𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐮𝐬 Think Acquisition is a business brokerage. We help business owners buy and sell businesses, and we specialise in the property industry: estate and letting agents, block management, surveying and holiday let management. We are a team of five at present and we are growing. We are now looking for an experienced outreach or administration executive to join us. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐨𝐥𝐞 This role focuses on setting up outreach campaigns, dealing with inbound responses, booking meetings and updating CRMs. You will prepare and run campaigns on behalf of our clients, look after the responses that come back, book the resulting meetings into our deal leads’ diaries, and keep our records accurate and current. There is no cold calling and no selling. Your job is to open doors politely and professionally in our voice, then hand the conversation over to the deal lead. It is a role for someone who takes real satisfaction in accuracy, follow-through and a system that stays tidy. 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 Preparing and running campaigns - Preparing target data for each campaign: filtering, cleaning and checking contact lists before anything goes out - Building campaigns to a set process, merging client and target details into approved templates so every piece is correctly personalised - Proofreading everything thoroughly for spelling, formatting and merge errors before it is submitted - Submitting all campaigns for director approval and launching only once they are signed off - Keeping the outreach timetable up to date so the team always knows what has gone out and when Managing responses - Checking for inbound responses twice a day, morning and afternoon, and replying promptly - Responding in a warm, professional tone: closing down a polite no, answering questions from those who want more information, and moving interested owners towards a meeting - Working from our response guidance so replies stay consistent and on message - Following up at set intervals and ahead of booked meetings Appointment setting - Booking meetings into the right deal lead’s diary, offering a choice of times across different days and within our booking rules - Confirming the best contact details and gathering any useful background on the person - Briefing the deal lead in writing so they go into every meeting prepared - Records and reporting - Updating the client CRM the same day a response comes in: status, date, method, notes and, where given, the reason behind a no - Maintaining the shared call lists the wider team works from, and updating them regularly with outcomes - Keeping reporting accurate enough that a client could look at it at any moment without warning 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 Essential: - Proven experience in a comparable outreach, appointment setting, sales support or administration role. This is not an entry level position - Meticulous attention to detail. You spot the missing merge field, the wrong company name or the odd stray capital before anyone else does - Excellent written English and a natural, professional tone. You will be writing to business owners on our clients’ behalf - Genuinely organised. You work from a process, finish what you start, and keep records current rather than catching up at the end of the week - Comfortable with data: spreadsheets, CSV files, filtering and CRM systems - Confident with outreach and CRM software, and quick to pick up systems that are new to you - Happy to work within an approval process. Nothing goes out unchecked and nothing is improvised - Discreet, with sound judgement. You will be handling confidential information about businesses and their owners - Reliable and self-managing, with a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work - Available to work UK hours, between 8am and 6pm UK time 𝐇𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐟𝐮𝐥, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐥: - Experience in the UK property sector: estate agency, lettings, block management, surveying or holiday let management - Experience supporting a small team, where you are trusted to run your own workload 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 Type: Self-employed contractor, fully remote Hours: 35.7 hours per week, worked between 8am and 6pm UK time Start date: September/October Onboarding: Interview process, short trial task & Skills test 𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐲 Send your CV and a short covering note. In your note, please tell us about your relevant experience and about a piece of work you were responsible for where accuracy really mattered and how you made sure you got it right.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description: *** Please read through the entire post before applying. Thanks! *** *** About the Role *** If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it! Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals. This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals. If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading. *** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP *** To succeed here, you need to live these three values: Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision. Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team. Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable. *** Role Overview *** This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs. *** Core Responsibilities *** Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation. Collaborative Design: Act as the internal design resource for our video editors. You will build the lower thirds, callouts, and technical diagrams their edits need. Web and Digital Assets: Design high-fidelity web page elements and marketing collateral that fit our brand and our clients' technical standards. Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look. Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here. *** Required Qualifications *** Technical Stack: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or similar motion and design software. Portfolio: A strong reel of explainer and motion graphics work, plus a portfolio of clean, functional graphic design (web elements, technical icons, diagrams). Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines. Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress. *** Bonus / Preferred Skills *** - 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar) - Technical illustration or data and diagram visualization - Brand and identity design - Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content - Familiarity with ---------- or structured feedback workflows - Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects *** Compensation *** Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill. This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability. Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP). Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP). [*Conversions are approximate.] *** A Note on AI and Judgment *** At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt. If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now. *** How to Apply *** Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job. - Set your subject line to: "Motivated Motion Graphics Artist - [Your Name]" - Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP). - Provide a link to your best motion and static design work. No portfolio means no consideration. - State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section. - In exactly two sentences, describe a specific time you had to fix a mistake you made in a motion graphics project. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff. - Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only. - Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list. Thanks for your time and genuine interest!

You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume. Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress. *** Bonus / Preferred Skills *** - Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar) - Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers - Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content - Familiarity with ---------- or structured feedback workflows - Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects *** Compensation *** Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. No portfolio means no consideration. - State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section. - In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. title: AEROSPACE FOOTAGE SOURCING
description: AEROSPACE FOOTAGE SOURCING BRIEF CHANNEL CONCEPT We produce narrated documentary compilations about real aviation and space emergencies, engineering failures, safety tests and close calls. Our schedule alternates between: * One NASA/space video * One aviation video Your job is to find original, high-quality footage from official sources, confirm its usage status and organize it for the writer and editor. Do not download footage from other documentary or compilation channels. PRIMARY NASA SOURCES Search these official resources: 1. NASA Image and Video Library ---------- 2. NASA mission pages ---------- 3. NASA History ---------- 4. NASA Scientific Visualization Studio ---------- 5. NASA Technical Reports Server ---------- 6. NASA+ ---------- 7. National Archives Catalog ---------- HOW TO SEARCH NASA FOOTAGE Search by the mission name, mission number, astronaut, spacecraft and i ---------- . Example searches: * Apollo 13 mission footage * Apollo 13 mission audio * Gemini VIII recovery * Gemini 8 emergency * Apollo 12 lightning launch * STS-41D pad abort * STS-51F abort to orbit * STS-93 launch * M2-F2 crash test * Boeing 720 controlled impact * NASA aircraft drop test * spacewalk water leak * Luca Parmitano EVA * spacecraft recovery mission * Hubble servicing footage Try different versions of mission names. For example, search both “Gemini 8” and “Gemini VIII.” Download the highest available resolution directly from NASA. Save the asset’s title, asset ID, date, description, credit and original URL. NASA RIGHTS RULES NASA-produced media is generally available for factual, educational and informational use, but do not assume every file on a NASA website is automatically cleared. Check whether: * NASA created the footage. * A commercial company, foreign agency or news organization contributed it. * The page identifies a third-party copyright owner. * The footage contains copyrighted music. * The planned use could imply NASA endorsement. * An identifiable person creates a privacy or publicity concern. NASA must be credited as the source. Do not use the NASA name or logo in a way that suggests the channel is an official NASA production. PRIMARY AVIATION SOURCES 1. NTSB Aviation Investigation Search ---------- 2. NTSB Docket System ---------- 3. NTSB A ---------- Reports ---------- 4. NTSB Event Archive ---------- 5. NASA Image and Video Library Search the Aeronautics category. 6. National Archives Catalog Search for FAA, NASA, military and aviation-safety footage. 7. FAA official media and safety pages ---------- 8. DVIDS military media archive ---------- HOW TO USE THE NTSB SYSTEM Search using: * Airline * Flight number * Aircraft registration * A ---------- date * Location * NTSB a ---------- number Open the investigation docket and look for: * Flight-path animation * Recorded-data animation * Airport surveillance * Security-camera video * Witness video * Investigation photographs * Wreckage photographs * Cockpit displays * Air-traffic-control transcripts * Exhibit lists * Hearing presentations * Maps and diagrams * Final a ---------- report Do not assume every file in an NTSB docket is public domain. The NTSB may possess privately created passenger videos, airport surveillance, manufacturer graphics or news photographs. Record the creator and rights information for each individual file. Do not use an actual cockpit voice recording unless its release and use are explicitly lawful. Use authorized transcripts, official narration or NTSB animations instead. AVIATION SEARCH EXAMPLES Use searches such as: * ---------- “flight path animation” aviation * ---------- /Docket “animation” flight * ---------- Boeing 720 controlled impact * ---------- aircraft crash test * ---------- M2-F2 * ---------- NASA aviation test * ---------- aviation emergency public domain * ---------- aircraft safety test video PROHIBITED SOURCES Do not download footage from: * Mentour Pilot * Green Dot Aviation * Disaster Breakdown * Air Crash Investigation * Smithsonian Channel * National Geographic * Discovery * Netflix * News stations * Airline documentaries * Passenger social-media accounts * Reddit * TikTok * Instagram * Other YouTube creators * LiveATC * C-SPAN * Commercial stock libraries without a purchased license These may be used to discover an i ---------- , but never as our master footage source without written commercial permission. FOOTAGE RIGHTS CLASSIFICATION Mark every asset: GREEN * Clearly identified as NASA or U.S. federal-government work * Explicitly identified as public domain * Explicitly downloadable and reusable * Commercial license has been purchased and documented YELLOW * Hosted by a government agency but original creator is unclear * Foreign-government or international-agency footage * Airport surveillance * Manufacturer-created animation * Third-party material contained in an NTSB docket * Usage terms are unclear Yellow footage cannot be placed in the edit until permission or ownership is confirmed. RED * News footage * Television documentary footage * Other YouTube creator footage * Passenger or witness video without permission * Copyrighted music * Material explicitly prohibiting redistribution * Footage with an unidentified watermark Do not download or submit red footage for production. FOOTAGE REQUIREMENTS FOR EACH CASE For every i ---------- , collect: * Five to ten minutes of usable video when available * Ten or more high-resolution photographs * Mission or a ---------- animation * Official report * Relevant transcript * Maps or flight path * Technical diagrams * Crew or astronaut photographs * Vehicle or spacecraft photographs * Rescue and recovery material * Official outcome * Safety changes made afterward A case should not be recommended for production unless it can visually support at least two to three minutes of the finished video. DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS Create one folder per i ---------- : 01_Footage 02_Audio 03_Images 04_Documents 05_Rights 06_Notes Name each asset clearly: Case_Source_Date_Description_AssetID Example: Apollo13_NASA_1970_MissionControl_AssetID.mp4 The Rights folder must contain: * Screenshot or PDF of the asset page * Original URL * Copyright or usage statement * Required credit * Date accessed * Creator or agency * Rights classification TRACKING SHEET Include these columns: Video Topic | I ---------- | Agency | Asset Title | Asset ID | Direct URL | Media Type | Duration | Resolution | Creator | Rights Status | Rights Evidence | Required Credit | Downloaded | Best Timestamps | Notes QUALITY CONTROL Before submitting a package, confirm: * Every file opens. * Videos are the highest available resolution. * Files do not contain third-party watermarks. * No footage came from another YouTube documentary. * Every asset has a saved source URL. * Every asset has a rights classification. * Strong moments have timestamps. * The official facts match the footage. * There is enough visual material to make the segment engaging. Never label footage public domain merely because it appears on a government website.

job_title: 🧠 DEEP PERSONAL GROWTH & TRANSFORMATION SPECIALIST  ### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious &
description: ### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious & Mind-Body Connection **Remote | One-on-One | Zoom** I am looking for an **excellent psychologist, therapist, mental-health coach, holistic life coach, or integrative wellness practitioner** who has deep knowledge of **personal transformation, subconscious patterns, emotional conditioning, behavior change, and mind-body approaches.** I am currently healthy and am **not looking for treatment of a mental-health disorder or diagnosis.** My goal is **personal growth and meaningful change**. I want to become more motivated, improve how I represent myself, develop better habits and behaviors, overcome patterns that may be holding me back, and become the best version of myself. ## WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION DIFFERENT I am looking for someone with a **deep and broad understanding of different approaches to personal transformation**, rather than someone who relies on only one standard therapeutic method. For example, I am very interested in approaches such as: * Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work * Somatic and body-based approaches * Inner-child work * Hypnotherapy * EFT / Tapping * EMDR, when appropriately trained * Meditation and mindfulness * Breathwork * Nervous-system regulation * Subconscious and emotional-pattern work * Visualization * Mind-body approaches * Trauma-informed approaches * Attachment and relational approaches * Neuroplasticity and habit change * Other experiential, integrative, holistic, or consciousness-based approaches **These are examples, not a required checklist.** If you know other powerful modalities or approaches that I have not mentioned, I want to hear about them. In fact, discovering approaches I **don't already know about** is part of what I am looking for. ## 🧠 DEPTH OF KNOWLEDGE IS IMPORTANT I want someone who understands the deeper relationship between: **thoughts → emotions → nervous system → brain → subconscious/implicit patterns → behavior → habits → identity → change** Knowledge of areas such as the **amygdala, subconscious processes, conditioning, neuroplasticity, habit formation, emotional learning, and behavior change** is a strong advantage. I am also interested in the broader **mind-body and consciousness field**. If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza's work**, meditation approaches, visualization, emotional-state work, or similar mind-body/consciousness teachings, that is a major plus. You do not need to follow any particular teacher or agree with every theory. I am looking for someone who can **understand these ideas intelligently, explain them clearly, and distinguish established evidence from theories, interpretations, or spiritual concepts.** ## 🎯 I WANT AN ACTUAL PLAN The biggest thing I am looking for is someone who can take all this knowledge and turn it into **practical personal development.** I don't simply want to have conversations every week. I want someone who can help me: * Identify the areas I want to change * Understand the patterns behind them * Determine which approaches may be useful * Create a personalized plan * Give me specific exercises and practices * Set realistic goals * Create weekly action steps * Follow up on my progress * Hold me accountable * Evaluate what is working and what isn't * Adjust the approach when necessary * Help me actually implement the changes For example, if we identify a particular pattern or behavior I want to change, I want us to be able to say: **What is the pattern? What may be contributing to it? What are we going to work on? What technique or exercise will we use? What am I going to practice this week? What will we review next session?** I want the work to be **structured, personalized, and results-oriented.** ## 🌱 THIS IS ABOUT GROWTH, NOT DIAGNOSIS I want to emphasize that I am **currently healthy and seeking personal development**, not treatment for a psychiatric or medical condition. I am looking for someone who can work with a healthy person who wants to: * Grow personally * Change behaviors and habits * Improve motivation * Build confidence * Improve self-expression * Understand themselves more deeply * Develop greater awareness * Become more consistent * Improve their relationships and communication * Break unwanted patterns * Create meaningful positive change If you are a licensed psychologist or therapist, please state your credentials. If you are a coach or practitioner rather than a licensed mental-health professional, that is also fine — **please clearly explain your actual training, certifications, experience, and scope of practice.** ## 👤 WHO I AM LOOKING FOR The ideal candidate is someone who has **studied multiple approaches and developed a broad professional toolbox.** You might be: * A psychologist with additional integrative training * A therapist trained in multiple modalities * An IFS or somatic practitioner * A holistic/integrative therapist * A highly trained life or wellness coach * A hypnotherapist * A mind-body practitioner * A meditation or mindfulness professional * Or another practitioner with substantial training in personal transformation The specific title is less important to me than **the depth of your knowledge, quality of your training, and your ability to actually help someone create change.** ## 🔎 APPLICATION QUESTIONS Please answer these carefully in your OnlineJobs.ph application. ### 1. Imagine that a healthy person tells you: **“There are certain things about myself that I want to change. I understand intellectually what I should do, but I repeatedly fall back into the same patterns.”** How would you approach helping that person create lasting change? Please explain your actual approach rather than simply listing techniques. ### 2. What are the deeper or less commonly known modalities you have studied or practiced? Please tell me about approaches **beyond standard CBT or general talk therapy** that you believe can be useful for personal transformation. There is **no requirement to know the specific modalities listed in this post**. I am interested in discovering what YOU know. ### BONUS QUESTION What is your understanding of the relationship between the **amygdala, subconscious/implicit patterns, repeated experiences, neuroplasticity, and behavior change?** If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches**, please explain your familiarity. ## 💰 PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE Please include: * Your **hourly or session rate** * Normal session length * Whether you offer an initial/trial session * Price of the initial session, if different **Please include your rate in your application.** ## 📱 ALTERNATIVE WHATSAPP CONTACT The preferred method is to apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**. However, if you believe you are an especially strong fit, you may also contact me directly on WhatsApp: **WhatsApp: ---------- ** If contacting me through WhatsApp, please introduce yourself, explain your professional background and the approaches you specialize in, and include your rate. ## 💵 $20 REFERRAL BONUS If you are **not personally the right person** for this position but know someone who would be an **excellent fit**, please feel free to share this post with them. If your referral results in me hiring that person, **I will pay a $20 referral fee.** So if you know an exceptional psychologist, therapist, coach, somatic practitioner, IFS practitioner, hypnotherapist, or another professional with deep expertise in personal transformation, please feel free to send them this opportunity. ## ⭐ FINAL I am looking for someone with **real depth, broad knowledge, professionalism, and the ability to turn knowledge into action.** Someone who can help me understand myself more deeply, introduce me to approaches I may not know about, create a personalized strategy for growth, and then **actually work with me to implement it.** If you believe you are that person, I would be very interested in hearing from you. Join our group for more job updates ---------- /CGhqjb0WQwD0WRh99tTinL

title: CONTENT & RESEARCH SPECIALIST
description: CONTENT & RESEARCH SPECIALIST Employment Type: Contract Time Zone: EST Location: Remote About the Role We are looking for a Content & Research Specialist with strong B2B copywriting and content-writing experience, ideally with a background in sales, outbound, B2B SaaS, franchise, or enterprise environments. This role will be responsible for developing highly targeted outreach copy and ongoing LinkedIn content based on real sales conversations, buyer objections, and audience language. A key part of the role is the ability to write convincingly in someone else's voice. This is not simply a general marketing-content position. The ideal candidate should be comfortable with ghostwriting-style work and able to capture a client's tone, perspective, terminology, and communication style with minimal editing. You will also conduct focused buyer and ICP research, identify relevant trigger events, segment audiences, and continuously improve messaging based on real prospect conversations Key Responsibilities Campaign Copywriting Write initial campaign copy for email and LinkedIn outreach sequences based on the client's positioning, audience, and approved strategy. Develop messaging that is specific to the prospect's role, company, industry, and buying context. Create different messaging angles and sequences for different audience segments rather than relying on generic outreach copy. Adapt copy based on real objections, questions, and language coming from prospects LinkedIn Content & Ghostwriting Develop ongoing LinkedIn content for the client's spokesperson. Draft posts based on real sales conversations, buyer objections, customer questions, and recurring market themes. Capture and maintain the client's authentic voice, tone, opinions, and communication style. Write content that feels naturally authored by the spokesperson rather than generic AI- or marketing-generated content. Maintain a consistent content cadence and deliver posts according to agreed schedules ICP & Buyer Research Conduct light research into the client's Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and target buyers. Research buyer pain points, motivations, objections, priorities, and purchasing contexts. Use research findings to inform campaign messaging, content angles, and targeting. Prioritize specific, relevant, and verifiable insights over generic industry observations. Trigger Event Research Identify relevant trigger events that can create timely and personalized outreach opportunities. Monitor signals such as: Platform or technology sunsets Competitor renewals or changes Company funding announcements Hiring activity Leadership or organizational changes Public customer complaints Product or technology changes Other relevant business developments Translate relevant trigger events into potential campaign angles and messaging opportunities. Audience Segmentation Segment target lists into meaningful groups based on role, company type, business model, and buying context. Develop distinct messaging approaches for each segment. Examples may include: Franchisor headquarters Individual franchisees Multi-unit independent operators Enterprise organizations Different buyer/persona levels Ensure each segment receives messaging and campaign sequences that genuinely reflect its unique needs and buying context rather than superficial variations of the same campaign. Messaging & Response Library Maintain a living "Suggested Responses" reference document. Add and refine suggested responses based on real conversations and recurring prospect questions. Identify effective responses to common objections and scenarios. Continuously improve the reference material as new conversations and insights become available Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured by: Content/Copy Turnaround Time: Requested copy and content delivered within agreed timelines, typically within 48 hours of receiving a brief. Voice & Tone Accuracy: How closely drafts match the client's actual voice and communication style without requiring heavy editing. Research Quality & Specificity: Research findings are relevant, specific, and supported by real, checkable signals rather than generic information. Segmentation Quality: Target groups are meaningfully differentiated, with messaging and campaign approaches that genuinely change based on the audience. Content Cadence: Consistent delivery of scheduled content, such as 2 LinkedIn posts per week. Revision Rate: Percentage of content requiring significant edits before it is usable. Lower revision requirements indicate stronger performance Requirements Proven experience as a B2B copywriter, content writer, or similar role. Demonstrated experience writing for sales, outbound, lead generation, or business development campaigns. Strong understanding of B2B audiences, buyer psychology, and sales messaging. Experience writing email and LinkedIn outreach sequences. Strong ability to adapt writing to different audiences, industries, and buyer personas. Demonstrated ability to write convincingly in another person's voice or perform ghostwriting style work. Excellent written English with strong command of tone, structure, clarity, and persuasion. Strong research skills and ability to identify meaningful business signals and trigger events. Ability to turn research and real customer conversations into relevant content and messaging. Strong attention to detail and ability to work from briefs and established client guidelines. Ability to work consistently within EST hours. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience writing for B2B SaaS companies. Experience working with franchise, enterprise, or multi-location businesses. Previous experience supporting sales or outbound teams. Experience with LinkedIn thought leadership or executive ghostwriting. Experience creating messaging for different ICP segments or buyer personas. Familiarity with sales engagement, CRM, or outbound platforms. Experience analyzing sales conversations, objections, and prospect feedback to improve messaging. Portfolio demonstrating strong B2B copywriting, outbound messaging, and/or ghostwriting work. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a strong B2B writer who understands sales, not simply a general content marketer. You should be able to take a brief, understand the target buyer, research the relevant context, and produce messaging that feels specific and commercially relevant. Most importantly, you should be able to sound like the client. Your writing should reflect their voice and perspective naturally, without requiring extensive rewriting. You should also be comfortable using real sales conversations and market signals to continuously improve campaigns and content. We will prioritize candidates whose portfolios demonstrate B2B SaaS, enterprise, franchise, outbound, sales-focused, or ghostwriting experience. If interested kindly send your relevant portfolio and Resume/CV. Thank you

title: Azure cloud hosting
description: Below is a professional job posting designed for a CPA firm seeking a contractor or IT consultant to design, deploy, and manage an Azure-hosted environment for Drake Tax Software while meeting Written Information Security Plan (WISP) requirements. Azure Cloud Infrastructure Consultant – Drake Tax Software Hosting & WISP Compliance Contract Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Infrastructure Consultant to design, implement, and document a secure Microsoft Azure hosting environment for Drake Tax Software supporting approximately 5 to 7 concurrent users. The environment must be optimized for performance, reliability, and compliance with IRS Publication 4557, FTC Safeguards Rule requirements, and our firm's Written Information Security Plan (WISP). This project will support a CPA firm with a strong focus on client data protection, secure remote access, disaster recovery, and regulatory compliance. Project Scope The selected consultant will be responsible for designing and deploying a cloud-hosted solution that includes: Azure Infrastructure Design Design an Azure environment to host Drake Tax Software for 5–7 users. Recommend and implement appropriate Azure Virtual Machines, storage, networking, and security architecture. Configure secure Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) integration. Design for scalability and future growth. Secure Remote Access Implement secure remote desktop access for authorized users. Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Configure conditional access and identity security controls. Restrict administrative privileges using least-privilege principles. WISP & Regulatory Compliance Design the environment to support compliance with: FTC Safeguards Rule IRS Publication 4557 Written Information Security Plan (WISP) Data encryption requirements Access control requirements Security monitoring requirements Document security controls and compliance measures. Data Protection & Backup Implement automated backup and recovery procedures. Configure geo-redundant or appropriate business continuity protections. Establish Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO). Enable encryption for data at rest and in transit. Security Monitoring Configure: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Azure Security Center Security alerting and monitoring Audit logging and retention Endpoint protection recommendations Documentation Provide complete documentation including: Network diagrams Server specifications Security configuration documentation Administrative procedures Disaster recovery procedures User onboarding/offboarding procedures WISP compliance mapping Deliverables The successful consultant will provide: Azure architecture design document Cost estimate and licensing requirements Fully deployed Azure environment Drake Tax software installation and configuration Security hardening checklist Backup and disaster recovery plan WISP compliance documentation Administrative guide and knowledge transfer session Required Qualifications Minimum 5 years of Microsoft Azure infrastructure experience. Experience hosting line-of-business applications in Azure Virtual Desktop or Azure Virtual Machines. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Experience implementing cybersecurity controls for accounting, financial, or professional service firms. Knowledge of FTC Safeguards Rule and IRS security requirements. Experience configuring: Azure Virtual Machines Azure Backup Azure File Shares Virtual Networks Microsoft Defender Conditional Access Policies Multi-Factor Authentication Preferred Qualifications Experience hosting Drake Tax Software. Experience supporting CPA firms or tax practices. Microsoft Azure certifications. Cybersecurity certifications (CISSP, CISM, Security+, Microsoft Security certifications). Experience implementing Written Information Security Plans (WISP). Desired Outcomes The project will result in: Secure remote access for 5–7 staff members. Reliable Drake Tax Software performance. Centralized document and application management. Reduced cybersecurity risk. Environment aligned with firm security policies and WISP requirements. Comprehensive documentation for ongoing maintenance and compliance reviews. To Apply Please provide: Relevant Azure certifications. Experience with tax software hosting environments. Similar project references. Proposed architecture approach. Estimated project cost and timeline. Ongoing support and maintenance options. This is an excellent opportunity for an Azure consultant with cybersecurity and compliance expertise to help modernize a growing CPA firm's technology platform while ensuring protection of sensitive taxpayer information.

WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and qualify inbound B2B inquiries with professionalism and genuine brand awareness - Research, identify and reach out to quality wholesale partners: surf shops, surf schools, surf camps, water sports centres, resort operators and boardsport retailers - Evaluate partners not just by size, but by reputation, community standing and cultural fit - Build and nurture relationships with key accounts, following up properly instead of sending one email and giving up - Maintain a clean, accurate outreach tracker in Google Sheets: who was contacted, when, what was said, what happens next - Report to the CEO weekly with a structured update on pipeline, leads and opportunities - Act as a brand ambassador. Are comfortable communicating with CEOs, founders, executives, and business owners. Understand B2B sales psychology and modern prospecting strategies. Have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Are self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven. Have excellent written English and strong communication skills. Understand that quality conversations matter more than message volume. LINKEDIN PROFILE REQUIREMENTS To be considered, your LinkedIn profile should have: At least 1,000 LinkedIn connections A professional network relevant to: B2B SaaS Marketing Design Technology An active LinkedIn profile with consistent engagement. An account in good standing with no recent restrictions. Important: We may request a screenshot of your LinkedIn Network page during the hiring process to verify your network size and profile activity. WHY JOIN PENJI? At Penji, we believe great outreach isn't about spamming people—it's about starting the right conversations with the right people. You'll have the freedom to: Experiment with different messaging strategies Test new outreach angles Analyze data and improve conversion rates Build relationships with business decision-makers Work with a collaborative remote team Directly contribute to Penji's sales growth This isn't a role where success is measured by how many messages you send. BRAND AND COMPLIANCE STANDARDS VLARI serves an established and sophisticated audience. All content must be professional, credible, polished, and consistent. all content before submitting it for approval * Verify names, dates, figures, links, and claims * Use approved disclosures when required * Protect client confidentiality * Protect company intellectual property * Maintain organized records of approvals and published content You may not independently: * Promise tax savings or financial results * Publish unverified financial figures * Provide tax, legal, investment, or insurance advice * Respond to individualized strategy questions * Recommend insurance or financial products * Use actual client information without written authorization * Create title: Full-Time Lead Generation & CRM Specialist (GoHighLevel | Outreach | Social Media Support)
job_title: Full-Time Lead Generation & CRM Specialist (GoHighLevel | Outreach | Social Media Support)
description: Full-Time Lead Generation & CRM Specialist (GoHighLevel | Outreach | Social Media Support) - $4.50–$5.50/hour (based on experience) - Full-time, 40 hours/week - Remote – Overlap with Eastern Time (EST) preferred — ideally available during US morning or early afternoon hours - Paid bi-weekly (or weekly if need be) via Wise or PayPal or direct deposit About Us We're a truck, trailer, and RV repair company based in Pompano Beach, South Florida — and we're growing fast. We serve commercial fleets, owner-operators, and RV owners across Broward County, and we have aggressive plans to expand. We run lean. Every person on this team owns their work and moves the needle directly. We're not hiring someone to "manage our social media." We're hiring someone who finds leads, works them hard, and turns them into booked jobs. What You'll Be Working On Your #1 mission is to build a large, clean database of businesses in Broward County that operate trucks, trailers, or RVs — and then convert those leads into booked service appointments through smart, persistent, multi-channel outreach. Everything else on this list supports that core goal. #1. Lead Generation & Database Building — 50%+ of your time Use Google Maps, industry directories, Seamless, Lusha, Apollo, and similar tools to research and identify businesses that operate commercial vehicles or RVs. Build a master database that includes company name, website, industry, estimated fleet size, physical address, phone numbers, emails, and key contacts where available. We want a large, structured, usable list — built with care, not speed. #2. CRM Management (GoHighLevel or similar) Set up and manage pipelines, import and tag lead data, build email/SMS/follow-up automations, and keep lead status and conversation history current and organized. #3. Outreach & Appointment Setting — Critical Run outbound campaigns across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and DMs. Follow up consistently — most deals close after the 4th or 5th touch. Respond to inbound inquiries across platforms (Facebook, Reddit, Google, etc.) and convert conversations into booked service appointments. We measure results, not activity. Booked appointments = success. #4. Automation & AI Workflows Build follow-up automations that reduce manual effort over time. Use AI tools to scale outreach and responses. We want systems that compound — not constant manual work. #5. Social Media — Supporting Role Post daily to Facebook, Instagram, and Google Business Profile (TikTok optional). Engage in trucking and RV-related groups, respond to messages, and use social channels to drive inbound leads. Social media supports lead generation — it is not the primary job. #6. Basic Marketing Materials Create simple, clean flyers and graphics in Canva or similar tools to support outreach campaigns. Nothing elaborate — functional and professional. #7. Light Admin / RFP Support Assist with occasional research and document prep for service bids as needed. What We're Looking For - GoHighLevel experience — be specific and honest about your level - Strong internet research and lead sourcing skills - Comfortable running multi-channel outreach (email, SMS, WhatsApp, DMs) - Highly organized and detail-oriented - Self-starter who takes initiative without waiting for instructions - Proficient with AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.) - Strong written English; Spanish is a bonus - Available to overlap with EST hours (Miami, FL) — at least 4–5 hours of shared working time per day What Working With Us Looks Like We're a small, fast-moving operation. You'll work directly with the owner. We communicate clearly, give you the tools you need, and get out of your way. We don't micromanage — we set goals and expect you to own them. We're building something here, and the right person grows with us. This role starts full-time and we treat long-term contributors well. What Success Looks Like at 60 Days - A large, clean, tagged lead database ready for outreach - Active outreach happening daily across multiple channels - Booked appointments traceable to your efforts - Automations in place that reduce manual follow-up work This Role Is NOT For You If: - You're looking for a social media posting job, you wait for step-by-step instructions, or you think one follow-up email is enough. This Role IS For You If: - You like hunting for leads, you follow up until you get an answer, and you take ownership of outcomes — not just tasks. We want someone who treats this business like it matters, because it does. To Apply, Include: - Your lead generation experience and tools you've used (Seamless, Lusha, Apollo, etc.) - Your GoHighLevel experience — be specific - Your availability and how many hours per day you can overlap with Eastern Time - A brief walkthrough of how you'd find 50 fleet or RV businesses in a specific Florida city - The word SIERRA somewhere in your application
